title.en: World Desk
title.zh: 全球焦点

strap.en: A fast view of global affairs, conflict, diplomacy, and human need.
strap.zh: 快速掌握国际局势、冲突、外交与人类处境。

title.en: Trump uses 9/11 memorial speech to justify Iran war as families commemorate victims of attack – live
title.zh: 特朗普在9/11纪念演讲中为伊朗战争辩护，之际家属纪念袭击受害者

summary.en: President Trump used the 9/11 memorial event for a political speech, while victims of the September 11 attacks were honored at memorials across the US. The article notes that 25 years prior, Osama bin Laden was in eastern Afghanistan, unaware of the attacks unfolding in the US.
summary.zh: 特朗普总统在9/11纪念活动上发表了政治演讲，而全美各地的纪念仪式正在悼念“9·11”袭击的受害者。文章提到，25年前的9月11日，本·拉登正在阿富汗东部，并未得知美国境内发生的袭击事件。

body.en: President appears to tie Iran war to ‘sacred oath’ to victims killed in September 11 attacks as memorials are held across the US On 11 September, 25 years ago, Osama bin Laden drove with a small number of al-Qaida retainers and aides to a remote location in eastern Afghanistan. His convoy of SUVs was accompanied by a minivan converted into a makeshift communications centre. The van’s rudimentary equipment did not allow Bin Laden to watch the 19 men he had started sending to the US more than a year before fly planes into the twin towers in New York and the Pentagon near Washington DC, killing about 3,000 people. But he listened as shocked radio announcers broke the news. Continue reading...
body.zh: 总统利用9月11日袭击中遇难者发表政治演讲的机会，在美国各地举行纪念活动。25年前的9月11日，奥萨马·本·拉登带着少数基地组织成员和助手驱车前往阿富汗东部的一个偏远地区。他的车队由一辆改装成临时通讯中心的小型货车陪同。这辆面包车的设备简陋，无法让本·拉登亲眼目睹一年多前他开始派往美国的 19 名人员驾驶飞机撞上纽约双子塔和华盛顿特区附近的五角大楼，造成约 3,000 人死亡。但当广播播音员宣布这一消息时，他感到震惊。继续阅读...

reflection.en: On the solemn anniversary of 9/11, a day meant for remembrance and honoring victims, the occasion was used for political speech. This moment highlights the ongoing struggle to respond to tragedy with solemnity and respect, rather than allowing it to become a platform for partisan rhetoric. The call to overcome evil with good, rather than mirroring it with...
reflection.zh: 在“9·11”这个本应庄严纪念遇难者的周年纪念日，这一时刻却被用于政治演讲。这一事件凸显了在面对悲剧时，如何以肃穆和尊重来回应，而不是将其变成党派言论的平台。战胜邪恶而非以分裂的言辞回应邪恶的呼吁，依然是一个挑战。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: US officials declare multi-state cyclospora outbreak over
title.zh: 美国官员宣布多州环孢子虫疫情结束

summary.en: The largest recorded multi-state outbreak of cyclosporiasis in the US, linked to processed iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms in Mexico, has ended. The outbreak infected 12,883 people across 21 states, leading to 570 hospitalizations and two deaths.
summary.zh: 美国有记录以来最大规模的多州环孢子虫病爆发已结束，该疫情与墨西哥泰勒农场加工的球生菜有关。此次疫情波及21个州，感染了12,883人，导致570人住院，2人死亡。

body.en: Outbreak was linked to iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms, which infected 12,882 people and led to two deaths The US’s largest recorded multi-state outbreak of sickness caused by the cyclospora parasite has ended, federal health officials announced on Friday. The record outbreak of cyclosporiasis was linked to processed iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms in central Mexico, which infected 12,883 people across 21 states and led to 570 hospitalizations and two deaths. Continue reading...
body.zh: 疫情与泰勒农场的卷心生菜有关，该生菜感染了 12,882 人，并导致两人死亡。联邦卫生官员周五宣布，美国有记录以来最大规模的由环孢子虫寄生虫引起的多州疾病疫情已经结束。创纪录的环孢子虫病爆发与墨西哥中部泰勒农场加工的卷心生菜有关，该病感染了 21 个州的 12,883 人，导致 570 人住院治疗，两人死亡。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This outbreak, affecting over 12,000 people and tragically claiming two lives, serves as a stark reminder of how interconnected our food systems are and how vulnerable we can be to widespread illness. The news of the outbreak's end brings relief, but it also calls for continued vigilance and prayer for those who suffered and for the systems that protect...
reflection.zh: 此次疫情影响了超过12,000人，并悲惨地夺走了两条生命，它鲜明地提醒我们食品系统的相互关联性以及我们在面对广泛疾病时的脆弱性。疫情结束的消息带来了宽慰，但也呼吁我们继续保持警惕，并为那些遭受病痛的人以及保障食品供应系统的人祈祷。 愿雅伟赐予所有受此疾病影响的人医治，并赐予那些致力于保障我们食品供应安全的人智慧。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Man sacked by Grand Theft Auto maker believes employees were put on ‘watch list’
title.zh: 《侠盗猎车手》制造商被解雇的员工认为员工被列入“观察名单”

summary.en: A UK employment tribunal is examining whether Rockstar Games unlawfully dismissed 31 staff for engaging in trade union activities. Dayne Oram, a former employee, testified that he believed the company placed workers on a 'watch list' after they signed a petition regarding remote working in 2023, suggesting a pattern...
summary.zh: 英国就业法庭正在审理 Rockstar Games 是否因工会活动而非法解雇了 31 名员工。前员工 Dayne Oram 作证称，他认为公司在 2023 年员工签署了关于远程工作的请愿书后，将一些工人列入了“观察名单”，这表明存在报复行为。

body.en: UK employment tribunal examines whether Rockstar Games unlawfully fired 31 staff for trade union activity A worker fired by the makers of Grand Theft Auto has said he believed employees were put on a “watch list” after signing a petition about remote working. Dayne Oram told an employment tribunal in Glasgow examining whether Rockstar Games unlawfully fired 31 employees for trade union activity on Friday that he thought the company started keeping an eye on a group of workers after the petition was sent to leadership in 2023. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国就业法庭正在调查 Rockstar Games 是否因工会活动非法解雇 31 名员工 一名被《侠盗猎车手》制造商解雇的员工表示，他相信员工在签署一份关于远程工作的请愿书后被列入“观察名单”。 Dayne Oram 周五在格拉斯哥的一个就业法庭上表示，该法庭正在调查 Rockstar Games 是否因工会活动非法解雇 31 名员工，他认为公司在 2023 年向领导层提交请愿书后就开始关注一群工人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the pursuit of fair labor practices, the dignity of every worker must be upheld. When employees organize or voice concerns, as Dayne Oram did, they should be met with justice and respect, not suspicion or dismissal. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that should guide employer-employee relationships.
reflection.zh: 在追求公平的劳动实践中，必须维护每位工人的尊严。当员工组织起来或表达担忧时，正如 Dayne Oram 所做的那样，他们应该得到公正和尊重，而不是怀疑或解雇。弥迦书 6:8 呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与我们的雅伟同行，这些原则应指导雇主与雇员之间的关系。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Trump and Hegseth use 9/11 memorial remarks at Pentagon to defend war on Iran
title.zh: 特朗普和赫格斯在五角大楼的9/11纪念讲话中为对伊朗的战争辩护

summary.en: During remarks at the Pentagon on the 25th anniversary of 9/11, President Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth linked the terrorist attacks to the ongoing war in Iran, suggesting the conflict was part of the legacy of 9/11. These ceremonies typically focus on the victims of the 2001 attacks, but the leaders used...
summary.zh: 在纪念9/11事件25周年之际，特朗普总统和国防部长皮特·赫格斯在五角大楼的讲话中，将这次恐怖袭击与正在进行的伊朗战争联系起来，暗示这场冲突是9/11事件遗留问题的一部分。这类纪念仪式通常侧重于2001年袭击的受害者，但两位领导人却借此机会为这场已持续六个多月且看不到尽头的战争辩护。

body.en: President and defense secretary try to link worst terrorist attack in US history to current unpopular war US politics live – latest updates Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth used remarks at the memorial ceremony marking the 25th anniversary of 9/11 to defend the US-Israel war on Iran – and suggest the controversial conflict was part of the legacy of the worst terrorist attack in US history. While such ceremonies on September 11 typically focus on the victims of the 2001 attacks, the US president and his defense secretary each pointed to the war they launched on Iran more than six months ago, with no end in sight. Continue reading...
body.zh: 总统和国防部长试图将美国历史上最严重的恐怖袭击与当前不受欢迎的美国政治现场战争联系起来——唐纳德·特朗普和皮特·赫格斯在纪念9/11 25周年的纪念仪式上发表讲话，为美以对伊朗的战争辩护——并暗示这场有争议的冲突是美国历史上最严重的恐怖袭击遗产的一部分。虽然 9 月 11 日的此类仪式通常聚焦于 2001 年袭击的受害者，但美国总统和国防部长都提到了他们在六个多月前对伊朗发动的战争，而且这场战争还没有结束的迹象。继续阅读...

reflection.en: On solemn anniversaries like September 11th, the focus is often on remembrance and healing. However, when leaders use such moments to justify ongoing military action, it risks perpetuating cycles of conflict. The temptation to respond to past violence with present force can overshadow the call to overcome evil with good, a principle that calls for a...
reflection.zh: 在9月11日这样的庄严纪念日，人们的焦点通常是缅怀和疗伤。然而，当领导人利用这样的时刻为正在进行的军事行动辩护时，就有可能加剧冲突的循环。用当前的武力回应过去的暴力，这种诱惑可能会盖过“以善胜恶”的呼召，而这呼召要求一条不同于无休止报复的道路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: New Mexico lawyer fined for using AI-generated brief containing fabricated police testimony
title.zh: 新墨西哥州律师因使用包含捏造警方证词的AI生成摘要而被罚款

summary.en: Stephen Aarons, a lawyer, has been fined and held in contempt by the New Mexico Supreme Court for submitting a legal brief that contained fabricated police testimony and witnesses generated by OpenAI's ChatGPT. Aarons stated he used the AI to create a 'bulletproof summary' for a murder conviction appeal but failed to...
summary.zh: 新墨西哥州最高法院对律师斯蒂芬·阿隆斯处以罚款并将其视为藐视法庭，原因是他在一份法律摘要中提交了由OpenAI的ChatGPT捏造的警方证词和证人。阿隆斯表示，他曾试图使用该AI为一起谋杀案定罪的上诉创建一个“无懈可击的摘要”，但未能核实其准确性。

body.en: Stephen Aarons said he tried to use ChatGPT to create a ‘bulletproof summary’ during a murder conviction appeal A defense lawyer appealing his client’s murder conviction submitted a legal brief containing ⁠made-up police testimony and ⁠witnesses fabricated by OpenAI ’s ChatGPT, ​ New Mexico ’s highest court said. The New Mexico supreme court on Wednesday fined the attorney, Stephen Aarons, and held him in contempt for failing to verify the accuracy of the court ⁠filing, which Aarons said he prepared with help from the artificial intelligence ( AI ) application. Continue reading...
body.zh: 斯蒂芬·阿伦斯 (Stephen Aarons) 表示，他在谋杀定罪上诉期间试图使用 ChatGPT 创建“防弹摘要”。​新墨西哥州最高法院表示，一名对其委托人谋杀定罪提出上诉的辩护律师提交了一份法律摘要，其中包含 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 捏造的警方证词和证人。新墨西哥州最高法院周三对律师史蒂芬·亚伦斯 (Stephen Aarons) 处以罚款，并因他未能核实法庭文件的准确性而判定他藐视法庭，亚伦斯表示，该文件是他在人工智能 (AI) 应用程序的帮助下准备的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI presents new challenges to truth and integrity in all fields, including the legal profession. When human judgment is bypassed in favor of automated output, the risk of disseminating falsehoods, as seen with the fabricated testimony in this case, becomes a serious concern. Upholding truthfulness is a fundamental ethical and...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展给包括法律界在内的所有领域带来了对真相和诚信的新挑战。当人类的判断被自动化输出所取代时，传播虚假信息的风险，正如本案中捏造的证词所示，就成了一个严重的问题。坚持说实话是一项基本的道德和属灵责任。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists sentenced to up to seven years in prison
title.zh: 香港天安门案活动人士被判处最高七年监禁

summary.en: Hong Kong was formerly one of the few places in Chinese territory where gatherings could be held to commemorate the 1989 crackdown.
summary.zh: 香港曾是中国领土上少数可以举行集会纪念1989年镇压事件的地点之一。

body.en:
Three Hong Kong activists who organised annual vigils commemorating Beijing's 1989 crackdown on Tiananmen Square protests have been handed prison sentences of up to seven years.

Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, were convicted last month of inciting others to subvert state power, under the city's controversial national security law. A third defendant, Albert Ho, 74, had pleaded guilty in January.

The office of United Nations human rights chief Volker Türk called for "these sentences to be quashed".

Hong Kong and Macau were for years the only places on Chinese soil where people could hold gatherings to mark the Tiananmen crackdown - a highly sensitive and heavily censored topic in mainland China.

These gatherings were banned by Hong Kong's authorities in 2020, citing Covid-19 policies, but never resumed. That same year, the national security law, which makes illegal a wider range of dissenting acts, officially came into force.

Authorities say the law is necessary to maintain stability, but critics argue it has eroded Hong Kong's autonomy and created a climate of fear.

Lee, Chow and Ho were charged in 2021. They faced up to 10 years in prison after their conviction.

On Friday, the court sentenced Lee to seven years in prison, while Chow was handed seven years and three months. Ho, who pleaded guilty, was sentenced to five years in prison.

As the court session started, Chow and Lee stood up and smiled at the public gallery, which was full of people. Ho wore a serious expression.

After their sentences were handed down, Lee appeared to pray as he was led out of the dock, while Chow blew a kiss to those seated in the public gallery.

According to a court summary in August, Lee and Chow had "incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power".

A key part of the trial concerned the group's slogan of "ending one-party dictatorship", which the court said had incited people to undermine the Chinese Communist Party.

"I cannot imagine that he has to spend another three years in jail, it is really unacceptable," she said, adding that Lee intended to appeal his sentence.

Chow's mother Medina told a crowd outside the court not to be "overly saddened" about the verdict. "Do not lose heart. And above all, do not feel guilty," she said, Reuters reported.

Speaking to the BBC before her arrest in 2022, Chow said she was "prepared to be arrested" and "willing to pay the price for fighting for democracy".

The defendants were leaders of the now-disbanded Hong Kong Alliance, a group founded in May 1989 to support students holding pro-democracy rallies.

Weeks later, the Chinese Communist Party sent troops and tanks to crush pro-democracy protests in Beijing's Tiananmen...
body.zh: 组织年度守夜活动纪念北京 1989 年镇压天安门广场抗议活动的三名香港活动人士被判处最高七年监禁。 上个月，根据香港备受争议的国家安全法，69岁的李卓人和41岁的周恒东因煽动他人颠覆国家政权而被定罪。第三名被告，74 岁的何俊仁 (Albert Ho) 一月份已认罪。 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克办公室呼吁“撤销这些判决”。 多年来，香港和澳门是中国领土上唯一人们可以举行集会纪念天安门镇压的地方——这是中国大陆高度敏感且受到严格审查的话题。 2020 年，香港当局以 Covid-19 政策为由禁止这些聚会，但从未恢复。同年，国家安全法正式生效，该法将范围更广的异议行为定为非法。 当局表示，这项法律对于维持稳定是必要的，但批评者认为，它削弱了香港的自治权，并造成了恐惧气氛。 李、周和何于 2021 年受到指控。定罪后，他们将面临最高 10 年的监禁。 周五，法院判处李某有期徒刑七年，周某则被判处七年零三个月监禁。何某认罪后被判处五年徒刑。 开庭时，周和李站起来，对着挤满人的公众旁听席微笑。何浩一脸严肃。 宣判后，李在被带出被告席时似乎在祈祷，而周则向坐在公共席上的人飞吻。 根据八月份的法庭摘要，李和周“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或参与行为，以颠覆国家政权”。 审判的一个关键部分涉及该组织“结束一党专政”的口号，法院称该口号煽动人们破坏中国共产党。 她说：“我无法想象他还要再入狱三年，这真的令人无法接受。”她补充说，李打算对他的判决提出上诉。 周的母亲梅迪纳告诉法庭外的人群不要对判决“过度悲伤”。据路透社报道，她说：“不要灰心。最重要的是，不要感到内疚。” 周在 2022 年被捕前接受 BBC 采访时表示，她“已经做好被捕的准备”，并且“愿意为争取民主而付出代价”。 被告是现已解散的香港联谊会的领导人，该团体成立于 1989 年 5 月，旨在支持学生举行民主集会。 几周后，中国共产党派遣军队和坦克镇压北京天安门的民主抗议活动......

reflection.en: These sentences highlight the tension between state authority and freedom of conscience. The activists, by organizing vigils for the Tiananmen Square crackdown, chose to honor memory and truth over obedience to laws they deemed unjust. Their actions echo the apostles' declaration: 'We must obey God rather than human beings.'
reflection.zh: 这些判决凸显了国家权威与良心自由之间的紧张关系。这些活动人士通过组织天安门镇压事件的守夜活动，选择了铭记历史和真相，而非服从他们认为不公正的法律。他们的行为呼应了使徒们的宣告：“我们必须服从雅伟，而不是人。”

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
title.zh: 胡塞武装声称在也门取得重大进展，并收紧对红海航运通道的控制

summary.en: The Iran-backed Houthis have reportedly seized Perim Island, a strategic location at the mouth of the Bab al-Mandab Strait, and captured the port city of Mokha, consolidating their control over a major international shipping route.
summary.zh: 据报道，伊朗支持的胡塞武装已占领曼德海峡入口处的战略要地皮里姆岛，并攻占了战略港口城市摩卡，巩固了其对主要国际航运通道的控制。

body.en:
Yemen's Houthis have claimed a major advance on the western Red Sea coast, consolidating their grip on the key international shipping route.

The Iran-backed group seized Perim Island at the mouth of the waterway in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a source from Yemen's internationally-recognised government told the BBC.

It comes a day after the Houthis captured the strategic port city of Mokha from Saudi-backed pro-government forces, according to military sources. A Yemeni military official told the AFP news agency the Houthis now control the entire coastline.

The Houthis earlier said they posed no threat to international shipping but reiterated their threat to target vessels from Saudi Arabia.

Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, the country's de facto ruler, has personally pressed US President Donald Trump to take military action against the Houthis during their rapid advance, two sources familiar with the matter told CBS News - the BBC's media partner in North America.

Trump has so far declined to involve the US military directly, offering instead to assist with intelligence and targeting support, the sources said.

A senior Trump administration official later told the BBC: "We are in continuous dialogue with Saudi Arabia and the Republic of Yemen government regarding regional stability."

On Friday, Yemeni pro-government forces withdrew from Perim (also known as Mayyun).

The Houthis later issued a statement, saying that their military operation to expel Saudi-backed forces had been a "success" and that "maritime navigation is safe for all companies except for Saudi vessels".

Houthi military spokesman Yahya Sarea said the "large-scale" military operation was launched on 3 September due to Saudi Arabia's "blatant aggression" against "our dear people".

Sarea also said the Houthis had expelled "Saudi enemy" forces from six districts in the Taiz and Hodeidah regions, claiming that hundreds of troops had been killed, wounded or captured.

Perim Island sits at the narrowest point of the Bab al-Mandab Strait, which has become increasingly important following the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz - another crucial waterway - in the conflict between the US and Iran.

Saudi Arabia has been relying on the Red Sea and the Bab al-Mandab Strait for shipping oil to customers in Asia.

The escalation of the conflict between the Houthis, Yemen's government and Saudi Arabia has contributed to a surge in oil prices.

Hundreds of people have reportedly been killed and thousands displaced since the Houthis launched an offensive in the south-west a week ago.

A Saudi-led coalition has also carried out air strikes on Houthi-controlled areas in western Yemen in support of the pro-government forces, and the Houthis have launched missiles and drones at cities...
body.zh: 也门胡塞武装声称在红海西部海岸取得了重大进展，巩固了他们对主要国际航运路线的控制。 国际公认的也门政府的消息人士告诉英国广播公司，伊朗支持的组织占领了曼德海峡水道口的佩里姆岛。 据军方消息人士称，一天前，胡塞武装从沙特支持的亲政府部队手中夺取了战略港口城市莫卡。一名也门军方官员告诉法新社，胡塞武装现在控制了整个海岸线。 胡塞武装早些时候表示，他们对国际航运不构成威胁，但重申他们的威胁是针对来自沙特阿拉伯的船只。 两位知情人士告诉英国广播公司北美媒体合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻，该国事实上的统治者沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼亲自敦促美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在胡塞武装迅速推进期间对其采取军事行动。 消息人士称，特朗普迄今为止拒绝直接让美国军方介入，而是提出提供情报和目标支持方面的协助。 特朗普政府的一名高级官员后来告诉英国广播公司：“我们正在与沙特阿拉伯和也门共和国政府就地区稳定问题进行持续对话。” 周五，也门亲政府部队从彼林（又名马云）撤军。 胡塞武装随后发表声明称，他们驱逐沙特支持部队的军事行动“成功”，“除沙特船只外，所有公司的海上航行都是安全的”。 胡塞武装发言人叶海亚·萨雷亚表示，9月3日发起的“大规模”军事行动是由于沙特阿拉伯对“我们亲爱的人民”的“公然侵略”。 萨雷亚还表示，胡塞武装已将“沙特敌方”部队驱逐出塔伊兹和荷台达地区的六个地区，并声称有数百名士兵被杀、受伤或被俘。 佩里姆岛位于曼德海峡最狭窄的地方，随着美国和伊朗冲突中另一条重要水道霍尔木兹海峡的有效关闭，曼德海峡变得越来越重要。 沙特阿拉伯一直依靠红海和曼德海峡向亚洲客户运输石油。 胡塞武装、也门政府和沙特之间的冲突升级，导致油价飙升。 据报道，自胡塞武装一周前在西南部发动攻势以来，已有数百人丧生，数千人流离失所。 沙特领导的联军还对也门西部胡塞武装控制的地区进行了空袭，以支持亲政府部队，胡塞武装还向城市发射了导弹和无人机……

reflection.en: The ongoing conflict in Yemen, with the Houthis tightening their grip on the vital Bab al-Mandab Strait, illustrates a persistent global struggle. Psalm 46:9 speaks to the deep human yearning for an end to such strife, reminding us that ultimately, Yahweh is the one who brings wars to a halt. May we pray for the cessation of hostilities and the restoration...
reflection.zh: 也门冲突持续不断，胡塞武装收紧了对至关重要的曼德海峡的控制，这凸显了全球持续不断的斗争。诗篇 46:9 呼应了人类对结束此类冲突的深切渴望，提醒我们最终是雅伟结束战争。愿我们为该地区的停火和和平恢复祈祷。

verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: How global trade and oil prices could be hit by Houthi advance
title.zh: 胡塞武装推进可能如何影响全球贸易和油价

summary.en: Yemen's Houthis have seized territory near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a vital chokepoint for global shipping and oil transport, raising concerns about potential impacts on international trade and oil prices.
summary.zh: 也门的胡塞武装已占领了靠近曼德海峡的地区，该海峡是全球航运和石油运输的重要通道，引发了对国际贸易和油价可能受到影响的担忧。

body.en:
Fighters from the Iran-backed Houthi group have seized territory close to the Bab al-Mandab Strait in the Red Sea - a key trade gateway that links Asia and Europe.

Houthis have said they pose no threat to international shipping but have reiterated their intention to target vessels from Saudi Arabia.

Saudi Arabia has increasingly relied on the Red Sea for oil exports since the US and Israel's war effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz.

At least 46,000 people have been displaced in Yemen since fighting escalated last week, according to the United Nations.
body.zh: 伊朗支持的胡塞武装武装分子占领了红海曼德海峡附近的领土——这是连接亚洲和欧洲的重要贸易门户。 胡塞武装表示，他们对国际航运不构成威胁，但重申他们打算瞄准来自沙特阿拉伯的船只。 自美国和以色列的战争有效关闭霍尔木兹海峡以来，沙特阿拉伯越来越依赖红海的石油出口。 据联合国称，自上周战斗升级以来，也门至少有 46,000 人流离失所。

reflection.en: The seizure of territory near the Bab al-Mandab Strait by the Houthis creates significant uncertainty for global trade and oil prices. This strategic location's instability underscores the profound human cost of conflict, impacting economies far beyond the immediate region. May we pray for a swift resolution that brings peace and stability to this vital...
reflection.zh: 胡塞武装占领曼德海峡附近地区，给全球贸易和油价带来了巨大的不确定性。这个战略要地的动荡凸显了冲突对人类深远的代价，其影响远远超出当地经济。愿我们祈求冲突能迅速得到解决，为这条重要的水道带来和平与稳定。

title.en: Norway's Princess Astrid dies two days after attending brother King Harald's funeral
title.zh: 挪威阿斯特丽德公主在哥哥国王哈拉尔葬礼两天后去世

summary.en: Princess Astrid of Norway, sister of the late King Harald V, has died at the age of 94, two days after attending his funeral. The new king, Haakon VIII, praised her for representing the Royal House in a warm and dutiful manner throughout her life. Her funeral will be a state expense.
summary.zh: 挪威阿斯特丽德公主，已故国王哈拉尔五世的妹妹，于94岁去世，此前两天她刚参加了哥哥的葬礼。新国王哈康八世称赞她一生中以温暖而尽责的方式代表了王室。她的葬礼将由国家承担费用。

body.en:
Princess Astrid of Norway, the sister of the late King Harald V, has died at the age of 94, two days after attending his funeral, the country's royal palace has announced.

The new king, Haakon VIII, said that "throughout her long life, Princess Astrid represented the Royal House in a warm and dutiful manner".

Harald died last month, aged 89, after more than 35 years as king. His funeral was Astrid's last public engagement.

The princess will be buried at state expense and flags will be flown at half-mast across Norway, Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre said.

Astrid was the last surviving child of King Olav V, who reigned from 1957 to 1991.

She became Norway's first lady at the age of 22 in 1954, after the death of her mother Crown Princess Märtha. Olav did not remarry and Astrid retained the title until her brother's marriage in 1968.

"In her work, Princess Astrid was always particularly concerned with care and inclusion for the most vulnerable in society," her nephew King Haakon said in his statement.

Her health had deteriorated in recent months and in March she received hospital treatment for pneumonia.

Dozens of European royals and heads of state attended Harald's funeral on Wednesday, including the Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings.

Thousands of people lined the route during a procession from the royal palace to Oslo Cathedral on Wednesday afternoon.

The non-royal leaders paying their respects included Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier and five foreign prime ministers.

In the final months of Harald's life, Norway's royal family faced personal challenges and scandal.

Earlier this year, documents revealed that King Haakon's wife, Queen Mette-Marit, had had frequent contact with US sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. She later said she wished she had never met the late disgraced financier.

Meanwhile, her son from a previous relationship, Marius Borg Høiby - who is not a royal but grew up within the family - was given a four-year jail term for two counts of rape in June.

Høiby, who is under house arrest pending appeal, was granted permission to attend the funeral.
body.zh: 挪威王宫宣布，已故国王哈拉尔五世的妹妹、挪威公主阿斯特丽德在参加葬礼两天后去世，享年 94 岁。 新国王哈康八世表示，“在她漫长的一生中，阿斯特丽德公主以热情和尽职的方式代表着王室”。 哈拉尔德上个月去世，享年 89 岁，他担任国王已超过 35 年。他的葬礼是阿斯特丽德最后一次公开参加。 挪威首相乔纳斯·加尔·斯托尔表示，公主的下葬将由国家出资，挪威全国将下半旗志哀。 阿斯特丽德是奥拉夫五世国王最后一个幸存的孩子，奥拉夫五世于 1957 年至 1991 年在位。 1954 年，她的母亲玛莎王储妃去世后，22 岁的她成为挪威第一夫人。奥拉夫没有再婚，阿斯特丽德保留了这个头衔，直到 1968 年她哥哥结婚为止。 她的侄子哈康国王在声明中说：“在她的工作中，阿斯特丽德公主总是特别关心社会上最弱势群体的照顾和包容。” 近几个月来，她的健康状况恶化，三月份她因肺炎接受了住院治疗。 周三，数十名欧洲王室成员和国家元首参加了哈拉尔的葬礼，其中包括威尔士亲王和三位北欧国王。 周三下午，数千人在从皇宫到奥斯陆大教堂的游行队伍中排队。 前来吊唁的非王室领导人包括乌克兰总统泽连斯基、德国总统施泰因迈尔和五位外国总理。 在哈拉尔生命的最后几个月，挪威王室面临着个人挑战和丑闻。 今年早些时候，文件显示哈康国王的妻子梅特-玛丽特王后曾与美国性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦有频繁接触。她后来说，她希望自己从未见过这位已故的名誉扫地的金融家。 与此同时，她前一段感情的儿子马吕斯·博格·霍伊比(Marius Borg Høiby)——不是王室成员，但在这个家庭中长大——在六月因两项强奸罪被判处四年监禁。 霍伊比被软禁等待上诉，但获准参加葬礼。

reflection.en: Princess Astrid's passing, so soon after mourning her brother, King Harald, underscores the profound reality of human mortality. Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that death is a universal appointment, a natural end to our earthly journey. May her life of service and her final days of family remembrance offer comfort and perspective.
reflection.zh: 阿斯特丽德公主的离世，紧随她哀悼哥哥哈拉尔国王之后，凸显了人类生命终有一死的深刻现实。希伯来书9:27提醒我们，死亡是每个人都会面对的定数，是我们尘世旅程的自然终点。愿她一生服侍的生涯以及她生命最后时刻的家庭追思，能带来安慰和省思。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
title.zh: 以色列称已摧毁真主党主要地下基地

summary.en: Israel's military announced it has destroyed a significant underground complex belonging to Hezbollah in southern Lebanon, using over 1,000 tonnes of explosives to demolish tunnels spanning more than 2km. The resulting blast caused seismic activity equivalent to a magnitude 4.1 earthquake. Hezbollah and the Lebanese...
summary.zh: 以色列军方宣布已摧毁真主党在黎巴嫩南部的一个重要地下基地，使用了超过1000吨炸药摧毁了绵延2公里以上的隧道。爆炸引发了相当于里氏4.1级地震的地震活动。真主党和黎巴嫩政府尚未公开回应。

body.en:
Israel's military says it has destroyed a large underground complex operated by Hezbollah in southern Lebanon.

It said it used more than 1,000 tonnes of explosives to destroy two tunnels spanning more than 2km (1.2 miles) beneath the Ali Taher Ridge.

The blast triggered seismic activity equivalent to a magnitude 4.1 earthquake, according to the US Geological Survey.

There was no immediate public response from Hezbollah or the Lebanese government.

Israeli forces took control of the ridge last week after months of fighting with the Iran-backed group there. The Israeli military occupies a large swathe of southern Lebanon captured after the conflict with Hezbollah resumed in March.

Images released by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) showed a fireball lighting up the sky.

"The sky lit up and about 15 seconds later we heard the terrifying sound," Ahamed, a resident in Nabatieh, about 6km west of the ridge, told the BBC.

He said people were screaming and children were crying, and that cars filled the roads as people left the area for Beirut.

The IDF said the underground infrastructure included a command centre used by Hezbollah's Badr unit and contained dozens of rockets, missiles and unmanned aerial vehicles, as well as anti-tank weapons, mines and explosives.

"This was strategic infrastructure that was constructed over two decades, funded and planned by the Iranian terror regime," the IDF said in a statement on Telegram.

"All of the terrorists who were inside the infrastructure were eliminated or fled."

The IDF said the destruction of the complex completed a mission to destroy eight tunnels and establish a "security zone" in the area.

The latest action comes amid renewed fighting in southern Lebanon, where Israeli forces have expanded operations against Hezbollah positions and continue to hold what Israel describes as a security zone near the border.

Lebanese media reported fresh Israeli strikes elsewhere in the south on Thursday, including Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Mansouri in the Tyre district.

The Lebanese army has increased deployments in areas outside Israeli control, including the southern city of Nabatieh, in efforts to strengthen stability and reassure residents, local television station MTV reported.

Lebanon was drawn into the war between Israel, the US and Iran on 2 March, when Hezbollah launched rockets into Israel in retaliation for a strike that killed Iran's supreme leader.

Israel responded by launching a bombing campaign across Lebanon and invading a significant part of the country's south. Its forces continue to occupy roughly 5% of Lebanese territory.

Fighting decreased following a ceasefire deal between Iran and the US in June, alongside a separate agreement between Lebanon and Israel.

body.zh: 以色列军方表示，它摧毁了真主党在黎巴嫩南部运营的一个大型地下建筑群。 该公司表示，使用了超过 1,000 吨炸药摧毁了阿里塔赫尔山脊下方两条横跨 2 公里（1.2 英里）的隧道。 据美国地质调查局称，爆炸引发的地震活动相当于 4.1 级地震。 真主党或黎巴嫩政府没有立即公开回应。 以色列军队在与伊朗支持的组织进行数月战斗后，于上周控制了该山脊。以色列军队占领了黎巴嫩南部的大片地区，这些地区是在三月份与真主党的冲突重新爆发后占领的。 以色列国防军（IDF）发布的图像显示，火球照亮了天空。 “天空亮了起来，大约 15 秒后我们听到了可怕的声音，”纳巴蒂耶 (Nabatieh) 的居民艾哈迈德 (Ahamed) 告诉 BBC，纳巴蒂耶位于山脊以西约 6 公里处。 他说，人们在尖叫，孩子们在哭泣，当人们离开该地区前往贝鲁特时，汽车挤满了道路。 以色列国防军表示，地下基础设施包括真主党巴德尔部队使用的指挥中心，内有数十枚火箭、导弹和无人机，以及反坦克武器、地雷和爆炸物。 以色列国防军在 Telegram 上的一份声明中表示：“这是由伊朗恐怖政权资助和规划的、二十年来建造的战略基础设施。” “基础设施内的所有恐怖分子都被消灭或逃跑。” 以色列国防军表示，摧毁该建筑群完成了摧毁八条隧道并在该地区建立“安全区”的任务。 最新行动发生在黎巴嫩南部重新爆发战斗之际，以色列军队扩大了针对真主党阵地的行动，并继续占领以色列所说的边境附近的安全区。 黎巴嫩媒体周四报道称，以色列在南部其他地方发动了新的袭击，其中包括蒂尔地区的纳巴蒂耶·福卡和曼苏里。 据当地电视台 MTV 报道，黎巴嫩军队增加了在以色列控制之外地区的部署，包括南部城市纳巴蒂耶，以加强稳定并安抚居民。 3 月 2 日，黎巴嫩卷入以色列、美国和伊朗之间的战争，当时真主党向以色列发射火箭，以报复杀害伊朗最高领导人的袭击。 作为回应，以色列在黎巴嫩各地发动了轰炸，并入侵了该国南部的大部分地区。其部队继续占领约 5% 的黎巴嫩领土。 六月份伊朗和美国达成停火协议以及黎巴嫩和以色列之间达成单独协议后，战斗有所减少。虽然数十万人...

reflection.en: The immense power unleashed in the destruction of this Hezbollah base, measured by seismic activity, underscores the devastating scale of modern conflict. In the midst of such destruction, we are reminded of the divine promise to ultimately bring an end to all warfare, turning weapons of destruction into tools for peace.
reflection.zh: 在摧毁真主党基地时释放出的巨大力量，其规模甚至被地震活动所衡量，这凸显了现代冲突的毁灭性。在如此巨大的破坏中，我们被提醒了神最终将终结一切战争的应许，并将毁灭的武器转化为和平的工具。

title.en: Iran pursues cautious escalation ahead of US midterms
title.zh: 伊朗在中期选举前寻求谨慎升级

summary.en: Tehran appears to be increasing pressure on Washington ahead of the crucial US midterm elections, but it shows little inclination to return to a full-scale war.
summary.zh: 在关键的美国中期选举前，德黑兰似乎正在加大对华盛顿的压力，但其并无意愿重回全面战争。

body.en:
Tehran appears to be boosting pressure on Washington ahead of the crucial midterm vote, but shows little desire to return to a full-scale war.

The war with Iran "is going to end immediately after the [US midterm] election because they can't hold out any longer," US President Donald Trump said of Iran's leaders on Wednesday. 

Speaking at the Republican midterm convention,  the first such event to be held at a massive arena in Dallas, Texas, Trump described the November 3 vote as "one of the most important elections of your lives," and once again defended the war against Iran.

The US president restated his argument that he had launched the attacks to prevent Tehran from developing a nuclear weapon. He also promised that oil prices would fall as soon as the US had won the war.

But even if Trump's promises are taken at face value, rising gas prices are sure to hurt Republicans' electoral prospects in the midterms .

On Wednesday, Brent crude — the global benchmark for prices — jumped to over $100 (€86) per barrel. The fighting escalated again this week, with the US striking Iranian oil tankers in retaliation for Iran's targeting of a US warship.

"Iran still appears to see escalation primarily as a controlled instrument of coercive bargaining, rather than as an end in itself," said Mohammad Ghaedi, a Middle East expert and professor at the Department of Political Science at George Washington University.

"Iran is trying to impose costs on the United States without raising those costs so dramatically that Washington feels compelled to return to full-scale war," he explained.

"That helps explain why the number of missiles fired at US naval vessels has remained relatively limited."

The regime wants to demonstrate that it can threaten US forces and disrupt the maritime traffic in the region, the expert said, "but it also wants to keep the confrontation below a threshold that could trigger a much larger American response."

Tehran's preferred outcome would be a return to the Memorandum of Understanding signed in Islamabad in June , Ghaedi said, referring to a preliminary deal that paused the full-scale conflict. 

At the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in late August, Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian reiterated that, if the United States returns to the memorandum, Iran would return as well.

Ghaedi said the first provision of the memorandum presents a major obstacle, as it requires an Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon — "something Tehran sees as unlikely before Israel's elections."

body.zh: 在关键的中期投票之前，德黑兰似乎正在加大对华盛顿的压力，但并没有表现出重返全面战争的意愿。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周三在谈到伊朗领导人时表示，与伊朗的战争“将在[美国中期]选举后立即结束，因为他们无法再坚持下去了”。 共和党中期代表大会是首次在德克萨斯州达拉斯的大型舞台上举行的此类活动，特朗普在会上发表讲话，称 11 月 7 日的投票是“你们一生中最重要的选举之一”，并再次为针对伊朗的战争辩护。 美国总统重申了他的论点，即他发动袭击是为了阻止德黑兰发展核武器。他还承诺，一旦美国赢得战争，油价就会下跌。 但即使特朗普的承诺得到了兑现，油价上涨也肯定会损害共和党在中期选举中的选举前景。 周三，全球价格基准布伦特原油价格跃升至每桶 100 美元以上（86 欧元）。本周，战斗再次升级，美国袭击了伊朗油轮，以报复伊朗袭击美国军舰。 中东问题专家、乔治华盛顿大学政治学系教授穆罕默德·盖迪表示：“伊朗似乎仍然主要将升级视为强制谈判的受控工具，而不是其本身。” 他解释说：“伊朗试图让美国付出代价，但又不想让这些代价大幅增加，以致华盛顿感到有必要重返全面战争。” “这有助于解释为什么向美国海军舰艇发射的导弹数量仍然相对有限。” 专家表示，该政权希望证明它可以威胁美军并扰乱该地区的海上交通，“但它也希望将对抗控制在可能引发美国更大规模反应的阈值以下。” 加迪表示，德黑兰最希望的结果是恢复六月份在伊斯兰堡签署的谅解备忘录，他指的是一项暂停全面冲突的初步协议。 在八月下旬的上海合作组织峰会上，伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安重申，如果美国返回该备忘录，伊朗也会返回。 加迪表示，备忘录的第一条规定是一个主要障碍，因为它要求以色列从黎巴嫩撤军——“德黑兰认为在以色列选举之前这是不可能的”。 以色列将于 10 月 27 日投票选举新议会，就在美国即将举行中期投票的几天前。 在德黑兰，许多人认为冲突的决定性转折点......

reflection.en: As geopolitical tensions rise ahead of the US midterm elections, Iran is reportedly increasing pressure on Washington. This situation highlights the delicate balance between asserting influence and avoiding full-scale conflict. The call to live peaceably with all, as much as it depends on us, is a constant challenge in international relations.
reflection.zh: 在美国中期选举前地缘政治紧张局势加剧之际，据报道伊朗正在加大对华盛顿的压力。这种情况凸显了施加影响与避免全面冲突之间的微妙平衡。‘尽力而为，与众人和睦’的呼吁在国际关系中是一个持续的挑战。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: India's BRICS strategy tested with Xi, Putin set to visit
title.zh: 印度在金砖国家战略中面临考验，因习近平和普京将访问印度

summary.en: India's foreign policy strategy, termed "America Plus," involves strengthening relationships with China and Russia while simultaneously attempting to prevent the BRICS bloc from becoming an anti-Western alliance. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to host the BRICS summit in New Delhi, which will include Chinese...
summary.zh: 印度奉行的“美国优先”外交战略，旨在深化与中国和俄罗斯的关系，同时努力阻止金砖国家集团成为反西方联盟。印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪将主办本周末在新德里举行的金砖国家峰会，中国国家主席习近平将自2019年以来首次访问印度。此次峰会正值印度担任金砖国家轮值主席国即将结束之际，其与华盛顿的关系依然紧张。

body.en:
New Delhi's "America Plus" approach sees India deepening its ties with China and Russia, while also trying to keep BRICS from turning into an anti-Western platform.

India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi will host the 18th BRICS summit this weekend in New Delhi, welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping to India for the first time since 2019.   

The summit comes at an important moment for India . As New Delhi's year-long BRICS presidency draws to a close, India is stepping up engagement with China and Russia , and its relationship with Washington remains difficult .

Modi met both Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, on August 31 and September 1. Just two weeks later, Modi is set to see them again in New Delhi for the BRICS summit.

But with BRICS both growing in size and increasingly troubled by internal divisions, the forum might limit Modi's diplomatic gains.

Indian diplomats are trying to protect their room for maneuver in a changing international order.

Ashok Kantha, a former Indian ambassador to China, said India's engagement with BRICS and the SCO is part of New Delhi's longstanding strategy of strategic autonomy.

"These groupings give India a seat at the table and allow it to pursue its own interests while maintaining relationships with different major powers," Kantha told DW.

However, as Modi prepares to host Xi in New Delhi, ties between India and China are less than ideal .

Both countries reached a border patrol agreement in 2024, ending a four-year military standoff along their disputed frontier.

International flights have resumed, the Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage has reopened and some visa restrictions have eased. But major problems remain between Beijing and New Delhi — India is reporting a trade deficit of over $112 billion (€96.5 billion) with China, and the two countries argue over market access.

The Modi-Xi meeting will therefore be watched for signs of a major diplomatic thaw, particularly on trade and investment.

Kantha said the visit could bring some stabilization but should not be mistaken for a reset.

"The border remains heavily militarized and major differences over trade, investment and security remain. India needs a stable and predictable relationship with China, but without lowering its guard," said Kantha.

"It is a relationship of armed coexistence and managed competition. We should not reduce it to a simple 'elephant and dragon' story," he said, referring to traditional symbols of the world's two most populous nations.

India's presidency has already exposed the difficulty of reaching agreement within BRICS, which has grown from its original five members to 11.

With nations such as Brazil, South Africa, Indonesia and...
body.zh: 新德里的“美国+”方针让印度加深了与中国和俄罗斯的关系，同时也试图阻止金砖国家变成一个反西方的平台。 印度总理莫迪将于本周末在新德里主办金砖国家领导人第十八次峰会，欢迎中国国家主席习近平自 2019 年以来首次访问印度。 此次峰会对印度来说正值重要时刻。随着新德里为期一年的金砖国家轮值主席国任期接近尾声，印度正在加强与中国和俄罗斯的接触，其与华盛顿的关系仍然困难。 莫迪于8月31日和9月1日在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会上会见了习近平和俄罗斯总统普京。仅仅两周后，莫迪将在新德里出席金砖国家峰会时再次会见他们。 但随着金砖国家规模不断扩大，内部分歧日益困扰，该论坛可能会限制莫迪的外交成果。 印度外交官正试图在不断变化的国际秩序中保护自己的回旋余地。 印度前驻华大使阿肖克·坎塔表示，印度与金砖国家和上合组织的接触是新德里长期战略自主战略的一部分。 坎塔对德国之声表示：“这些组织让印度在谈判桌上占有一席之地，并使其能够在与不同大国保持关系的同时追求自身利益。” 然而，当莫迪准备在新德里接待习近平时，印度和中国之间的关系并不理想。 两国于 2024 年达成边境巡逻协议，结束了两国争议边境长达四年的军事对峙。 国际航班已恢复，神山朝圣活动已重新开放，一些签证限制也已放宽。但北京和新德里之间仍存在重大问题——印度报告的对华贸易逆差超过1120亿美元（965亿欧元），两国在市场准入问题上存在争议。 因此，莫迪与习近平的会晤将受到重大外交解冻的迹象，特别是在贸易和投资方面。 坎塔表示，这次访问可能会带来一些稳定，但不应被误认为是重置。 坎塔表示：“边境仍然高度军事化，贸易、投资和安全方面的重大分歧依然存在。印度需要与中国建立稳定和可预测的关系，但又不能放松警惕。” “这是一种武装共存和有管理的竞争的关系。我们不应将其简化为一个简单的‘象与龙’故事，”他说，他指的是世界上人口最多的两个国家的传统象征。 印度担任轮值主席国已经暴露了金砖国家内部达成协议的难度，金砖国家成员已从最初的5个增加到11个。 与巴西、南非、印度尼西亚等国家...

reflection.en: India's diplomatic balancing act, hosting leaders from China and Russia while navigating complex global politics, underscores the challenge of pursuing peace amidst competing interests. The Apostle Paul's counsel to "live in peace with everyone" calls for wisdom and intentionality in managing relationships, even when they are fraught with tension.
reflection.zh: 印度在外交上寻求平衡，一方面接待中国和俄罗斯领导人，另一方面又要在复杂的全球政治中周旋，这凸显了在利益冲突中寻求和平的挑战。使徒保罗劝勉我们要“尽力与众人和睦”，这呼吁我们在处理关系时，即使充满紧张，也要有智慧和意图。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Uber leaves two key African markets — and their drivers in despair
title.zh: 优步退出非洲两大市场——留下绝望的司机

summary.en: Uber has announced its immediate departure from Nigeria and Uganda, leaving customers inconvenienced. More significantly, drivers in these markets are facing despair as rising fuel and operating costs make it difficult to earn a living, especially after the company's exit.
summary.zh: 优步已宣布立即退出尼日利亚和乌干达市场，给客户带来不便。更重要的是，这两个市场的司机正面临绝望，因为燃料和运营成本的上涨使他们难以维持生计，尤其是在公司退出之后。

body.en:
Uber's departure from Nigeria and Uganda has left countless customers high and dry. But what about drivers? With fuel prices, maintenance and other operating costs rising, many say they're struggling to make a living.

A week ago, Uber unexpectedly announced its departure from the Nigerian market after spending over a decade building up its presence in Africa's most populous country. The ride-hailing platform also said it would be winding up its operations in Uganda — also with immediate effect.

With the exit from both Nigeria and Uganda , Uber now remains operational only in a handful of African countries — namely Egypt, Ghana, Kenya, and South Africa.

"This decision is limited strictly to these two markets and does not impact our operations across the rest of the continent," Uber said in a statement, adding that their "immediate priority is supporting drivers, riders, and local team members throughout this transition," without sharing details on what this assistance would entail.

In the last year, the multinational company also closed shop in Ivory Coast and Tanzania, while also cutting its global workforce by 10%.

Uber has not managed to grow across much of the African market despite its massive global scale. The profit-driven ride-hailing app faces stiff competition from rival platforms, including Bolt, inDrive and SafeBoda, which operate in the Nigerian and Ugandan markets and beyond.

Many of its drivers across Africa have been raising complaints about shrinking profit margins amid rising fuel costs, inflation and currency volatility, especially in markets like Nigeria.

In their view, Uber's business model of pocketing around 20 — 25% of any trip fare in commissions is no longer tenable.

Abbas Olamide, an Uber driver in the Nigerian capital Abuja, said the company's overall service was "good," while firmly stressing that the high commission rates were adding greatly to his existing woes .

He told DW that a ride of 30,000 Naira (€ 20) "to the airport means the ride-hailing app would deduct 6,000 Naira as commission," still leaving him to "then pay a gate fee at the airport."

"Probably because you do not want to go back to town empty-handed, we also pay to park at the airport [to pick up another client]," he explained.

Samuel Olatunji, an Uber-driver in the megacity Lagos, also shared his concerns with DW following the abrupt announcement of Uber's exit, saying he will now have to recalibrate his own business model.

The 43-year-old driver says he'll have to join hundreds of other drivers who "have to depend on other [ride-hailing] apps now" to ensure any steady stream of income.

In recent years, drivers like Olamide and Olatunji have staged several strikes and protests over soaring operating costs, low fares and working...
body.zh: Uber退出尼日利亚和乌干达让无数客户陷入困境。但司机呢？随着燃料价格、维护和其他运营成本的上涨，许多人表示他们正在为生计而苦苦挣扎。 一周前，优步出人意料地宣布退出尼日利亚市场，此前该公司花了十多年时间在非洲人口最多的国家建立了业务。该叫车平台还表示，将结束在乌干达的业务，并立即生效。 随着尼日利亚和乌干达的退出，优步现在仅在少数非洲国家继续运营，即埃及、加纳、肯尼亚和南非。 优步在一份声明中表示：“这一决定严格限于这两个市场，不会影响我们在非洲大陆其他地区的运营。”并补充说，他们的“当务之急是在整个过渡过程中为司机、乘客和当地团队成员提供支持”，但没有透露这项援助所需的详细信息。 去年，这家跨国公司还关闭了在科特迪瓦和坦桑尼亚的工厂，同时还削减了 10% 的全球员工队伍。 尽管优步在全球规模庞大，但未能在非洲大部分市场实现增长。这款以利润为导向的叫车应用程序面临着来自竞争对手平台的激烈竞争，包括在尼日利亚和乌干达等市场运营的 Bolt、inDrive 和 SafeBoda。 非洲各地的许多司机一直抱怨燃料成本上涨、通货膨胀和货币波动导致利润率下降，特别是在尼日利亚等市场。 在他们看来，Uber 将出行费用的 20% 至 25% 左右作为佣金的商业模式已经站不住脚了。 尼日利亚首都阿布贾的优步司机阿巴斯·奥拉米德表示，该公司的整体服务“良好”，同时坚定地强调，高额佣金大大加剧了他现有的困境。 他告诉德国之声，前往机场的乘车费用为 30,000 奈拉（20 欧元），“意味着乘车应用程序将扣除 6,000 奈拉作为佣金”，但他仍然“需要在机场支付登机费”。 “可能是因为你不想空手回城，我们还支付在机场停车的费用（以接另一位客户），”他解释道。 在Uber突然宣布退出后，特大城市拉各斯的Uber司机塞缪尔·奥拉通吉(Samuel Olatunji)也向德国之声表达了他的担忧，称他现在必须重新调整自己的商业模式。 这位 43 岁的司机表示，他将不得不加入数百名其他司机的行列，“现在必须依赖其他[叫车]应用程序”来确保稳定的收入来源。 近年来，像奥拉米德和奥拉通吉这样的司机因运营成本飙升、票价低廉和工作压力而多次举行罢工和抗议……

reflection.en: The departure of Uber from Nigeria and Uganda leaves many drivers in a precarious position. As operating costs rise and the platform withdraws, their struggle to earn a fair wage echoes the ancient cry of exploited workers. May we remember those whose labor is undervalued and whose livelihoods are disrupted by corporate decisions.
reflection.zh: 优步退出尼日利亚和乌干达，使许多司机陷入困境。随着运营成本的上升和平台的撤离，他们为获得公平报酬而进行的斗争，呼应了古代被剥削工人的呐喊。愿我们铭记那些劳动被低估、生计因企业决策而中断的人们。

verse.textEn: Look! The wages you failed to pay the workers who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of Yahweh Almighty.
verse.textZh: 工人给你们收割庄稼，你们亏欠他们的工钱，这工钱有声音呼叫，并且那收割之人的冤声已经入了万军之主的耳了。

title.en: Iran war: Saudi-Houthi escalation intensifies Yemen conflict
title.zh: 伊朗战争：沙特与胡塞武装升级加剧也门冲突

summary.en: The Houthi group's capture of Mokha, Dhubab, and Perim in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait risks drawing Yemen further into the Middle East conflict. The Iran-backed Houthis have made advances against Yemen's government and Saudi Arabia, escalating fighting with missile and drone exchanges.
summary.zh: 胡塞武装占领曼德海峡的摩卡、朱巴卜和佩里姆，可能将也门更深地卷入中东战争。受伊朗支持的胡塞武装在也门政府和沙特阿拉伯方面取得了进展，双方的导弹和无人机袭击加剧了冲突。

body.en:
The Houthi takeovers of Mokha, Dhubab and Perim in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait threaten to push Yemen deeper into the Middle East war. The Iran-backed group has made advances against Yemen's government and Saudi Arabia.

Fighting between the Houthi militia and Yemen's internationally recognized government  escalated  further this week as the Iran-backed group seized territory and exchanged missile and drone attacks with Saudi Arabia.

On Thursday, the Houthis  seized the port city of Mokha and by Friday had taken control of the town of Dhubab and the island of Perim, Yemeni government sources told the news agency Reuters.  Mokha, Dhubab and Perim had been held by forces aligned with Yemen's government. All three are strategically located near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden.

With Iran having blockaded the nearby Strait of Hormuz , the narrow Bab el-Mandeb Strait has become increasingly important as an alternative route for Saudi oil exports. As the Houthis are aligned with Iran, control of and potential attacks on shipping through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait gives Iran additional leverage in its war with the United States.

The government-aligned National Resistance Forces announced on Thursday that troops were reorganizing and consolidating their defenses in Mokha in coordination with other anti-Houthi forces.

The conflict  has also spilled into Saudi Arabia, a close US ally and regional rival of Iran's. This week, the Houthis launched dozens of ballistic missiles and drones at four cities in Saudi Arabia. The Houthis said Saudi Arabia responded with dozens of airstrikes across four Yemeni provinces.

"This is actually a full-scale war," Farea Al-Muslimi, a Yemen researcher at the London-based think tank Chatham House, told DW. "It hasn't been given that name yet but we are marching there full time," Al-Muslimi said.

The latest escalation, which started in July, ended a period of relative calm after years of war. A Saudi-led coalition intervened to support Yemen's government in 2015 following the 2014 Houthi insurgency. The war between the Houthis — which the United States redesignated as a foreign terrorist organization in March 2025 — and the Saudi-backed government ended in 2022 with a UN-brokered truce. However, the country remains de facto split.

The Houthis control Yemen's capital, Sanaa, and most of the country's north, as well as parts of the center, and now also much of the western coastal stretch, including Mokha, Dhubab and Perim. The internationally recognized government, represented by the Presidential Leadership Council, is based in Aden. Many senior officials operate from Saudi Arabia. body.zh: 胡塞武装占领曼德海峡的莫卡、杜巴布和佩里姆，有可能将也门进一步卷入中东战争。该伊朗支持的组织已对也门政府和沙特阿拉伯取得进展。 胡塞民兵与国际公认的也门政府之间的战斗本周进一步升级，伊朗支持的组织夺取了领土，并与沙特阿拉伯进行了导弹和无人机袭击。 也门政府消息人士告诉路透社，胡塞武装周四占领了港口城市莫卡，周五控制了杜巴布镇和佩里姆岛。 莫卡、杜巴布和佩里姆已被与也门政府结盟的部队控制。这三个海峡都位于连接红海和亚丁湾的曼德海峡附近，地理位置优越。 随着伊朗封锁附近的霍尔木兹海峡，狭窄的曼德海峡作为沙特石油出口的替代路线变得越来越重要。由于胡塞武装与伊朗结盟，对曼德海峡航运的控制和潜在的攻击使伊朗在与美国的战争中获得了额外的筹码。 与政府结盟的国家抵抗军周四宣布，部队正在与其他反胡塞武装协调，重组和巩固莫卡的防御。 这场冲突还蔓延到了沙特阿拉伯，它是美国的亲密盟友，也是伊朗的地区竞争对手。本周，胡塞武装向沙特阿拉伯的四个城市发射了数十枚弹道导弹和无人机。胡塞武装表示，沙特阿拉伯对也门四个省份进行了数十次空袭作为回应。 伦敦智库查塔姆研究所的也门研究员法雷亚·穆斯利米（Farea Al-Muslimi）告诉德国之声：“这实际上是一场全面战争。” “它还没有被命名，但我们正在全力前往那里，”穆斯利米说。 最近的升级始于七月，结束了多年战争后的一段相对平静的时期。 继 2014 年胡塞叛乱之后，沙特领导的联盟于 2015 年进行干预，支持也门政府。胡塞武装（美国于 2025 年 3 月将其重新定性为外国恐怖组织）与沙特支持的政府之间的战争于 2022 年在联合国斡旋下停战。然而，该国事实上仍然处于分裂状态。 胡塞武装控制也门首都萨那、该国北部大部分地区以及中部部分地区，现在还控制着西部沿海地区的大部分地区，包括莫卡、杜巴布和佩里姆。由总统领导委员会代表的国际公认的政府设在亚丁。许多高级官员在沙特阿拉伯办公。政府结盟部队控制了南部部分地区并......

reflection.en: The relentless cycle of conflict in Yemen, marked by territorial gains and escalating attacks, highlights the deep human yearning for peace. Psalm 46:9 speaks of Yahweh's ultimate power to end warfare and disarm the instruments of destruction, offering a vision of hope beyond the present devastation.
reflection.zh: 也门冲突的无情循环，以领土扩张和不断升级的袭击为标志，凸显了人类对和平的深切渴望。诗篇46:9篇讲述了雅伟最终有能力结束战争、解除毁灭的武器，在当前的破坏之外，提供了一个充满希望的景象。

title.en: A 16-hour flight, 100,000 fans and an upset: The NFL makes its Australian debut
title.zh: 一场16小时的飞行，10万粉丝和一场意外：NFL首次亮相澳大利亚

summary.en: For some Americans, the long trek to see their teams clash on the other side of the world was well worth the journey.
summary.zh: 对于一些美国人来说，长途跋涉到世界的另一边观看他们支持的球队比赛是值得的。

body.en:
More than 100,000 fans from across Australia and abroad flooded the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) on Friday to watch the San Francisco 49ers thrash the Los Angeles Rams 27-7 in the NFL's first-ever regular-season game in Australia.

With the match kicking off at 10am to line up with US prime time, one Rams fan at the MCG described it as the earliest he'd ever been up for a game.

"The atmosphere, I love it, but it's kind of quiet," he told SBS News. "You know, back home it would usually be a bit crazier, with both teams going at it."

Another fan was adding Melbourne to a list of 43 overseas stadiums he'd visited. His white jersey was embroidered with patches representing each country, with a small green patch featuring a cluster of koalas to represent Melbourne on the bottom left.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I've been to every stadium in the world where the NFL plays," he told SBS News. "It's my first time in Australia, and I love it, everyone is so nice and inviting and helpful."

"I flew all the way in from Miami, Florida, two days ago, and I'm going home tonight. I just came to witness this amazing stadium and the great people of Melbourne."

Friday's game was the first of a four-year deal between Australia and the NFL , but with no guarantee a game will be played here every year, thousands of overseas fans made the pilgrimage.

A sea of red, white, blue and yellow filled the MCG, with a sold-out crowd of 100,022 fans, including thousands of visitors from the US. Almost half of spectators were expected to be from interstate or overseas, according to the state government.

Los Angeles resident Nancy Gakere took advantage of the opportunity for a holiday, stopping over in Fiji on the way to and from Melbourne to break up what could have been a 16-hour direct flight.

She said the journey was more than worth it, especially as the 49ers, pegged as the underdogs, pulled off a surprise rout.

"Everything was just great; honestly, we couldn't have planned it any better," she told SBS News.

"When this away game happened to be in Australia, we thought, why not? And we booked the trip as soon as tickets came out in April, so we have been excited about it for a while."

"And being 49ers fans, we were not the favourites, so we came in with low expectations, and winning was a nice surprise."

Gakere said that staying in Brunswick, in Melbourne's north, had made the trip economical.

"Other than the Uber from the airport, we have just been taking the tram in and out of the city to sight-see, trying food, the bars, walking around and exploring," she told SBS News. "And we went to the Great Ocean Road, which was our main tourism activity."

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.

title.en: 'A day that changed the world': 25 years on, Australia remembers 9/11
title.zh: “改变世界的一天”：澳大利亚纪念9/11事件25周年

summary.en: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese stated that the best of humanity was evident amidst the horror, while the Opposition leader called for a 'reckoning on terrorism.' Twenty-five years ago, the world watched in horror as hijacked airliners struck the World Trade Center in New York, killing 2,977 people and irrevocably...
summary.zh: 总理阿尔巴尼斯表示，在恐怖之中展现了人性的至善，而反对党领袖则呼吁对“恐怖主义进行清算”。二十五年前，全世界惊恐地注视着被劫持的飞机撞击纽约世界贸易中心，造成2977人死亡，永远地改变了世界。澳大利亚领导人和机构纷纷致敬，悼念遇难的十名澳大利亚人。

body.en:
Twenty-five years ago, the world watched with horror as two hijacked airliners plunged into the Twin Towers at the World Trade Centre in New York, part of a catastrophic attack that would kill 2,977 people and change the world forever.

A quarter-century on from the disaster that claimed lives from more than 90 countries — including ten Australians — tributes have poured in from Australian leaders and agencies.

In a video posted on social media, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called for a pause to reflect on "that darkest of days", and for Australians to think of the people across the world whose lives were changed forever "in scenes so confronting that they remain seared into our collective memory".

Albanese said that while it was a day that changed the world, the bravery seen amid the horror showed "the greater side of humanity".

"From New York to Washington, to Pennsylvania, so many people responded to terror with extraordinary courage, compassion and defiance," he said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"And together, they defined the spirit of a nation. We hold on to that, and we remember everyone who never came home from what should've been just an ordinary day in September."

Coinciding with the historic date is a new event in the relationship between Australia and the United States : the first NFL game played in Australia, held at the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) on Friday.

During the game, the Australian Defence Force teamed up with its US counterparts in a flyover to commemorate the lives lost 25 years ago.

"In a powerful display of unity and skill, the Royal Australian Air Force Roulettes will fly with the US Marine Corps Ospreys, in a mixed formation above the MCG for this historic event," the ADF said in a statement, adding that the defence force would provide additional ceremonial support at the NFL match, including a Flag Party.

Leader of the Opposition Angus Taylor said it was "hard to believe" that the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks had arrived.

"It is hard to fathom that an entire generation of young Australians have reached adulthood who were not born on 9/11. And yet, they have grown up in a post 9/11 world — a darker world. My four children are among them," Taylor said in a statement.

"We all remember where we were, and how we received the shocking news ... Of course, this was the pre-smartphone age, and many Australians would not see the news until the following morning. I was one of them ... The entire situation was unfathomable and surreal."

Taylor went on to describe his appreciation for then-prime minister John Howard's actions.

reflection.en: Twenty-five years after the horrific attacks of September 11, 2001, Australia joins the world in remembrance. The tragedy claimed the lives of ten Australians and countless others, leaving an indelible mark on global history. As leaders call for a reckoning on terrorism, we are reminded of the enduring challenge to overcome evil not with more violence, but...
reflection.zh: 2001年9月11日恐怖袭击事件发生二十五年后，澳大利亚与世界一同缅怀。这场悲剧夺去了十名澳大利亚人以及无数其他人的生命，给全球历史留下了不可磨灭的印记。当领导人呼吁对恐怖主义进行清算时，我们被提醒要面对一个持久的挑战：以坚定的良善和对和平的承诺来克服邪恶，而非以更多的暴力回应。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Several dead after coach carrying 48 Dutch tourists plunges down Swiss embankment
title.zh: 载有48名荷兰游客的教练车在瑞士坠入斜坡，数人死亡

summary.en: A coach carrying 48 Dutch tourists from the Netherlands to Switzerland crashed late Thursday afternoon, hitting a safety barrier before overturning and plunging down an embankment, resulting in several fatalities and injuries.
summary.zh: 一辆载有48名荷兰游客的教练车于周四下午晚些时候在瑞士坠入斜坡，撞上安全护栏后翻车并坠入路堤，造成数人死亡和多人受伤。

body.en:
Several people were killed and more were injured when a coach carrying Dutch tourists in eastern Switzerland crashed, police said on Friday.

The accident happened late on Thursday afternoon local time, between the communes of Susch and Zernez in the far-eastern canton of Graubünden.

The coach hit a safety barrier before overturning and plunging down an embankment, a local police spokesman told Swiss media.

The Dutch Federation of Travel Agencies (ANVR) told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency that the coach belonged to the tour company Oad and was carrying 48 passengers, all of them from the Netherlands.

"Several people died in the coach crash in Susch. Several others were also injured," the cantonal police said on X, without giving details on the circumstances of the accident or the victims' identities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A police spokesman told AFP that the force did not wish to provide a more detailed toll until the victims' families had been informed.

According to the ANVR, the coach left the Netherlands on Monday and was on a day trip to Switzerland from Austria when the crash happened.

Footage broadcast by Swiss media showed rescue workers rushing around the coach, with helicopters stationed nearby.

Oad said in a statement it was "deeply shocked and devastated by the tragic accident".

"Our thoughts are with everyone involved and their loved ones. Local authorities are currently fully engaged in relief efforts and in determining the situation and the number of casualties," it added.

"We are doing everything in our power to obtain clarity quickly and to support those involved and their families wherever possible."

Swiss President Guy Parmelin offered his condolences to the families of the victims, calling the crash a "tragic accident".

Zernez is the entry point for visitors to the Swiss national park, a vast Alpine reserve stretching more than 100 square kilometres (40 square miles) across the mountainous Engadine valley.

body.zh: 警方周五表示，一辆载有荷兰游客的巴士在瑞士东部坠毁，造成多人死亡，多人受伤。 这起事故发生在当地时间周四下午晚些时候，地点位于远东格劳宾登州的苏施镇和策尔内茨镇之间。 当地警方发言人告诉瑞士媒体，这辆客车撞上了安全护栏，然后翻倒并冲下路堤。 荷兰旅行社联合会（ANVR）告诉法新社（法新社），这辆旅游巴士属于Oad旅游公司，载有48名乘客，全部来自荷兰。 州警方在 X 上表示：“苏施的长途客车事故造成多人死亡。另有多人受伤。”但没有透露事故情况或遇难者身份的详细信息。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 警方发言人告诉法新社，在通知受害者家属之前，警方不希望提供更详细的死亡人数。 据ANVR称，事故发生时，该客车周一离开荷兰，正在从奥地利前往瑞士进行一日游。 瑞士媒体播放的视频显示，救援人员在大巴周围奔忙，直升机驻扎在附近。 奥德在一份声明中表示，“对这起悲惨事故深感震惊和悲痛”。 声明补充说：“我们的心与所有参与其中的人及其亲人同在。地方当局目前正在全力投入救灾工作，并确定局势和伤亡人数。” “我们正在尽一切努力迅速澄清情况，并尽可能支持涉案人员及其家人。” 瑞士总统盖伊·帕梅林向遇难者家属表示哀悼，称这起事故是一场“悲惨事故”。 策尔内茨是游客进入瑞士国家公园的入口，这是一个广阔的高山保护区，绵延 100 多平方公里（40 平方英里），横跨多山的恩嘎丁山谷。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The news from Switzerland is heartbreaking, detailing the sudden loss of life among Dutch tourists. In moments of such profound grief, we turn to the hope that Yahweh will ultimately wipe away every tear and end all death, mourning, and pain. This promise offers solace as we navigate the harsh realities of our fallen world.
reflection.zh: 瑞士传来的消息令人心碎，详细描述了荷兰游客生命的突然逝去。在如此深切的悲痛时刻，我们转向雅伟的应许，他终将擦去一切眼泪，不再有死亡，也不再有悲伤、哭泣和痛苦。这个应许在我们穿越这个堕落世界的严酷现实时，提供了慰藉。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Nepal continues looking for survivors in hydropower tunnels two weeks after deadly floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔在致命洪水两周后继续在水电隧道中搜寻幸存者

summary.en: Nepal, which has contributed little to the emissions driving global warming, said reconstruction could cost billions. Rescuers are still searching for survivors in hydropower tunnels two weeks after a glacial mountain collapse triggered deadly flooding. The disaster has killed 1,377 people and left over 5,000 missing.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔表示，尽管其对导致全球变暖的排放贡献甚微，但重建可能耗资数十亿美元。在冰川山体垮塌引发致命洪水两周后，救援人员仍在水电隧道中搜寻幸存者。此次灾难已造成 1,377 人死亡，另有 5,000 多人失踪。

body.en:
Nepali rescuers clung to hopes of finding survivors trapped in hydropower tunnels on Wednesday, two weeks after deadly flooding triggered by a glacial mountain collapse.

The 26 August tsunami-like surge of water, mud and debris — which began on the China-Nepal border — has killed 1,377 people and left 5,130, including 587 foreigners, missing, according to Nepali authorities.

"The rescue and search work in the tunnels at Trishuli 3A, 3B and Chilime hydropower projects is ongoing," Nepal Army spokesman Raja Ram Basnet told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency.

The number of Australians unaccounted for remains at 35 , and Australian government officials and disaster response personnel have been deployed to Nepal to support response efforts. Neither Nepal nor China has confirmed that any Australians are among the deceased.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Australia’s Disaster Assistance and Response Team (DART) has conducted mapping and thermal searches in the disaster-hit region, including the last known locations of some missing Australians.

Three people were rescued from deep inside hydropower tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday.

Authorities appealed on Wednesday for overseas family members of the missing — preferably parents or children — to submit DNA samples via email.

A public notice outlined specific types of genetic tests the family members should seek out depending on their sex and relationship to the missing person.

Thousands of people displaced by the disaster are living in camps, and the charity Save the Children said as many as 540 children had been separated from their parents.

Nepal police said they were taking extra care to ensure the safety of children and women in relief camps.

"We have become more vigilant in temporary holding centres in the affected areas where there are children, women or minority groups who could be victims of sexual abuse," said Nepal Police spokesman Abi Narayan Kafle.

"We have also started providing psychosocial counselling in different camps," he told AFP.

While the exact cause of the glacial collapse is unclear, climate change is accelerating glacial melt worldwide and increasing the risk of such disasters.

Nepal, a largely rural nation of 30 million people that has contributed little to the greenhouse gas emissions driving global warming, has said reconstruction could cost billions of dollars.

Kafle said security personnel have involved community members to search for bodies feared buried under debris.

"We have started a special search campaign for missing bodies all across the Bhotekoshi river corridor," he said.

title.en: India's BRICS strategy tested with Xi, Putin set to visit
title.zh: 印度金砖国家战略面临考验，习近平和普京即将访印

summary.en: India's 'America Plus' strategy involves strengthening ties with China and Russia while simultaneously attempting to prevent the BRICS bloc from becoming a platform against the West. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to host the BRICS summit in New Delhi, which will include Chinese President Xi Jinping's first visit...
summary.zh: 印度“美国加”战略涉及加强与中国和俄罗斯的联系，同时试图阻止金砖国家集团成为反西方平台。印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪将主办金砖国家峰会，中国国家主席习近平自2019年以来首次访印，而印度与华盛顿的关系仍面临挑战。

body.en:
New Delhi's "America Plus" approach sees India deepening its ties with China and Russia, while also trying to keep BRICS from turning into an anti-Western platform.

India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi will host the 18th BRICS summit this weekend in New Delhi, welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping to India for the first time since 2019.   

The summit comes at an important moment for India . As New Delhi's year-long BRICS presidency draws to a close, India is stepping up engagement with China and Russia , and its relationship with Washington remains difficult .

Modi met both Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, on August 31 and September 1. Just two weeks later, Modi is set to see them again in New Delhi for the BRICS summit.

But with BRICS both growing in size and increasingly troubled by internal divisions, the forum might limit Modi's diplomatic gains.

Indian diplomats are trying to protect their room for maneuver in a changing international order.

Ashok Kantha, a former Indian ambassador to China, said India's engagement with BRICS and the SCO is part of New Delhi's longstanding strategy of strategic autonomy.

"These groupings give India a seat at the table and allow it to pursue its own interests while maintaining relationships with different major powers," Kantha told DW.

However, as Modi prepares to host Xi in New Delhi, ties between India and China are less than ideal .

Both countries reached a border patrol agreement in 2024, ending a four-year military standoff along their disputed frontier.

International flights have resumed, the Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage has reopened and some visa restrictions have eased. But major problems remain between Beijing and New Delhi — India is reporting a trade deficit of over $112 billion (€96.5 billion) with China, and the two countries argue over market access.

The Modi-Xi meeting will therefore be watched for signs of a major diplomatic thaw, particularly on trade and investment.

Kantha said the visit could bring some stabilization but should not be mistaken for a reset.

"The border remains heavily militarized and major differences over trade, investment and security remain. India needs a stable and predictable relationship with China, but without lowering its guard," said Kantha.

"It is a relationship of armed coexistence and managed competition. We should not reduce it to a simple 'elephant and dragon' story," he said, referring to traditional symbols of the world's two most populous nations.

India's presidency has already exposed the difficulty of reaching agreement within BRICS, which has grown from its original five members to 11.

With nations such as Brazil, South Africa, Indonesia and...
body.zh: 新德里的“美国+”方针让印度加深了与中国和俄罗斯的关系，同时也试图阻止金砖国家变成一个反西方的平台。 印度总理莫迪将于本周末在新德里主办金砖国家领导人第十八次峰会，欢迎中国国家主席习近平自 2019 年以来首次访问印度。 此次峰会对印度来说正值重要时刻。随着新德里为期一年的金砖国家轮值主席国任期接近尾声，印度正在加强与中国和俄罗斯的接触，其与华盛顿的关系仍然困难。 莫迪于8月31日和9月1日在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会上会见了习近平和俄罗斯总统普京。仅仅两周后，莫迪将在新德里出席金砖国家峰会时再次会见他们。 但随着金砖国家规模不断扩大，内部分歧日益困扰，该论坛可能会限制莫迪的外交成果。 印度外交官正试图在不断变化的国际秩序中保护自己的回旋余地。 印度前驻华大使阿肖克·坎塔表示，印度与金砖国家和上合组织的接触是新德里长期战略自主战略的一部分。 坎塔对德国之声表示：“这些组织让印度在谈判桌上占有一席之地，并使其能够在与不同大国保持关系的同时追求自身利益。” 然而，当莫迪准备在新德里接待习近平时，印度和中国之间的关系并不理想。 两国于 2024 年达成边境巡逻协议，结束了两国争议边境长达四年的军事对峙。 国际航班已恢复，神山朝圣活动已重新开放，一些签证限制也已放宽。但北京和新德里之间仍存在重大问题——印度报告的对华贸易逆差超过1120亿美元（965亿欧元），两国在市场准入问题上存在争议。 因此，莫迪与习近平的会晤将受到重大外交解冻的迹象，特别是在贸易和投资方面。 坎塔表示，这次访问可能会带来一些稳定，但不应被误认为是重置。 坎塔表示：“边境仍然高度军事化，贸易、投资和安全方面的重大分歧依然存在。印度需要与中国建立稳定和可预测的关系，但又不能放松警惕。” “这是一种武装共存和有管理的竞争的关系。我们不应将其简化为一个简单的‘象与龙’故事，”他说，他指的是世界上人口最多的两个国家的传统象征。 印度担任轮值主席国已经暴露了金砖国家内部达成协议的难度，金砖国家成员已从最初的5个增加到11个。 与巴西、南非、印度尼西亚等国家...

reflection.en: In a world often defined by division, India's diplomatic approach seeks a delicate balance. The upcoming BRICS summit in New Delhi, with leaders from China and Russia attending, presents an opportunity for dialogue and the pursuit of peace, even amidst complex international relations. May wisdom guide these leaders as they navigate the path toward mutual...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常被分裂所定义的世界上，印度的外交方针寻求微妙的平衡。即将在新德里举行的金砖国家峰会，中国和俄罗斯的领导人将出席，这为对话和寻求和平提供了机会，即使在复杂国际关系中也是如此。愿智慧引导这些领导人，在寻求相互理解与合作的道路上。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: BRICS Summit 2026: Putin, Modi reaffirm partnership
title.zh: 金砖国家峰会2026：普京、莫迪重申伙伴关系

summary.en: Modi will also meet Xi Jinping as India seeks to balance ties with China and Russia. The wars in Ukraine and Iran could test the group's unity at the summit. Follow DW for more.
summary.zh: 莫迪还将与习近平会晤，因为印度试图平衡与中国和俄罗斯的关系。乌克兰和伊朗的战争可能会考验该集团在峰会上的团结。请关注DW了解更多。

body.en:
Modi will also meet Xi Jinping as India seeks to balance ties with China and Russia. The wars in Ukraine and Iran could test the group's unity at the summit. Follow DW for more.

Tired of missing our real-time updates?  Click here to add us as a Preferred Source on Google . Then tap the "Star" or "Preferred" to keep DW News at the top of your feed.

India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi again appealed to Russian President Vladimir Putin to enter negotiations to end the war in Ukraine.

During their meeting in New Delhi on the eve of the BRICS summit, Modi told Putin that dialogue and diplomacy are the right way to resolve conflicts, the Indian Foreign Ministry said in a statement.

Russia's war in Ukraine and its impact on shipping in the Black Sea have affected India, a major buyer of Russian oil and grain. Indian sailors have also been caught up in drone attacks.

The war, which the Indian Foreign Ministry has referred to as conflicts "in the Black Sea region," is on the agenda for the two-day summit.

India has adopted a typically pragmatic approach to the conflict, seeking to balance ties with the West and with Russia.

However, during an August meeting of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) in Kyrgyzstan, Modi urged Putin to end the war, which was in its fifth year.

The BRICS summit 2026 takes place in Delhi this weekend. Unlike last year, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping are expected to attend. Can India keep the expanded bloc united?

Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has met with Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian on the eve of the BRICS leaders' summit.

According to a statement by India's Foreign Ministry, Modi thanked Pezeshkian for taking part in the summit "despite the challenging circumstances" for Iran, which remains at war with the US and Israel.

Despite that conflict and economic pressure from the US to cut trading ties, India has sought to balance maintaining its relationship with Tehran and with Israel and Arab Gulf states.

Modi called for regional peace and stability to be restored and maintained and for maritime trade routes to be protected, amid the US and Iran's competing blockades of the Strait of Hormuz.

Iran is currently experiencing "critical, dangerous" levels of pressure, President Masoud Pezeshkian said.

The pressure comes as a result of the US sanctions on the country, according to Pezeshkian.

"Iran has been subjected to heavy sanctions in recent years," the Iranian leader said ahead of the BRICS summit in India.

"This pressure has reached critical and dangerous stage in recent months following the military aggression by the US and Israel,"  he added.

Pezeshkian also said that the world is going through a period of "unprecedented complexity."

body.zh: 印度寻求平衡与中国和俄罗斯的关系之际，莫迪还将与习近平会面。乌克兰和伊朗的战争可能会考验该组织在峰会上的团结。关注DW了解更多。 以下是 2026 年印度金砖国家峰会的一些头条新闻摘要。 厌倦了错过我们的实时更新？ 单击此处将我们添加为 Google 上的首选来源。然后点击“星标”或“首选”，将 DW News 保留在您的 Feed 顶部。 总统马苏德·佩泽什基安表示，伊朗目前正面临“严重、危险”的压力。 佩泽什基安表示，这种压力是美国对该国实施制裁的结果。 伊朗领导人在印度金砖国家峰会前表示：“近年来，伊朗遭受了严厉制裁。” 他补充说：“近几个月来，随着美国和以色列的军事侵略，这种压力已经达到了关键和危险的阶段。” 佩泽什基安还表示，世界正在经历一个“前所未有的复杂性”时期。 俄罗斯领导人表示，西方国家正集中精力摧毁设施和管道以及扣押船只，以维持其经济领先地位。 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在将于周六开始的金砖国家峰会期间举行双边会谈。 印度外交部的一份声明称，两位领导人“就印俄在多边领域的合作，特别是印度担任 2026 年轮值主席国期间的金砖国家合作交换了意见”。 在会议上，领导人还就“共同关心的关键地区和全球问题，包括影响海上贸易和印度海员安全的西亚和黑海地区冲突”交换了意见。 声明补充说，两国领导人重申了两国的关系，并承诺“继续致力于进一步加强两国之间的特殊和特权战略伙伴关系”。 伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安抵达德里出席金砖国家峰会。 这是八年来伊朗总统首次访问印度。 佩泽什基安定于下午 6 点 15 分与总理纳伦德拉·莫迪举行双边会谈。当地时间周五推进双向贸易并加强整体联系。 他参加金砖国家峰会以及与莫迪的双边会谈具有重要意义，因为此时中东局势紧张，能源市场混乱震动了全球经济。 金砖国家目前拥有近 37 亿人口，占全球 GDP 的近 40%，各国领导人在地缘政治紧张局势、贸易争端和能源挑战日益加剧的背景下召开会议。 虽然扩大后的集团正在寻求在……中发出更强有力的声音。

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

Last month, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang  by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and pouring praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011.

Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

title.en: China angered by Taiwan VP's visit to EU democracy forum
title.zh: 中国对台湾副总统访问欧盟民主论坛表示愤怒

summary.en: Beijing has lodged a complaint with Italy and the EU over top Taiwanese officials visiting a democracy conference. The EU is navigating contentious issues with China, and high-ranking Taiwanese visits are rare.
summary.zh: 北京就台湾高级官员访问民主会议一事向意大利和欧盟提出抗议。欧盟正在处理与中国的敏感问题，而台湾高级官员的访问非常罕见。

body.en:
Beijing has lodged a complaint with Italy and the EU over top Taiwanese officials visiting a democracy conference. The EU is navigating contentious issues with China and high-ranking Taiwanese visits are rare.

China was angered by Italy and the EU on Friday, lodging "solemn ‌representations" with both after news broke that high-ranking Taiwanese officials had traveled to the bloc to attend an annual democracy summit.

Beijing's Foreign Ministry said it firmly opposes official interactions of any form with Taiwan by nations who have ties with China .

Solemn ‌representations is a literal translation of a Chinese term expressing diplomatic discontent. 

At issue is a visit by Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim and Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung, both of whom were welcomed to the Ventotene Conference for Freedom and Democracy in Italy.

China sees democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory, which it has  vowed to "reunite" with the mainland . 

Beijing has previously blasted Hsiao as an "independence diehard" and has criticized her Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) as a separatist outfit.

Taiwan's government has not sought formal independence but Beijing has, nevertheless, threatened to take the island by military force.

European Parliament Vice President Pina Picierno announced Hsiao and Lin's attendance at the conference early Friday morning, adding that news of the visit had been kept under wraps until they arrived for safety reasons.

The EU's Picierno, who called the visit a "very important message," was defiant on Friday, saying, "No one can decide who is hosted in Ventotene and who is not," and calling out the Chinese "regime" for seeking to interfere. 

Though Taiwanese foreign ministers travel abroad, it is rare for an official as high-ranking as the vice president to visit nations with ties to Beijing for fear of fallout for host countries.

Other prominent pro-democracy advocates such as Russian Kremlin critic Yulia Navalnaya , the wife of the late Alexei Navalny, and Belarus opposition leader Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya are also in attendance. 

Italy, like most nations, is not among Taiwan's 12 formal diplomatic allies, although the Vatican is.

Italy's Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani will not meet with the visiting Taiwanese officials.

The EU is walking a fine line between democratic support for Taiwan and relations with China.

Beijing's support for Russia in its ongoing invasion of Ukraine — which also prompted Taiwan to seek closer ties with the EU in 2022 — has been a thorn in the side of EU nations and in Brussels.

body.zh: 北京已就台湾高级官员参观民主会议向意大利和欧盟提出投诉。欧盟正在处理与中国有争议的问题，台湾高层访问很少。 周五，意大利和欧盟激怒了中国，在台湾高级官员前往欧盟参加年度民主峰会的消息传出后，中国向意大利和欧盟提出了“严正交涉”。 北京外交部表示，坚决反对与中国有联系的国家与台湾进行任何形式的官方互动。 严正交涉是表达外交不满的中文术语的直译。 争论的焦点是副主席萧美琴和外交部长林家龙的访问，他们两人都受到了意大利文托泰内自由民主会议的欢迎。 中国将民主治理的台湾视为自己的领土，并发誓要与大陆“统一”。 北京此前曾抨击萧是“独立顽固分子”，并批评她所在的民进党（DPP）是分裂主义组织。 台湾政府并未寻求正式独立，但北京却威胁要用武力夺取台湾。 欧洲议会副主席皮娜·皮切尔诺周五凌晨宣布萧和林出席会议，并补充说，出于安全原因，在他们抵达之前，此次访问的消息一直处于保密状态。 欧盟委员皮切尔诺称这次访问是一个“非常重要的信息”，他在周五挑衅地说，“没有人可以决定谁在文托泰内接待，谁不接待”，并指责中国“政权”试图干涉。 尽管台湾外长经常出国访问，但像副总统这样的高级官员很少访问与北京有联系的国家，因为担心对东道国造成影响。 其他著名的民主倡导者，如俄罗斯克里姆林宫批评家尤利娅·纳瓦尔纳亚（已故阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼的妻子）和白俄罗斯反对派领导人斯维亚特兰娜·齐哈努斯卡娅也出席了会议。 与大多数国家一样，意大利并不在台湾的 12 个正式外交盟友之列，但梵蒂冈却在其中。 意大利外交部长安东尼奥·塔亚尼不会会见来访的台湾官员。 欧盟在对台湾的民主支持和与中国的关系之间保持着微妙的平衡。 北京对俄罗斯持续入侵乌克兰的支持——这也促使台湾在 2022 年寻求与欧盟建立更紧密的关系——一直是欧盟国家和布鲁塞尔的眼中钉。 如果您依赖我们团队提供值得信赖的报告，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，以便您始终看到...

reflection.en: Diplomatic tensions often arise from differing political views and national interests. In these moments, the call to live peaceably with all, as much as it depends on us, is a vital reminder for nations and individuals alike. May wisdom guide leaders toward de-escalation and mutual respect.
reflection.zh: 外交紧张局势常常源于不同的政治观点和国家利益。在这些时刻，尽我们所能与人和睦相处的呼吁，对国家和个人来说都是一个重要的提醒。愿智慧引导领导者走向缓和局势和相互尊重。
