title.en: Hong Kong Tiananmen activists jailed for up to 7 years
title.zh: 香港天安门案活动人士被判处最高七年监禁

summary.en: Three pro-democracy activists who organized annual commemorations of China's deadly 1989 Tiananmen crackdown were sentenced to between five and seven years in prison under Hong Kong's national security law for "incitement to subversion."
summary.zh: 三名组织纪念中国1989年致命天安门镇压活动的有组织民主活动人士，根据香港国安法被判处五年至七年监禁，罪名为“煽动颠覆”。

body.en:
Three pro-democracy activists who organized annual commemorations of China's deadly 1989 Tiananmen crackdown were charged under Hong Kong's Beijing-backed national security law.

A Hong Kong court on Friday sentenced three pro-democracy activists who organized annual vigils marking China's deadly 1989 Tiananmen crackdown to between five and seven years in prison under the city's national security law .

The three were convicted in August of "incitement to subversion" over their activities with the now-disbanded Hong Kong Alliance, which received a fine of HK$1.5 million ($191,304, €164,768). The alliance had organized annual Tiananmen vigils in Victoria Park.

Judges cited the group's call to "end one-party dictatorship," saying it challenged the legitimacy of Communist Party rule in the Chinese special administrative region. 

Lee and Chow denied the subversion charges under Hong Kong's controversial national security law. The defendants also insisted the alliance had not asked people to do anything illegal. 

The court rejected arguments that the defendants believed they were acting within the law given Hong ​Kong's freedoms of speech, which have been severely curtailed since Beijing imposed the law in 2020 following a crackdown mass pro-democracy protests the previous year.

The vigils, once a major annual event in Hong Kong, have been effectively banned under the law. 

Chow, a barrister who represented herself, raised both arms and waved at supporters as she was escorted out.

Her mother, Medina Chow, addressed her supporters saying, "For today's verdict, you do not need to be overly saddened. Do not lose heart. And above all, do not ​feel guilty."

The convictions have drawn criticism from foreign governments and rights groups.

"This sentencing is a triple tragedy: for the activists being unjustly punished; the survivors and victims of the Tiananmen crackdown itself; and the generations of Hongkongers denied the space to discuss one of the most consequential events in modern Chinese history," said Amnesty International's deputy regional director, Sarah Brooks.

Germany and France last month had condemned the verdict against Chow saying that "peaceful advocacy for human rights does not constitute a crime."

Among those arrested under the security law are pro-democracy former media tycoon Jimmy Lai and former student leader Joshua Wong .

body.zh: 三名民主活动人士因每年组织纪念 1989 年中国致命的天安门镇压活动而受到北京支持的香港国家安全法的指控。 香港一家法院周五根据香港国家安全法判处三名民主活动人士五年至七年监禁，这些活动人士每年组织纪念中国 1989 年天安门镇压事件的守夜活动。 三人于 8 月因与现已解散的香港联盟的活动而被判“煽动颠覆”罪，该联盟被罚款 150 万港元（191,304 美元，164,768 欧元）。该联盟在维多利亚公园组织了一年一度的天安门守夜活动。 法官援引该组织“结束一党专政”的呼吁，称其挑战了共产党在中国特别行政区统治的合法性。 李和周否认了根据香港有争议的国家安全法提出的颠覆罪指控。被告还坚称联盟没有要求人们做任何非法的事情。 鉴于香港的言论自由自去年镇压大规模民主抗议活动后北京于 2020 年实施该法律以来，香港的言论自由受到严重限制，法院驳回了被告认为自己在法律范围内行事的论点。 守夜活动曾经是香港的一项重大年度活动，但实际上已被法律禁止。 周女士是一名代表自己的大律师，她在被护送出去时举起双臂向支持者挥手致意。 她的母亲周美娜对她的支持者说：“对于今天的判决，你们不必过度悲伤。不要灰心。最重要的是，不要感到内疚。” 这些定罪引起了外国政府和人权组织的批评。 国际特赦组织区域副主任萨拉·布鲁克斯 (Sarah Brooks) 表示：“这一判决是一场三重悲剧：活动人士受到不公正的惩罚；天安门镇压本身的幸存者和受害者；几代香港人被剥夺了讨论中国现代历史上最重要事件之一的空间。” 德国和法国上个月谴责了对周的判决，称“和平倡导人权并不构成犯罪”。 根据国安法被捕的人包括民主派前媒体大亨黎智英和前学生领袖黄之锋。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The sentencing of these activists underscores a deep yearning for remembrance and justice, a cry for accountability that echoes through the years. The pursuit of truth, even when met with severe penalties, reflects a profound human need to acknowledge past wrongs and seek a more just future.
reflection.zh: 对这些活动人士的判决，凸显了对纪念和伸张正义的深切渴望，这是多年来挥之不去的对问责的呼唤。追求真相，即使面临严厉的惩罚，也反映了人类承认过去的错误并寻求更公正未来的深刻需求。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水过后近两周，又一名澳大利亚人被发现生还

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水后，一名身在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。 据 SBS 新闻了解，这名澳大利亚人无法联系上，但今天确认他们安全无恙，不需要领事协助。 8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生的泥石流和洪水造成至少1,399人死亡，5,400多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 一群失踪亲人的澳大利亚家庭周日发表声明，呼吁旅游团和当局提高透明度。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们对澳大利亚联邦警察和寻找失踪澳大利亚人的搜救队表示感谢，但批评澳大利亚政府未能提供答案。 联邦政府已派出救灾响应小组和其他专业资源前往加德满都协助搜寻。 它还承诺提供 1100 万美元来支持救灾，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一表示，这对国家具有重要意义。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 8月26日，尼泊尔和中国边境的一座冰川崩塌成河，至少11个水电项目被吞没，这些项目的隧道入口被瓦砾和泥土掩埋，并切断了被困人员的通道。 当局周二表示，尼泊尔的救援人员正在重点关注三个水电项目隧道，他们认为那里可能有数十名工人被困。 “我们的搜索行动主要是寻找幸存者，包括在隧道中寻找幸存者。我们更关注的是 Chilime 水力发电项目，我们相信那里有人被困，因为那里有食堂、住所和食物安排，”该国灾害管理局局长 Dharma Raj Upreti 告诉路透社。 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动带来了前所未有的挑战。 “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods that claimed many lives and left others missing, the news of a found Australian offers a beacon of hope. This story echoes the Psalmist's declaration that weeping may last for a night, but joy comes in the morning. For the families who feared the worst, this reunion is a profound answer to prayer and a testament to...
reflection.zh: 在夺走许多生命并导致多人失踪的毁灭性洪水灾难中，一名澳大利亚人被找到的消息带来了希望的曙光。这个故事呼应了诗篇作者的宣告：哭泣虽可过夜，但早晨必带来欢欣。对于那些曾恐惧最坏情况的家庭来说，这次重逢是对祷告的深刻回应，也是坚韧不拔的证明。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

body.zh: 巴里·卡西迪（Barrie Cassidy）和肖恩·凯利（Sean Kelly）（本周接替托尼·巴里）直接前往自由党前座议员安德鲁·哈斯蒂（Andrew Hastie）与宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）一起观看动画片。哈斯蒂是少数愿意与一国党领导人较量的政客之一吗？这是否会成为自由党反击的开始？与一国保持一致：沃伦·皮克林本周新闻发布会的报道对媒体和公众如何以不同方式对待政治领导人有什么看法？总理继续因向其选区的一家高尔夫俱乐部提供资助而受到审查。哈斯蒂接受乔​​伊斯就“叛徒”漫画所做的道歉，而汉森则加倍努力，告诉批评者“冷静”。

reflection.en: In the heat of political disagreement, the temptation is to mirror harshness with harshness. Andrew Hastie's decision to accept an apology, even amidst ongoing conflict, offers a moment of grace. Proverbs 15:1 reminds us that a gentle answer can de-escalate tension, while harsh words inflame it.
reflection.zh: 在政治分歧的激烈争论中，人们很容易以强硬回应强硬。安德鲁·哈斯蒂选择接受道歉，即使在持续的冲突中，也提供了一个恩典的时刻。《箴言》15:1 提醒我们，温和的回答可以缓和紧张局势，而伤人的话语只会激化矛盾。

verse.textEn: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verse.textZh: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言语暴戾，触动怒气。

title.en: Australia and Canada can learn from each other on climate if we separate action from declaration | Rosa Galvez

summary.en: Climate integrity means being honest about the gap between emissions reduced on paper and emissions reduced in the atmosphere. Canada and Australia are both democracies built on abundant resources, extraordinary biodiversity and world-class science, with prosperity built substantially on mining, oil and gas. We are...
summary.zh: 气候诚信意味着诚实地认识到纸面减排量与大气中实际减排量之间的差距。加拿大和澳大利亚都是建立在丰富资源、非凡生物多样性和世界一流科学基础上的民主国家，其繁荣在很大程度上依赖于采矿、石油和天然气。我们是主要的化石燃料出口国，经济模式与稳定的气候不兼容，并通过日益严重的森林大火、洪水和干旱来承受后果。在我为悉尼气候诚信峰会做...

body.en: Climate integrity means being honest about the gap between emissions reduced on paper and emissions reduced in the atmosphere Canada and Australia are both democracies built on abundant resources, extraordinary biodiversity and world-class science, with prosperity built substantially on mining, oil and gas . We are major fossil fuel exporters running an economic model incompatible with a stable climate, and living the consequences through worsening bushfires , floods and drought. As I prepare for the Climate Integrity Summit in Sydney, I am struck less by the distance between our countries than by how much we have in common. We face the same defining question: how do we move beyond fossil fuels without sacrificing prosperity or nature? Continue reading...

This raises the question of our stewardship over the Earth, which Yahweh entrusted to humanity. Genesis 2:15 calls us to 'work the land and take care of it,' a mandate that requires...

title.en: Regional Australians want cheaper flights. What’s standing in the way?
title.zh: 澳大利亚偏远地区居民想要更便宜的机票。是什么阻碍了他们？

summary.en: An inquiry has heard that passengers in the bush are paying significantly more per kilometre than even those flying to or from regional cities. Bush communities are begging for more budget airfares even as regional airline Rex warns that stiff competition in small markets is pushing the airline to the brink. Isolated...
summary.zh: 一项调查了解到，偏远地区（bush）的乘客每公里支付的费用远高于往返区域性城市的乘客。偏远地区的社区迫切希望获得更便宜的机票，与此同时，区域航空公司Rex警告称，小型市场的激烈竞争正将该航空公司推向破产边缘。新南威尔士州中海岸地区发展局的首席执行官Madeleine...

body.en:
Bush communities are begging for more budget airfares even as regional airline Rex warns that stiff competition in small markets is pushing the airline to the brink.

Isolated and aging populations are being let down by expensive ticket costs, Madeleine Lawler, chief executive of Regional Development Australia on the Mid North Coast of NSW, warned.

Her comments came during the latest public hearing into the state of Australia's regional aviation sector.

Flights from Coffs Harbour or Port Macquarie cost about 71 cents per kilometre, but from Ballina, where budget flights are available on Jetstar, the average is 12 cents per kilometre, Lawler told the inquiry.

"When I first moved to Coffs Harbour, I was able to get a Bonza flight for under 100 bucks, or Tiger Air was in there for a while, and I was able to get around in a really affordable way," she said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"We are slicing demand out of our economies by not having those lower price points available in the market, and that means our tourism economies suffer as well."

But half-empty planes could not cover the costs required to run a flight, so Rex shared the burden with travellers from the bush or cancelled services, the struggling airline's network strategy general manager Warrick Lodge told the hearing.

"You end up in a situation where ... carriers are forced to charge each of those passengers more to try and cover their costs," he said.

In July 2024, Rex entered voluntary administration only to be kept afloat with a taxpayer-funded package of $40 million before being bought by American company Air T in December 2025.

Rex had already provided 40,000 seats a year to a market that only had 22,000 passengers — then Qantas added another 31,000.

Now, no airline flies Melbourne to Albury, while Rex pulled all services to Devonport in June.

Across the business, some Rex routes barely covered operating costs, while others were forced to contribute to overheads, Lodge said.

The airline has deals in place with the Queensland and WA governments, which subsidise operations in those states.

The Royal Flying Doctor Service told the hearing that regional airlines are critical to their operations.

Adequate air travel supported early intervention and helped patients avoid emergency treatment.

"Many of these flights will be to retrieve Australians who are critically ill and need urgent medical evacuation," federation chief executive Emma Buchanan said.

body.zh: 尽管区域航空公司雷克斯警告说，小市场的激烈竞争正在将航空公司推向崩溃的边缘，但布什社区仍在乞求更多的廉价机票。 新南威尔士州中北海岸澳大利亚区域发展公司首席执行官玛德琳·劳勒警告说，昂贵的门票价格正在让偏僻和老龄化的人口感到失望。 她是在最近一次有关澳大利亚支线航空业状况的公开听证会上发表上述言论的。 劳勒告诉调查组，从考夫斯港或麦觉理港出发的航班每公里票价约为 71 美分，但从巴利纳出发（捷星航空提供廉价航班）的平均票价为每公里 12 美分。 “当我第一次搬到科夫斯港时，我能以不到 100 美元的价格买到 Bonza 航班，或者虎航在那里呆了一段时间，我能够以非常实惠的方式出行，”她说。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “由于市场上没有较低的价格点，我们正在削减经济中的需求，这意味着我们的旅游经济也会受到影响。” 但陷入困境的航空公司网络战略总经理沃里克·洛奇(Warrick Lodge)在听证会上表示，半空的飞机无法支付运行航班所需的费用，因此雷克斯与来自丛林的旅客分担负担或取消航班。 他说：“最终的结果是……航空公司被迫向每位乘客收取更多费用，以试图弥补他们​​的费用。” 2024 年 7 月，Rex 进入自愿托管，但在 2025 年 12 月被美国公司 Air T 收购之前，仅靠纳税人资助的 4000 万美元的资金维持生存。 Rex 每年向只有 22,000 名乘客的市场提供 40,000 个座位，然后澳洲航空又增加了 31,000 个座位。 现在，没有航空公司有从墨尔本飞往奥尔伯里的航班，而雷克斯在六月取消了所有飞往德文波特的航班。 洛奇说，在整个业务中，一些雷克斯航线几乎无法支付运营成本，而其他航线则被迫承担管理费用。 该航空公司与昆士兰州和西澳州政府签订了协议，为这些州的运营提供补贴。 皇家飞行医生服务中心在听证会上表示，支线航空公司对其运营至关重要。 充足的航空旅行支持早期干预并帮助患者避免紧急治疗。 联合会首席执行官艾玛·布坎南（Emma Buchanan）表示：“其中许多航班将接回病情危重且需要紧急医疗后送的澳大利亚人。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The inquiry into regional airfares reveals a struggle for accessibility, particularly impacting isolated and aging populations. These communities, often overlooked, are paying disproportionately high costs for essential travel. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute." This...
reflection.zh: 关于偏远地区机票价格的调查揭示了出行便利性的困境，尤其影响了孤立和老龄化的人群。这些社区常常被忽视，却要为必要的出行支付不成比例的高昂费用。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们：“为不能说话的，就是一切被压住的，伸明伸冤。” 这段经文提醒我们要为那些声音不易被听见的人发声，确保他们的需求得到关注。

verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: A 16-hour flight, 100,000 fans and an upset: The NFL makes its Australian debut
title.zh: 一场16小时的飞行，10万粉丝和一场意外：NFL首次亮相澳大利亚

summary.en: For some Americans, the long trek to see their teams clash on the other side of the world was well worth the journey.
summary.zh: 对于一些美国人来说，长途跋涉到世界的另一边观看他们支持的球队比赛是值得的。

body.en:
More than 100,000 fans from across Australia and abroad flooded the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) on Friday to watch the San Francisco 49ers thrash the Los Angeles Rams 27-7 in the NFL's first-ever regular-season game in Australia.

With the match kicking off at 10am to line up with US prime time, one Rams fan at the MCG described it as the earliest he'd ever been up for a game.

"The atmosphere, I love it, but it's kind of quiet," he told SBS News. "You know, back home it would usually be a bit crazier, with both teams going at it."

Another fan was adding Melbourne to a list of 43 overseas stadiums he'd visited. His white jersey was embroidered with patches representing each country, with a small green patch featuring a cluster of koalas to represent Melbourne on the bottom left.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I've been to every stadium in the world where the NFL plays," he told SBS News. "It's my first time in Australia, and I love it, everyone is so nice and inviting and helpful."

"I flew all the way in from Miami, Florida, two days ago, and I'm going home tonight. I just came to witness this amazing stadium and the great people of Melbourne."

Friday's game was the first of a four-year deal between Australia and the NFL , but with no guarantee a game will be played here every year, thousands of overseas fans made the pilgrimage.

A sea of red, white, blue and yellow filled the MCG, with a sold-out crowd of 100,022 fans, including thousands of visitors from the US. Almost half of spectators were expected to be from interstate or overseas, according to the state government.

Los Angeles resident Nancy Gakere took advantage of the opportunity for a holiday, stopping over in Fiji on the way to and from Melbourne to break up what could have been a 16-hour direct flight.

She said the journey was more than worth it, especially as the 49ers, pegged as the underdogs, pulled off a surprise rout.

"Everything was just great; honestly, we couldn't have planned it any better," she told SBS News.

"When this away game happened to be in Australia, we thought, why not? And we booked the trip as soon as tickets came out in April, so we have been excited about it for a while."

"And being 49ers fans, we were not the favourites, so we came in with low expectations, and winning was a nice surprise."

Gakere said that staying in Brunswick, in Melbourne's north, had made the trip economical.

"Other than the Uber from the airport, we have just been taking the tram in and out of the city to sight-see, trying food, the bars, walking around and exploring," she told SBS News. "And we went to the Great Ocean Road, which was our main tourism activity."

body.zh: 周五，来自澳大利亚各地和国外的超过 100,000 名球迷涌入墨尔本板球场 (MCG)，观看旧金山 49 人队以 27-7 击败洛杉矶公羊队，这是 NFL 在澳大利亚的首场常规赛比赛。 比赛于上午 10 点开始，与美国黄金时间一致，MCG 的一位公羊队球迷称这是他参加比赛最早的一场比赛。 “我喜欢这里的气氛，但有点安静，”他告诉 SBS 新闻。 “你知道，回到主场通常会有点疯狂，两支球队都在努力。” 另一位球迷将墨尔本添加到了他参观过的 43 个海外体育场的名单中。他的白色球衣上绣有代表各个国家的补丁，左下角有一小块绿色补丁，上面有一群考拉，代表墨尔本。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我去过世界上 NFL 比赛的每一个体育场，”他告诉 SBS 新闻。 “这是我第一次来澳大利亚，我很喜欢这里，每个人都那么友善、热情、乐于助人。” “两天前我从佛罗里达州迈阿密一路飞来，今晚我就要回家了。我只是来见证这个令人惊叹的体育场和墨尔本伟大的人民。” 周五的比赛是澳大利亚与 NFL 之间四年协议中的第一场，但由于不能保证每年都会在这里举行比赛，因此成千上万的海外球迷前来朝圣。 MCG 充满了红、白、蓝、黄的海洋，100,022 名粉丝的门票全部售罄，其中包括数千名来自美国的游客。据州政府称，预计近一半观众来自州际或海外。 洛杉矶居民南希·加凯尔(Nancy Gakere)利用假期的机会，在往返墨尔本的途中经停斐济，中断了原本16小时的直飞航班。 她表示这段旅程非常值得，特别是当 49 人队被视为失败者时，却意外地惨败。 “一切都很棒；说实话，我们计划得再好不过了，”她告诉 SBS 新闻。 “当这场客场比赛恰好在澳大利亚举行时，我们想，为什么不呢？而且我们在四月份门票一出来就预订了行程，所以我们兴奋了一段时间。” “作为 49 人队的球迷，我们并不是最受欢迎的球队，所以我们的期望很低，但获胜是一个很大的惊喜。” 加凯雷说，住在墨尔本北部的布伦瑞克让这次旅行很经济。 她告诉 SBS 新闻：“除了机场的 Uber 之外，我们只是乘坐电车进出城市观光、尝试美食、酒吧、四处走走和探索。” “我们去了大洋路，这是我们的主要旅游活动。” SBS新闻...

This dedication to a sporting spectacle, with its intense training and striving for victory, echoes the Apostle Paul's analogy of athletes competing for a perishable crown. While the earthly prize fades, the discipline and commitment can reflect...
reflection.zh: NFL首次在墨尔本亮相吸引了超过10万名粉丝，许多人为此进行了长途跋涉。这种对体育盛事的奉献精神，以及其中包含的艰苦训练和对胜利的追求，呼应了使徒保罗将运动员为易朽的冠冕而奋斗的比喻。虽然地上的奖赏会消逝，但其中的纪律和投入可以折射出更深层次的追求。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: Card surcharges are ending soon. But the shake-up could come at a cost
title.zh: 信用卡附加费即将取消。但改革可能要付出代价

summary.en: Credit and debit card surcharges are ending from October in a move that's expected to save consumers $1.6 billion a year. However, because surcharges cover some merchants' banking costs, prices are expected to rise.
summary.zh: 从10月起，信用卡和借记卡的附加费将取消，预计每年为消费者节省16亿澳元。然而，由于附加费涵盖了部分商家的银行成本，预计价格将会上涨。

body.en:
Those irritating and often uneven percentages added to bills when you tap to pay will disappear next month, but the cost of using plastic won’t vanish, and prices are set to rise.

Eftpos, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB, and UnionPay purchases will be free from card surcharges from 1 October, saving consumers an estimated $1.6 billion per year. However, because surcharges cover some merchants' banking costs, prices are expected to rise.

The removal of surcharge fees is one of three changes being rolled out by the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) from next month. Interchange fees, which banks charge when they process domestic card transactions, will be capped at 0.3 per cent on each payment, down from 0.8 per cent.

Merchants typically absorb these costs, and Treasury estimates the changes will save small businesses a combined $910 million a year.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

And because those fees subsidise frequent flyer and rewards points programs, banks have already started raising annual fees and offering fewer perks.

Finder personal finance specialist Taylor Blackburn told SBS news that some deals at Westpac, ANZ, HSBC, MyCard, and BOQ have either changed or are slated to change from 30 September.

"Sign-up bonus offers have already changed at ANZ, for example, they used to do a $200 credit on your first annual fee, but they're getting rid of that," Blackburn said.

Other frequent flyer bonus offer cards have dropped by 50,000 bonus points, but some banks are improving their offers, so shop around for a better deal now before you get stung by shifting offers, he suggested.

Westpac is lifting interest rates on some of its credit cards and will increase annual fees. NAB credit card interest rates will rise 1.5 per cent too.

Commonwealth Bank announced its Commbank Awards program is changing how consumers earn points in a new loyalty and points scheme.

St George Bank is also lifting interest rates on its Amplify Qantas Platinum credit card and introducing an annual fee of $125. The bank has also dropped the interest-free period on purchases by 10 days.

Australian Banking Association (ABA) chief executive Simon Birmingham said last year that interchange fees in Australia are "already among the lowest in the world".

"We agree with the RBA's concerns about fairness for small businesses, but there are better, more targeted ways to address this without destabilising the broader payments system — such as a small business interchange rate."

The European Union caps fees for debit cards at 0.2 per cent and consumer credit cards at 0.3 per cent.

body.zh: 当你点击支付时，那些令人恼火且通常不均匀的百分比将在下个月消失，但使用塑料的成本不会消失，而且价格将会上涨。 从 10 月 1 日起，Eftpos、Visa、Mastercard、American Express、JCB 和银联卡消费将免收卡附加费，预计每年为消费者节省 16 亿美元。然而，由于附加费覆盖了一些商户的银行成本，预计价格将会上涨。 附加费只是下个月开始的三项变化之一。银行在处理国内银行卡交易时收取的交换费将从每次付款的 0.8% 下调至 0.3%。 据财政部称，商家通常会承担这些成本，因此当信用卡和借记卡附加费于 10 月份结束时，小型企业预计将节省 9.1 亿美元。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 由于这些费用用于补贴常旅客和奖励积分计划，银行已经开始提高年费并减少福利。 Finder 个人理财专家 Taylor Blackburn 告诉 SBS 新闻，从 9 月 30 日起，Westpac、ANZ、HSBC、MyCard 和 BOQ 的部分交易已经改变或计划改变。 布莱克本说：“ANZ的开卡奖金优惠已经发生了变化，例如，他们过去在你的第一笔年费中提供200美元的信用额度，但他们正在取消这一点。” 他建议，其他常旅客奖励积分卡已经减少了 50,000 点奖励积分，但一些银行正在改善其优惠，因此，在因优惠变化而受到困扰之前，现在就货比三家，寻找更好的优惠。 西太平洋银行正在提高部分信用卡的利率，并将增加年费。 NAB信用卡利率也将上涨1.5%。 联邦银行宣布其联邦银行奖励计划正在改变消费者在新的忠诚度和积分计划中赚取积分的方式。 圣乔治银行还提高了 Amplify Qantas Platinum 信用卡的利率，并收取 125 美元的年费。该银行还将购物免息期缩短了 10 天。 “我们同意澳大利亚央行对小企业公平性的担忧，但有更好、更有针对性的方法来解决这个问题，而不会破坏更广泛的支付系统的稳定——例如小企业汇率。” 欧盟将借记卡的收费上限设为 0.2%，将消费信用卡的收费上限设为 0.3%。 在美国，费率通常在 1.15% 至 3.3% 之间，加上每笔交易的少量固定费用。 十月份开始的第三次 RBA 改革将迫使 EFTPOS、万事达卡和 Visa 公布他们收取的商户费用，以便企业可以...

reflection.en: As card surcharges are set to end, consumers may see prices rise as merchants adjust. This shift highlights the ongoing tension between fair pricing and covering business costs. The ancient wisdom of Proverbs 11:1 reminds us that integrity in all dealings, including pricing, is valued.

title.en: The hidden $140 billion economy helping some Australians get ahead
title.zh: 帮助一些澳大利亚人前进的隐藏的1400亿澳元经济

summary.en: Older Australians are providing more than $140 billion in everyday support to younger family members each year, covering costs from childcare to home deposits and groceries.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的老年人每年为年轻家庭成员提供超过1400亿澳元的日常支持，涵盖从育儿到购房首付和食品杂货等各项开销。

body.en:
From free childcare to home deposits, groceries and holidays, billions of dollars are flowing between Australian generations long before an inheritance is handed down.

For Shane and Catherine, being grandparents to 10 children can sometimes resemble a full-time job.

A busy week can involve seeing one or more of their grandchildren almost every day, from picking them up from school, taking them to sport, helping with homework and cooking for them.

The couple, who have both worked as educators for 45 years, made a conscious decision to become active grandparents.

Catherine even reduced her working hours so she could help care for their grandchildren while their parents worked full-time.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"They couldn't have managed five days a week childcare. It's so expensive today," Catherine told SBS's Insight.

"So to look after the children, that's a saving in hundreds of dollars for them."

There may be no money changing hands, but the arrangement has significant financial value.

And Shane and Catherine are part of a much bigger, and often largely invisible, flow of support between Australian generations.

New research from SBS CulturalConnect estimates older Australians provide more than $140 billion worth of everyday financial support to younger family members each year.

The research involved in-depth interviews with 50 parents and grandparents providing support, followed by a survey of around 2,500 Australians.

More than 12 million Australians were found to support younger adult family members in some way.

Researchers have dubbed it the "Booster Economy", or the wealth and financial support flowing between generations while parents and grandparents are still alive.

And it extends far beyond the familiar "Bank of Mum and Dad" helping children into the housing market.

Among those providing support, 34 per cent had bought groceries for younger family members, 33 per cent had paid for restaurant meals and 30 per cent had bought clothes.

Almost one in five had paid for travel, while 14 per cent had bought a car and the same proportion had purchased appliances or electronics.

Forty-two per cent had provided cash, while 19 per cent had helped pay off debt.

The $140 billion estimate excludes cash transfers, debt repayments, homes and home deposits, capturing instead the scale of everyday purchases being made by older Australians for younger family members.

Finder personal finance expert Sarah Megginson said its research suggests reliance on family wealth is already growing significantly in one of the biggest areas of household finances: housing.

body.zh: 从免费托儿服务到家庭存款、食品杂货和假期，早在遗产传承之前，数十亿美元就在澳大利亚几代人之间流动。 对于肖恩和凯瑟琳来说，成为 10 个孩子的祖父母有时就像一份全职工作。 忙碌的一周可能意味着几乎每天都要见到一个或多个孙子，从接他们放学、带他们去运动、帮助他们做作业到为他们做饭。 这对夫妇都从事教育工作 45 年，他们有意识地决定成为积极的祖父母。 凯瑟琳甚至减少了工作时间，以便在父母全职工作时帮助照顾孙子。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 凯瑟琳告诉 SBS 的《Insight》：“他们无法承担每周 5 天的托儿服务。现在的费用太贵了。” “因此，为了照顾孩子，这对他们来说可以节省数百美元。” 可能没有金钱易手，但这种安排具有重大的财务价值。 肖恩和凯瑟琳是澳大利亚各代人之间更大的、通常基本上是看不见的支持流的一部分。 SBS CulturalConnect 的最新研究估计，澳大利亚老年人每年为年轻家庭成员提供价值超过 1,400 亿澳元的日常财务支持。 该研究对 50 名提供支持的父母和祖父母进行了深入访谈，随后对约 2,500 名澳大利亚人进行了调查。 研究发现，超过 1200 万澳大利亚人以某种方式支持年轻的成年家庭成员。 研究人员将其称为“助推经济”，即父母和祖父母还活着时，财富和经济支持在代际间流动。 它的范围远远超出了人们熟悉的帮助孩子进入房地产市场的“父母银行”。 在提供支持的人中，34%的人为年轻的家庭成员购买了杂货，33%的人支付了餐厅的餐费，30%的人购买了衣服。 近五分之一的人支付了旅行费用，14%的人购买了汽车，同样比例的人购买了电器或电子产品。 42% 的人提供了现金，19% 的人帮助偿还了债务。 1400亿澳元的估计不包括现金转移、债务偿还、住房和住房存款，而是反映了老年澳大利亚人为年轻家庭成员进行的日常购买规模。 Finder个人理财专家莎拉·梅金森(Sarah Megginson)表示，其研究表明，在家庭财务最大的领域之一：住房方面，对家庭财富的依赖已经显着增长。 Finder 最近发现，接受调查的房主中有 30% 收到过...

reflection.en: This news highlights the profound, often unquantified, ways families support one another across generations. The $140 billion figure represents not just financial aid, but also the investment of time and energy, such as grandparents providing childcare. It echoes the ancient wisdom that children are a blessing and a gift from Yahweh, a source of strength...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了家庭跨代支持的深刻且常常未被量化的方式。1400亿澳元这一数字不仅代表了经济援助，也象征着时间与精力的投入，例如祖父母提供的育儿支持。这与古老的智慧相呼应，即儿女是雅伟所赐的福分和恩典，是家庭和社会的活力与延续之源。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: 'A day that changed the world': 25 years on, Australia remembers 9/11
title.zh: “改变世界的一天”：澳大利亚纪念9/11事件25周年

summary.en: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese stated that the best of humanity was evident amidst the horror, while the Opposition leader called for a 'reckoning on terrorism.' Twenty-five years ago, the world watched in horror as hijacked airliners struck the World Trade Center in New York, killing 2,977 people and irrevocably...
summary.zh: 总理阿尔巴尼斯表示，在恐怖之中展现了人性的至善，而反对党领袖则呼吁对“恐怖主义进行清算”。二十五年前，全世界惊恐地注视着被劫持的飞机撞击纽约世界贸易中心，造成2977人死亡，永远地改变了世界。澳大利亚领导人和机构纷纷致敬，悼念遇难的十名澳大利亚人。

body.en:
Twenty-five years ago, the world watched with horror as two hijacked airliners plunged into the Twin Towers at the World Trade Centre in New York, part of a catastrophic attack that would kill 2,977 people and change the world forever.

A quarter-century on from the disaster that claimed lives from more than 90 countries — including ten Australians — tributes have poured in from Australian leaders and agencies.

In a video posted on social media, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called for a pause to reflect on "that darkest of days", and for Australians to think of the people across the world whose lives were changed forever "in scenes so confronting that they remain seared into our collective memory".

Albanese said that while it was a day that changed the world, the bravery seen amid the horror showed "the greater side of humanity".

"From New York to Washington, to Pennsylvania, so many people responded to terror with extraordinary courage, compassion and defiance," he said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"And together, they defined the spirit of a nation. We hold on to that, and we remember everyone who never came home from what should've been just an ordinary day in September."

Coinciding with the historic date is a new event in the relationship between Australia and the United States : the first NFL game played in Australia, held at the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) on Friday.

During the game, the Australian Defence Force teamed up with its US counterparts in a flyover to commemorate the lives lost 25 years ago.

"In a powerful display of unity and skill, the Royal Australian Air Force Roulettes will fly with the US Marine Corps Ospreys, in a mixed formation above the MCG for this historic event," the ADF said in a statement, adding that the defence force would provide additional ceremonial support at the NFL match, including a Flag Party.

Leader of the Opposition Angus Taylor said it was "hard to believe" that the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks had arrived.

"It is hard to fathom that an entire generation of young Australians have reached adulthood who were not born on 9/11. And yet, they have grown up in a post 9/11 world — a darker world. My four children are among them," Taylor said in a statement.

"We all remember where we were, and how we received the shocking news ... Of course, this was the pre-smartphone age, and many Australians would not see the news until the following morning. I was one of them ... The entire situation was unfathomable and surreal."

Taylor went on to describe his appreciation for then-prime minister John Howard's actions.

"In America’s darkest hour, Australia...
body.zh: 25 年前，全世界惊恐地看着两架被劫持的客机冲进纽约世贸中心双子塔，这是一场灾难性袭击的一部分，这场袭击造成 2,977 人死亡，并永远改变了世界。 这场导致 90 多个国家（包括 10 名澳大利亚人）丧生的灾难已经过去了四分之一个世纪，澳大利亚领导人和机构纷纷表达哀悼之情。 在社交媒体上发布的一段视频中，澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯呼吁暂停，反思“那段最黑暗的日子”，并让澳大利亚人想想世界各地的人们，他们的生活“在如此面对的场景中永远被改变，以至于他们仍然深深地烙印在我们的集体记忆中”。 阿尔巴内斯说，虽然这是改变世界的一天，但在恐怖中看到的勇敢展现了“人性更伟大的一面”。 他说：“从纽约到华盛顿，再到宾夕法尼亚州，许多人以非凡的勇气、同情心和反抗来应对恐怖。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “他们共同定义了一个国家的精神。我们坚持这一点，我们记住每一个从未从九月的平凡日子中回家的人。” 与这一历史性日期相一致的是澳大利亚和美国关系中的一个新事件：第一场 NFL 比赛于周五在墨尔本板球场 (MCG) 在澳大利亚举行。 比赛期间，澳大利亚国防军与美国国防军联手在天桥上纪念25年前逝去的生命。 ADF 在一份声明中表示：“澳大利亚皇家空军轮盘将与美国海军陆战队鱼鹰机队一起在 MCG 上方以混合编队飞行，以有力地展示团结和技能，参加这一历史性活动。”并补充说，国防军将在 NFL 比赛中提供额外的仪式支持，包括举行国旗派对。 反对党领袖安格斯·泰勒表示，“很难相信”9 月 11 日袭击事件 25 周年已经到来。 泰勒在一份声明中说：“很难想象，不是出生在 9/11 的整整一代澳大利亚年轻人都成年了。然而，他们是在 9/11 后的世界中长大的——一个更加黑暗的世界。我的四个孩子也在其中。” “我们都记得我们在哪里，以及如何收到这个令人震惊的消息……当然，这是智能手机时代之前的时代，许多澳大利亚人直到第二天早上才会看到这个新闻。我就是其中之一……整个情况是深不可测和超现实的。” 泰勒接着表达了他对时任总理约翰·霍华德行为的赞赏。 “在美国最黑暗的时刻，澳大利亚......

reflection.en: Twenty-five years after the horrific attacks of September 11, 2001, Australia joins the world in remembrance. The tragedy claimed the lives of ten Australians and countless others, leaving an indelible mark on global history. As leaders call for a reckoning on terrorism, we are reminded of the enduring challenge to overcome evil not with more violence, but...
reflection.zh: 2001年9月11日恐怖袭击事件发生二十五年后，澳大利亚与世界一同缅怀。这场悲剧夺去了十名澳大利亚人以及无数其他人的生命，给全球历史留下了不可磨灭的印记。当领导人呼吁对恐怖主义进行清算时，我们被提醒要面对一个持久的挑战：以坚定的良善和对和平的承诺来克服邪恶，而非以更多的暴力回应。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

title.zh: 香港：三名前六四守夜组织者因颠覆罪被判刑

summary.en: Three former leaders of the group that organized the June 4th vigils have been sentenced to prison for subversion, marking a significant development in the city's legal and political landscape.
summary.zh: 组织六四守夜活动的三名前领导人因颠覆罪被判处监禁，这是该市法律和政治格局中的一个重要事态发展。

reflection.en: The sentencing of these former leaders raises questions about justice and accountability. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God. May there be a path toward reconciliation and a just resolution for all involved.
reflection.zh: 这几位前领导人的判刑引发了关于公正和问责的疑问。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与神同行。愿所有相关各方都能找到和解与公正解决的道路。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Police search for man in lottery winnings dispute
title.zh: 警方搜寻涉嫌侵吞彩票奖金失踪男子

summary.en: Police are searching for a 36-year-old man who has allegedly absconded with lottery winnings after failing to share the prize money with 14 colleagues who pooled funds for a Mark Six ticket. The man, who placed the bet, is suspected of depositing the winnings into his personal account and refusing to distribute the...
summary.zh: 警方正在搜寻一名36岁男子，他涉嫌在与14名同事合资购买的六合彩彩票中奖后，拒绝分享奖金并携款潜逃。该男子负责投注，据称他将奖金存入个人账户后拒绝均分，导致同事报警。警方已将此案列为盗窃案进行调查。

body.en: Police are searching for a man who has disappeared after allegedly refusing to share lottery winnings with his colleagues who pooled money for a Mark Six ticket. Officers said they are investigating a theft case involving a 36-year-old man and 14 of his colleagues who jointly paid for a Mark Six ticket last Saturday. The man was responsible for placing the bet. After the group won, police said the prize money was deposited into his account. He is suspected of refusing to split the winnings equally with his colleagues. The man then did not contact the group, prompting his colleagues to report the matter to police. Officers are now searching for him. The estimated first division prize fund for the Snowball Draw is HK$228 million. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 警方正在寻找一名失踪的男子，该男子据称拒绝与凑钱购买马克六号彩票的同事分享彩票奖金。警方表示，他们正在调查一起盗窃案，该案涉及一名 36 岁男子和他的 14 名同事，他们上周六共同购买了一张马克六号门票。该男子负责下注。该团体获胜后，警方称奖金已存入他的账户。他涉嫌拒绝与同事平分奖金。该男子随后没有联系该组织，促使他的同事向警方报案。官员们现在正在寻找他。滚雪球抽奖的一等奖奖金预计为港币2.28亿元。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The allure of sudden wealth can test the integrity of even close colleagues. This incident highlights how the pursuit of money can fracture trust and lead to deceit, turning a shared joy into a source of conflict and loss. May we be reminded that true wealth lies not in material gain, but in faithfulness, integrity, and the bonds of community that money can...
reflection.zh: 一夜暴富的诱惑足以考验同事间的诚信。这起事件表明，对金钱的追逐会破坏信任并导致欺骗，将本应同享的喜悦变成冲突和损失的根源。 愿我们铭记，真正的财富不在于物质所得，而在于忠诚、正直以及金钱轻易就能摧毁的社群联系。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: ‘Rest in eternal peace’: veteran horror actor, filmmaker Simon Loui dies at age 62
title.zh: 资深恐怖演员、电影制作人卢海鹏享年62岁，愿您安息

summary.en: Veteran Hong Kong actor and filmmaker Simon Loui Yu-yeung, known as the “King of Ghosts” for his extensive work in horror films, has passed away at the age of 62. His wife confirmed he died in a Guangzhou hospital on Monday after a battle with gastric cancer. The family opted for a low-profile announcement.
summary.zh: 香港资深演员兼电影制作人卢海鹏（Simon Loui Yu-yeung），因其在恐怖片中的大量作品而被粉丝称为“鬼王”，近日以62岁之龄辞世。其妻子证实，他于周一在广州一家医院因胃癌病逝。家属希望保持低调，未作大肆宣扬。

body.en: Veteran Hong Kong actor and filmmaker Simon Loui Yu-yeung, better known to fans as the “King of Ghosts” for his prolific work in horror films, has died at the age of 62. Long-time friend and fellow actor Frankie Ng Chi-hung revealed to reporters on Friday that Loui’s wife, TV and radio personality Ma Li, had confirmed the filmmaker had died in a hospital in Guangzhou on Monday after losing his battle with gastric cancer. “The family hoped to stay low profile. There was no big announcement,” Ng...
body.zh: 香港资深演员兼电影制片人雷宇扬去世，享年 62 岁。雷宇扬因其多产的恐怖片作品而被影迷称为“鬼王”。他的老友兼演员吴志雄周五向记者透露，雷宇扬的妻子、电视和电台名人马丽证实，雷宇扬周一在广州的一家医院因胃癌而去世。 “家人希望保持低调。没有发布重大公告，”吴...

reflection.en: The news of Simon Loui's passing at 62 reminds us of the universal reality of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 states that it is appointed for all people to die, a truth that touches every life, regardless of fame or talent. In the face of such loss, we are called to reflect on the brevity of our time and the eternal hope that transcends this earthly existence.
reflection.zh: 卢海鹏先生以62岁辞世的消息，提醒我们死亡是全人类的普遍现实。希伯来书9章27节指出，人人都有一死，这是触及每个生命的真理，无论其名声或才华如何。面对这样的损失，我们被呼召反思生命的短暂，以及超越此世存在的永恒盼望。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Silver bond issue hits new highs on multiple fronts
title.zh: 银债发行在多方面创下新高

summary.en: Hong Kong's government announced on Friday that subscribers to its latest batch of silver bonds could receive up to 13 lots each, as both the number of applicants and the subscription amount reached record highs. The government received 476,703 applications for its 11th batch of silver bonds, designed for senior...
summary.zh: 香港政府周五宣布，其最新一批银色债券的认购者每人最多可获13手，申请人数和认购金额均创下历史新高。政府收到第11批银色债券的申请共计476,703份，该债券专为老年人设计，此次保证年息率为4.25%。认购总额达到1193亿港元，远超最终发行额550亿港元的两倍以上。

body.en: The government announced on Friday that people subscribing to its latest batch of silver bonds could receive up to 13 lots each, as the number of applicants as well as the subscription amount hit record highs. In a statement, the government said it received a total of 476,703 applications for its 11th batch of silver bonds – designed for senior citizens with a guaranteed annual coupon of 4.25 percent this time. The total subscription amount reached HK$119.3 billion, representing an over-subscription rate of more than double the final issuance amount of HK$55 billion. The government had originally aimed to issue HK$50 billion of the three-year silver bonds this year before raising it to HK$55 billion due to high demand. The 88,422 investors who applied for 12 lots or fewer will receive the full allotment they sought, with each lot costing HK$10,000. The remaining 388,281 investors who applied for more than 12 lots will first be allocated 12 lots – before a lottery draw is held to determine those who get the extra one. Authorities said over 97,000 people would get an extra lot. Commenting on the bond issuance this time, Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the new highs in both the number of applicants and subscription amount reflect the popularity of silver bonds among the elderly as a safe and stable investment option. He also noted that the funds raised from this batch of bond issuance would be used to finance infrastructure projects and improve people's lives. Chan said the government would continue to review the issuance arrangements of the silver bonds – after taking into consideration market conditions and subscription reactions. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 政府周五宣布，认购最新一批白银债券的人每人最多可获得 13 手，申请数量和认购金额均创历史新高。政府在一份声明中表示，第11批白银债券共收到476,703份申请，该债券专为老年人设计，保证年利率为4.25%。认购总额达1,193亿港元，超额认购率为最终发行额550亿港元的两倍以上。政府原本计划今年发行500亿港元的三年期白银债券，但因需求旺盛而将其增至550亿港元。申请12手或以下的88,422名投资者将获得他们所寻求的全部配额，每手售价为10,000港元。剩余的 388,281 名申请超过 12 手的投资者将首先被分配 12 手，然后进行抽奖以确定获得额外手的人。当局表示，超过 97,000 人将获得额外的福利。谈及本次债券发行，财政司司长陈茂波表示，申请人数和认购金额均创新高，反映白银债券作为安全稳定的投资选择，深受老年人欢迎。他还表示，本次债券发行所募集的资金将用于支持基础设施项目和改善人民生活。陈表示，政府将在考虑市场状况和认购反应后，继续审查白银债券的发行安排。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: This news highlights a significant financial undertaking by the Hong Kong government, resulting in record-breaking participation. It speaks to the importance of diligent planning and execution in public service. Committing our endeavors, whether personal or governmental, to Yahweh's guidance can lead to fruitful outcomes, as Proverbs 16:3 reminds us,...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了香港政府一项重大的金融举措，并取得了破纪录的参与度。它说明了在公共服务中勤勉规划和有效执行的重要性。《箴言》16:3提醒我们：“你要将所行的事交托雅伟，你所定的计ก็จะ成就。” 将我们的努力，无论是个人的还是政府的，都交托给雅伟的指引，可以带来丰硕的成果。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: ‘People will be shocked and angry’: Relatives, friends of jailed Tiananmen activists decry ‘unjust’ sentences
title.zh: “人们会感到震惊和愤怒”：被监禁的“六四”活动人士的亲友谴责“不公正”的判决

summary.en: Relatives of three Tiananmen vigil activists sentenced on Friday for inciting subversion have decried their years-long prison terms as “totally unjust,” and have said that two of the defendants will appeal. Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, leaders of the now-defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic...
summary.zh: 周五，三名参与“六四”守夜活动的活动人士因煽动颠覆国家政权罪被判处多年监禁，他们的亲属对此判决表示“完全不公正”，并称其中两人将提出上诉。已解散的“香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会”的领导人李卓人被判处七年监禁，周汉鼎被判处七年零三个月监禁。该联盟的另一位领导人何俊仁是三人中唯一认罪的人，被判处十二个月监禁。

body.en: Relatives of three Tiananmen vigil activists sentenced on Friday for inciting subversion have decried their years-long prison terms as “totally unjust,” and have said that two of the defendants will appeal. Elizabeth Tang (second from left), mother of Chow (middle) and Lau Ka-yee (first from right) met the press after sentences on September 11, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, leaders of the now-defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, were handed jail terms of seven years and seven years and three months, respectively. Fellow Alliance leader Albert Ho, the only one of the trio to plead guilty, received a sentence of five years and two months. The Alliance, which was also convicted and fined HK$1.5 million, held annual vigils to remember China’s 1989 Tiananmen crackdown. Elizabeth Tang outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on Friday, September 11, 2026, ahead of the sentencing of Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tung, Albert Ho, and her husband Lee Cheuk-yan. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Lee’s wife, Elizabeth Tang, told reporters outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building that the sentence, delivered by a panel of designated national security judges, was “unacceptable.” “It’s a sad day for me as his wife,” Tang said in Cantonese. “I cannot imagine that he has to spend another three years in jail.” “People will be shocked and angry,” she added. “Millions of people were there in Victoria Park [for the vigil].” Family members and friends of Tiananmen vigil activists meet the press on September 11, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Tang said Chow and Lee intend to launch an appeal against their convictions and sentences. June 4th memories ‘reopened’ Chow Hang-tung’s mother, who declined to give her name to press, said on Friday that her daughter was proud to represent herself in court. “She once said: ‘It feels great, I can finally take off my barrister’s robe and speak the truth freely on my own behalf’,” Chow’s mother recalled her daughter saying. Mother of Chow Hang-tung meets the press on September 11, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP, “I don’t know whether I should thank those who dragged her to the dock,” Chow’s mother said. “Thanks to them, the memories of June 4th were reopened. Thanks to them, the truth of June 4th and everything that has happened in Hong Kong over these years has been entered into Hong Kong court records.” The Tiananmen crackdown occurred on June 4, 1989, ending months of student-led demonstrations in China. It is estimated that hundreds, perhaps thousands, died when the People’s...
body.zh: 周五因煽动颠覆罪被判刑的三名天安门守夜活动人士的亲属谴责他们长达数年的监禁“完全不公正”，并表示其中两名被告将上诉。 2026 年 9 月 11 日，周先生（中）和刘嘉儿（右一）的母亲邓丽君（左二）在宣判后会见媒体。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。现已解散的香港爱国民主运动联盟领导人李卓人和周恒东分别被判处七年和七年零三个月徒刑。联盟领导人何俊仁是三人中唯一认罪的人，被判处五年零两个月的徒刑。该联盟也被定罪并被罚款 150 万港元，该联盟每年都会举行守夜活动，以纪念中国 1989 年的天安门镇压。 2026 年 9 月 11 日星期五，伊丽莎白·唐在西九龙法院大楼外，天安门守夜活动人士周恒东、何俊仁和她的丈夫李卓人即将被判刑。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。李的妻子伊丽莎白·唐(Elizabeth Tang)在西九龙法院大楼外告诉记者，由指定的国家安全法官组成的小组做出的判决“令人无法接受”。 “作为他的妻子，这对我来说是悲伤的一天，”唐用广东话说道。 “我无法想象他还要在监狱里再呆三年。” “人们会感到震惊和愤怒，”她补充道。 “数百万人在维多利亚公园[守夜]。”天安门守夜活动人士的家人和朋友于 2026 年 9 月 11 日与媒体会面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。唐说，周和李打算对他们的定罪和判刑提出上诉。 6 月 4 日的记忆“重新开启”周恒东的母亲拒绝向媒体透露姓名，她周五表示，她的女儿很自豪能够在法庭上代表自己。 “她曾经说过：‘感觉太棒了，我终于可以脱掉律师的袍子，代表我自己自由地说出真相了’，”周妈妈回忆女儿说。周恒东的母亲于 2026 年 9 月 11 日会见媒体。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP，“我不知道是否应该感谢那些把她拖到被告席上的人，”周恒东的母亲说。 “感谢他们，重新开​​启了6月4日的记忆。感谢他们，6月4日的真相以及这些年香港发生的一切都被载入了香港法庭记录。”天安门镇压发生于 1989 年 6 月 4 日，结束了中国学生领导的数月示威活动。据估计，当人民...

reflection.en: The families of Lee Cheuk-yan, Chow Hang-tung, and Albert Ho are calling their sentences “totally unjust.” This echoes the ancient cry for justice, a fundamental theme in scripture. May Yahweh hear their plea and may righteousness prevail, flowing like a mighty river through the courts and into society.
reflection.zh: 李卓人、周汉鼎和何俊仁的家属称他们的判决“完全不公正”。这呼应了古老的对公义的呼求，这是圣经中的一个基本主题。愿雅伟垂听他们的祈求，愿公义如大河奔腾，流淌在法庭和社会之中。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Hong Kong and Indonesia to host inaugural 14-team FIFA ASEAN Cup this month
title.zh: 香港和印度尼西亚将主办本月首届14支球队的国际足联东盟杯

summary.en: The inaugural FIFA ASEAN Cup, featuring 14 teams, will be held this month with matches taking place in Indonesia and Hong Kong. The tournament, starting September 24, includes the 11 ASEAN member nations and three guest teams: Hong Kong, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. The top-tier Division 1 will see eight teams compete,...
summary.zh: 首届国际足联东盟杯将于本月举行，共有14支球队参赛，比赛将在印度尼西亚和香港进行。该赛事将于9月24日开始，包括11个东盟成员国以及三个特邀球队：中国香港、巴基斯坦和孟加拉国。顶级的第一组将有八支球队争夺出线权，胜者将于10月5日进入决赛。

body.en: An inaugural FIFA ASEAN Cup will take place later this month featuring 14 teams with matches played in Indonesia and Hong Kong, organisers said on Thursday. FIFA ASEAN Cup. Photo: FIFA ASEAN Cup. The 11 members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and three guest sides — Hong Kong, Pakistan and Bangladesh — will play in two divisions from September 24. Eight teams will contest the top-tier Division 1 — hosts Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Bangladesh and Pakistan. They will be split into two sections of four with the winners contesting the first FIFA ASEAN Cup final on October 5. FIFA chief Gianni Infantino. Photo: Kremlin. The second-tier Division 2 will be hosted by Hong Kong and also involve Brunei, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar and Timor-Leste, split into two three-team sections with the winners advancing to a final on October 3. “The FIFA ASEAN Cup was launched to provide national teams with meaningful competitive opportunities,” said FIFA president Gianni Infantino. “The tournament will strengthen football ties across Southeast Asia.”
body.zh: 组织者周四表示，首届国际足联东盟杯将于本月晚些时候举行，共有 14 支球队参加，比赛将在印度尼西亚和香港举行。国际足联东盟杯。照片：国际足联东盟杯。东南亚国家联盟 (ASEAN) 的 11 个成员国和三支客队（中国香港、巴基斯坦和孟加拉国）将从 9 月 24 日起进行两个级别的比赛。八支球队将参加顶级级别 1 的比赛，东道主包括印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡、泰国、越南、孟加拉国和巴基斯坦。他们将分为两部分，每组四人，获胜者将参加 10 月 5 日举行的首届 FIFA 东盟杯决赛。 国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺 (Gianni Infantino)。照片：克里姆林宫。第二级别联赛将由香港主办，文莱、柬埔寨、老挝、缅甸和东帝汶也将参加，分为两个三队小组，胜者将晋级10月3日的决赛。“国际足联东盟杯的推出是为了给国家队提供有意义的竞争机会，”国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺表示。 “这项赛事将加强整个东南亚的足球联系。”

reflection.en: The launch of the first-ever FIFA ASEAN Cup signifies a new beginning in regional football cooperation. As organizers and teams embark on this ambitious project, they are reminded that success often hinges on careful planning and entrusting their endeavors to a higher power. May this new tournament foster unity and sportsmanship, reflecting the wisdom of...
reflection.zh: 首届国际足联东盟杯的启动，标志着区域足球合作的新篇章。当组织者和球队着手这项宏伟的计划时，他们被提醒成功往往取决于周密的计划，并将他们的努力托付给更高的力量。愿这项新赛事促进团结和体育精神，体现将工作交托于雅伟的智慧。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...

title.en: Scientists discover a strange new form of ice that could help explain the interiors of Neptune and Uranus
title.zh: 科学家发现一种奇特的冰，可能有助于解释海王星和天王星的内部

summary.en: Scientists have discovered a new form of ice that exists deep within planets like Neptune and Uranus. To understand its behavior under such extreme conditions, they recreated these environments in a laboratory setting. This research, led by Alexis Forestier, aims to improve our understanding of planetary interiors and...
summary.zh: 科学家们发现了一种存在于海王星和天王星等行星深处的新型冰。为了了解其在极端条件下的行为，他们在实验室中重现了这些环境。这项由 Alexis Forestier 领导的研究旨在增进我们对行星内部及其磁场的理解。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Scientists have discovered that there is ice deep inside planets like Neptune and Uranus and want to find out what form it takes and how it behaves. They cannot dig for it and transport it all the way back to Earth, so they do the next best thing: recreate those extreme conditions in the lab.

That's exactly what a team of scientists led by Alexis Forestier from the CEA, France's Alternative Energies and Atomic Energy Commission, did. What they discovered could help us better understand the strange magnetic fields and deep interior layers of these distant worlds.

On those planets, ice is not like the frozen cubes you put into a cold drink. It enters a weird state known as superionic ice because of the immense heat and pressure it is under. In this exotic phase, oxygen atoms lock into a solid grid while hydrogen nuclei flow freely through it like a liquid, allowing it to conduct electricity. Scientists already knew this hot, conducting ice existed, but they did not know what specific crystal shapes it formed.

To find out, they squeezed tiny samples of ice between two ultra-hard diamonds inside a device called a diamond anvil cell. They heated this trapped ice with lasers to over 1,800 Kelvin. They subjected it to pressures reaching 230 gigapascals, more than 2 million times Earth's atmospheric pressure.

And what they discovered was remarkable. X-ray diffraction at the European Synchrotron Radiation Facility revealed that the oxygen atoms had locked into a hexagonal pattern known as hexagonal close-packed (hcp). Above 200 gigapascals and 1,800 Kelvin, this form became the dominant phase of superionic ice, replacing the face-centered cubic (fcc) phase, as the team detailed in their paper published in Physical Review Letters .

"We report the unambiguous observation of a novel H 2 O ice phase adopting an hcp oxygen sublattice," the study authors commented.

What makes the research significant is that it could help us get a clearer picture of what is happening deep inside our solar system's icy giants. In planets like Uranus and Neptune, superionic ice has been proposed as playing a role in generating their unusual magnetic fields. Because the hexagonal form may have different electrical and mechanical properties from the cubic one, the discovery could change how scientists model those planetary interiors.

"The presence of an fcc-hcp martensitic transition in the superionic regime of warm dense ice may have implications for planetary models of Uranus and Neptune."

Written for you by our author Paul Arnold , edited by Gaby Clark , and fact-checked and reviewed by Robert...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 科学家发现海王星和天王星等行星深处存在冰，并希望了解它的形式和行为。他们无法挖掘它并将其一路运回地球，因此他们做了退而求其次的事情：在实验室中重现那些极端条件。 这正是法国替代能源和原子能委员会 Alexis Forestier 领导的科学家团队所做的事情。他们的发现可以帮助我们更好地了解这些遥远世界的奇怪磁场和深层内层。 在这些行星上，冰不像你放入冷饮中的冷冻块。由于它承受着巨大的热量和压力，它进入了一种被称为超离子冰的奇怪状态。在这个奇异的阶段，氧原子锁定在固体网格中，而氢原子核像液体一样自由地流过它，使其能够导电。科学家们已经知道这种热的导电冰的存在，但他们不知道它形成的具体晶体形状。 为了找到答案，他们在称为金刚石砧室的装置内的两颗超硬钻石之间挤压了微小的冰样本。他们用激光将这些被困的冰加热到超过 1,800 开尔文。他们对其施加的压力达到 230 吉帕斯卡，是地球大气压的 200 万倍以上。 他们的发现是非凡的。欧洲同步辐射设施的 X 射线衍射表明，氧原子已锁定为六角形图案，称为六方密排 (hcp)。正如该团队在《物理评论快报》上发表的论文中详细介绍的那样，在 200 吉帕斯卡和 1,800 开尔文以上，这种形式成为超离子冰的主要相，取代了面心立方 (fcc) 相。 “我们报告了采用 hcp 氧亚晶格的新型 H 2 O 冰相的明确观察结果，”研究作者评论道。 这项研究的意义在于它可以帮助我们更清楚地了解太阳系冰巨星深处正在发生的事情。在天王星和海王星等行星中，超离子冰被认为在产生异常磁场方面发挥了作用。由于六边形可能具有与立方体不同的电气和机械特性，这一发现可能会改变科学家对这些行星内部结构的建模方式。 “在温暖致密冰的超离子状态中存在面心立方-六面体马氏体转变可能会对天王星和海王星的行星模型产生影响。” 由我们的作者 Paul Arnold 为您撰写，由 Gaby Clark 编辑，并由 Robert 进行事实检查和审阅...

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge about the cosmos, even in the form of ice under immense pressure, reflects a deep human curiosity about God's creation. By recreating extreme conditions in the lab, scientists are, in a sense, asking the earth and its elements to reveal their secrets, mirroring the ancient wisdom that creation itself testifies to its Maker. This...
reflection.zh: 对宇宙知识的追求，即使是以巨大压力下的冰的形式，也反映了人类对雅伟创造物的深切好奇。通过在实验室中重现极端条件，科学家们在某种意义上是在让大地及其元素揭示它们的秘密，这呼应了古老的智慧——创造物本身就见证了其创造者。 这项努力提醒我们，理解宇宙，从最小的冰晶到最大的行星，都是一种探索雅伟精妙设计和力量的方式。

This smart pen detects pressure and movement during writing tasks, aiming to identify difficulties like dysgraphia and dysorthography earlier than traditional methods.

The study involved more than 700 children from primary and lower secondary school. The participants used the THInkPen (Tele-Health Ink Pen) while completing two BVSCO-3 tasks from the Battery for the Clinical Assessment of Writing and Orthographic Skills. This is the most widely used test in Italy for assessing writing difficulties, dysgraphia and dysorthography.

Yahweh的智慧在人类的探索中闪耀，正如这项新技术帮助我们更早地理解和支持有学习困难的孩子。通过创新和细致的观察，我们可以为下一代提供更好的成长环境。

title.en: Fertilizers and extreme heat are damaging coral reefs in the Gulf of Mexico, isotope analyses reveal
title.zh: 同位素分析显示，化肥和极端高温正在破坏墨西哥湾的珊瑚礁

summary.en: Isotope analyses have revealed that fertilizers and extreme heat are damaging coral reefs in the Gulf of Mexico. These vital ecosystems, often depicted in popular culture, are facing global pressure from climate change and pollution, leading to coral bleaching and death, even threatening previously resilient reefs in...
summary.zh: 同位素分析显示，化肥和极端高温正在破坏墨西哥湾的珊瑚礁。这些重要的生态系统，常在流行文化中出现，正面临着气候变化和污染带来的全球性压力，导致珊瑚白化和死亡，甚至威胁到墨西哥湾北部花花园浅滩国家海洋保护区内原本极具韧性的珊瑚礁。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Who isn't familiar with the colorful coral reefs from movies like "Finding Nemo" or "The Little Mermaid"? Unfortunately, the reality is often quite different, as these vital ecosystems are under pressure worldwide. Climate change and pollution are causing corals to bleach and die. Even the most resilient coral reefs of the United States are now threatened.

The reefs in the Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary in the northern Gulf of Mexico were long considered exceptionally healthy due to their high coral coverage. But rising water temperatures and an excess of nutrients are causing even these reefs to lose their resilience.

An international research team led by the Max Planck Institute for Chemistry and Louisiana State University has discovered that the high levels of nitrogen in the northern Gulf originate from the Mississippi River and are attributable to fertilizer use.

The team analyzed nitrogen isotopes in the calcareous skeletons of corals and used the data to reconstruct the source of nitrogen in seawater over the past 270 years.

The results show that, in recent decades, more than 60% and, during certain periods, up to 80% of the nitrogen in the Flower Garden Banks originated from the Mississippi River basin.

According to the study, published in the journal Science Advances , the highest nitrogen inputs occurred in 2016 and between 2022 and 2023. It was precisely during these years that the reefs suffered exceptional heat waves, massive coral bleaching events and increased disease outbreaks.

The Mainz researchers analyzed core samples from star corals in the northern Gulf of Mexico. These stony corals grow slowly but continuously and live to a very old age. Similar to the annual rings of trees, the corals form their calcareous skeletons in layers, making them an excellent archive of environmental conditions. As a result, the scientists were able to determine the nitrogen isotopes present in the corals from 1753 to 2023.

The isotopic fingerprint of nitrogen (N), more specifically, the ratio of heavy 15 N to light 14 N, carries information about the origin of the nutrients consumed by the coral.

Using this technique, the team could determine the origin of the water in which the corals grew. The coral cores were collected during an expedition by the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA).

reflection.en: The Genesis account declares creation 'very good,' a testament to its inherent beauty and purpose. Yet, human activities like fertilizer runoff and extreme heat, as detailed in this report, inflict damage on delicate ecosystems like coral reefs. This calls us to a deeper stewardship, recognizing our responsibility to care for the world entrusted to us.

title.en: Giant volcanic blanket reveals hidden 'Pompeii' of Andean landscapes
title.zh: 巨型火山毯揭示隐藏的安第斯景观“庞贝”

summary.en: A massive layer of volcanic rock in the Andes has preserved evidence of a landscape that existed 22 million years ago, according to research led by UCL.
summary.zh: 根据伦敦大学学院（UCL）领导的一项新研究，安第斯山脉中一片巨大的火山岩层保存了2200万年前存在的埋藏景观的线索。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A vast sheet of volcanic rock in the Andes has preserved clues to a buried landscape that existed 22 million years ago, according to a new study led by UCL (University College London) researchers.

The study, published in Science Advances , shows that a giant volcanic eruption acted a little like Vesuvius, but across an entire landscape, burying the terrain beneath it and preserving information that would otherwise have been lost to erosion and deformation.

For the study, the researchers looked at the vast expanse of volcanic rock that erupted from the Lauca Caldera in northern Chile 21.9 million years ago. A caldera is a large volcanic depression formed during major eruptions. A mountain's worth of rock, called ignimbrite, covered an area six times as large as Chile's capital, Santiago (or nearly three times as large as Greater London), reaching 1 kilometer (0.6 miles) deep in places.

The research team simulated hundreds of possible ancient landscapes, using models of how rivers shape mountain ranges, to test which ones could plausibly have been buried beneath the volcanic deposit. They found that only relatively low-relief landscapes—akin to gentle mountain foothills—could have done so.

From this, the team inferred that this part of the Andes was being built slowly, with rocks pushed upward by no more than 0.26 kilometer every million years—equivalent to 2.5 cm, or about an inch, every 100 years.

If rocks had been pushed upward faster in this region, the landscape would probably have developed steeper slopes that could not have fit beneath the immense volcanic deposits.

The finding lends support to the idea that the Andes grew slowly and steadily over tens of millions of years rather than popping up more recently, in the last few million years.

This rate is slow compared with many rapidly uplifting parts of active mountain belts, including parts of the Himalayas, where uplift and erosion can occur at rates of several millimeters to centimeters per year.

Lead author Dr. Byron Adams, based at UCL Earth Sciences, said, "This landscape was buried by a giant volcanic eruption—a little like Pompeii, but on a vastly larger scale. Instead of covering a town, hot mixtures of volcanic ash, rock fragments and gas swept across an entire landscape, engulfing the terrain beneath them.

"Pompeii shows how volcanic eruptions can freeze a moment in human history. This study shows that much larger eruptions can also freeze moments in Earth history, burying whole landscapes beneath volcanic deposits and preserving clues to how mountains were being built before the eruption.

"We...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 根据伦敦大学学院 (UCL) 研究人员领导的一项新研究，安第斯山脉的一大片火山岩保存了 2200 万年前存在的埋藏景观的线索。 这项发表在《科学进展》上的研究表明，一次巨大的火山喷发有点像维苏威火山，但它跨越了整个景观，将其下方的地形掩埋起来，并保留了原本会因侵蚀和变形而丢失的信息。 在这项研究中，研究人员观察了 2190 万年前从智利北部劳卡火山口喷发的大片火山岩。破火山口是大型火山喷发时形成的大型火山洼地。相当于一座山的岩石，称为火凝灰岩，覆盖的面积是智利首都圣地亚哥的六倍（或大伦敦的近三倍），有些地方深达 1 公里（0.6 英里）。 研究小组使用河流如何塑造山脉的模型模拟了数百种可能的古代景观，以测试哪些景观可能被埋在火山沉积物之下。他们发现，只有地势相对较低的景观（类似于平缓的山麓）才能做到这一点。 由此，研究小组推断，安第斯山脉的这一部分正在缓慢建造，岩石每百万年向上推升不超过0.26公里，相当于每100年推升2.5厘米，即大约一英寸。 如果该地区的岩石向上推得更快，地貌可能会形成更陡的斜坡，而这些斜坡无法适应巨大的火山沉积物。 这一发现支持了这样一种观点，即安第斯山脉在数千万年里缓慢而稳定地生长，而不是在最近几百万年里突然出现。 与许多活跃山脉快速隆起的地区相比，这个速度是缓慢的，包括喜马拉雅山的部分地区，那里的隆起和侵蚀可能以每年几毫米到厘米的速度发生。 伦敦大学学院地球科学中心的主要作者拜伦·亚当斯博士说：“这片土地被一次巨大的火山喷发所掩埋——有点像庞贝古城，但规模要大得多。火山灰、岩石碎片和气体的炽热混合物没有覆盖整个城镇，而是席卷了整个景观，吞没了它们下面的地形。 “庞贝古城展示了火山喷发如何冻结人类历史上的某个时刻。这项研究表明，更大规模的火山喷发也会冻结地球历史上的时刻，将整个景观埋在火山沉积物之下，并保留火山喷发前山脉如何形成的线索。 “我们...

reflection.en: This discovery in the Andes, where volcanic ash has preserved a 22-million-year-old landscape, reminds us of the immense timescales and hidden histories within the earth. It prompts us to consider the limits of our own understanding when faced with the deep past and the powerful forces that shaped our world, much like the questions posed in Job about the...
reflection.zh: 在安第斯山脉的这一发现，火山灰保存了2200万年前的景观，提醒我们地球内部存在着巨大的时间尺度和隐藏的历史。它促使我们思考，当我们面对遥远的过去和塑造我们世界的强大力量时，我们自身理解的局限性，这与《约伯记》中对大地根基提出的疑问相似。

verse.textEn: Where were you when I laid the earth's foundation? Tell me, if you understand.
verse.textZh: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？你若有聪明，只管说吧。

title.en: New study offers a detailed look at how wildfire smoke impacts Reno's air quality
title.zh: 新研究详细分析野火烟雾如何影响里诺的空气质量

summary.en: As Western wildfires grow larger, last longer, and become more intense, millions of Americans are exposed to wildfire smoke annually. California experienced a tenfold increase in fires in 2020 and 2021 compared to its history. Northern Nevada often receives smoke from these fires, leading to months of hazy skies for...
summary.zh: 随着西部野火的规模、持续时间和强度不断增加，每年有数百万美国人暴露在野火烟雾之下。加州在2020年和2021年经历了比历史上任何时期都多十倍的火灾。内华达州北部接收了加州野火的大部分烟雾，导致里诺居民数月天空被烟雾笼罩。一项新研究深入分析了烟雾中潜在的有害化学物质。

body.en: With Western wildfires increasing in size, duration and intensity, millions of Americans are now exposed to wildfire smoke each year. In California, 2020 and 2021 were particularly challenging, with a 10-fold increase in fires compared with any time in the state's history. Northern Nevada is positioned to receive much of the smoke from California wildfires, and Reno residents experienced months of smoke-shrouded skies during this time. Now, a new study gives us a deeper look into the potentially hazardous chemicals lurking in this smoke.
body.zh: 随着西部野火规模、持续时间和强度的增加，每年有数百万美国人暴露在野火烟雾中。在加利福尼亚州，2020 年和 2021 年尤其具有挑战性，火灾数量比该州历史上任何时期都增加了 10 倍。内华达州北部接收了加州野火的大部分烟雾，里诺居民在此期间经历了数月烟雾笼罩的天空。现在，一项新研究让我们更深入地了解潜伏在烟雾中的潜在危险化学物质。

reflection.en: The Psalmist marvels at the wisdom evident in creation, from the vastness of the seas to the intricate details of life. This new study, by dissecting the complex chemical composition of wildfire smoke, echoes this sense of wonder at the intricate, and sometimes hazardous, systems Yahweh has woven into our world. Understanding these elements, even the...
reflection.zh: 诗人惊叹于创造中显而易见的智慧，从海洋的浩瀚到生命的精妙细节。这项新研究通过剖析野火烟雾复杂的化学成分，呼应了对雅伟编织在我们世界中的复杂乃至危险的系统的惊奇感。理解这些元素，即使是危险的元素，也是一种与创造的深邃智慧互动的方式。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: AI extracts interpretable constitutive laws directly from solid-mechanics data
title.zh: 人工智能从固体力学数据中提取可解释的本构定律

summary.en: Researchers at the Eastern Institute of Technology (EIT), Ningbo, have developed a graph-based approach that directly extracts concise, accurate constitutive equations from solid-material experimental data. The study, published in Science Advances, describes a method for discovering constitutive models for alloy...
summary.zh: 宁波东方理工大学（EIT）的研究人员开发了一种基于图的方法，可以直接从固体材料的实验数据中提取简洁、准确的本构方程。这项发表在《科学进展》上的研究描述了一种用于发现合金钢、锂金属和填充橡胶的本构模型的方法。其预测精度优于主流的经验模型，同时保留了明确的、物理上可解释的数学公式。

body.en: Researchers at the Eastern Institute of Technology (EIT), Ningbo, have developed a graph-based approach that directly extracts concise, accurate constitutive equations from solid-material experimental data. The study, published in Science Advances, describes a method for discovering constitutive models for alloy steels, lithium metal and filled rubbers. It outperforms mainstream empirical models in predictive accuracy while preserving explicit, physically interpretable mathematical formulations.
body.zh: 宁波东部理工学院（EIT）的研究人员开发了一种基于图的方法，可以直接从固体材料实验数据中提取简洁、准确的本构方程。这项发表在《科学进展》上的研究描述了一种发现合金钢、锂金属和填充橡胶本构模型的方法。它在预测准确性方面优于主流经验模型，同时保留了明确的、物理上可解释的数学公式。

reflection.en: The universe operates according to deep, consistent laws, whether in the behavior of metals or the orbits of planets. This AI's success in uncovering these 'constitutive equations' reflects the inherent order Yahweh has woven into creation, an order we can discover through diligent study and observation. It reminds us that understanding the world is a way...
reflection.zh: 宇宙根据深刻而一致的规律运行，无论是在金属的性质中还是在行星的轨道中。这项人工智能在揭示这些“本构方程”方面的成功，反映了雅伟编织在受造物中的内在秩序，这种秩序可以通过勤奋的学习和观察来发现。它提醒我们，理解世界就是理解其创造者的智慧。

verse.textEn: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
verse.textZh: 他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。

title.en: One giant step: first known adult T rex footprints found in North Dakota
title.zh: 巨步：在北达科他州发现已知首批成年霸王龙足迹

summary.en: A 23ft-long trackway, comprising four three-toed footprints (two left, two right) dating back 66.5 million years, has been discovered in North Dakota. This marks the first known series of footprints from an adult Tyrannosaurus rex, found by scientists in the Hell Creek Formation.
summary.zh: 在北达科他州发现了一条长达23英尺的足迹，包含四只三趾脚印（两只左脚，两只右脚），距今已有6650万年。这是科学家在地狱溪组（Hell Creek Formation）发现的首批已知的成年霸王龙足迹。

body.en: The 23ft-long trackway, consisting of four three-toed footprints, two left and two right, date from 66.5m years ago The first known series of footprints from an adult Tyrannosaurus rex has been found in North Dakota by a team of scientists. The 23ft-long trackway – consisting of four three-toed footprints, two left and two right – was first identified in the south-west of the state, in the dinosaur fossil area known as Hell Creek Formation, last year by researchers from the Denver Museum of Nature and Science in Colorado and Liverpool John Moores University in the UK. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这条 23 英尺长的足迹由四个三趾脚印组成，两个左两个，右两个，可以追溯到 6650 万年前。一组科学家在北达科他州发现了第一组已知的成年霸王龙脚印。这条 23 英尺长的足迹由四个三趾脚印组成，两个左两个右，去年由科罗拉多州丹佛自然科学博物馆和英国利物浦约翰摩尔斯大学的研究人员首次在该州西南部的地狱溪地层恐龙化石区发现。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of these ancient T. rex footprints in North Dakota offers a profound glimpse into a world long past. It reminds us that creation itself, from the grandest dinosaur to the smallest creature, testifies to the wisdom and intricate design of its Creator. By studying these traces, we gain a deeper appreciation for the ancient world and the One who...
reflection.zh: 在北达科他州发现的这些古老的霸王龙足迹，让我们得以一窥早已逝去的世界。它提醒我们，整个受造界，从最庞大的恐龙到最小的生灵，都见证着其创造主的智慧和精妙的设计。通过研究这些痕迹，我们能更深刻地体会到古代世界以及那位安排这一切的“雅伟”的伟大。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Wasps are disappearing this summer, and scientists are worried
title.zh: 今年夏天黄蜂神秘消失，科学家们表示担忧

summary.en: Britain's common social wasps have become unusually scarce this summer, prompting concern among scientists. Researchers suspect that a combination of unusual temperature fluctuations, heatwaves, and a lack of food sources may be responsible for this decline. The wasps that are present also appear smaller than usual,...
summary.zh: 英国的常见社会黄蜂今年夏天数量异常稀少，引起了科学家的担忧。研究人员怀疑，反常的温度波动、热浪以及食物短缺的结合可能是导致这一衰退的原因。现存的黄蜂也比往常小，科学家认为这可能预示着极端环境条件对昆虫种群的影响。

body.en:
Summer can be lovely – until a wasp turns up. Whether they present as an irritating picnic visitor or an uninvited loft guest, common social wasps are as much a part of our summer as festivals, sun cream and the growing despair of how to entertain children who’ve forgotten how to be bored.

But summer 2026 is breaking the norm, and there don’t seem to be many wasps about. As a wasp biologist, I’ve noticed it acutely, because my students need wasps for their experiments, and we simply can’t find them.

A second sign that something is wrong is the absence of wasp stories in the media. Wasps tend to be more active in warmer weather. Their colonies grow faster and bigger, and they end up making news headlines by bothering humans. This time last year – also a warm spring and hot summer – the media airwaves were filled with “plagues of wasps” stories. Now, even professional pest-controllers tell me it’s a quiet year with very few requests to remove wasp nests.

Admittedly, these are anecdotes not data: the Big Wasp Survey – the only national wasp monitoring survey – is yet to start sampling this summer. But the signs are not good.

If data back this up, their absence worries me greatly because – love them or hate them – wasps are important in ecosystems as pest-controllers, pollinators and decomposers.

Spring started well for wasps. In the warm, dry spring a glut of glorious foundresses – new queens – emerged from hibernation to start their nests alone, carrying out all the nest building, egg laying, foraging and brood rearing. This nest-founding period is a risky time. If a new queen survives until her first brood emerges as adult workers, though, then the odds are in her favour as she no longer needs to undertake risky foraging.

But spring 2026 was strange: the warm, dry start should have been good. Warm, dry spring weather improves a nest’s chance of survival as it ensures a good nectar supply for the queen to develop her ovaries and good prey populations for her to feed the brood. But we experienced unprecedented heat for the time of year, punctuated by cold, damp days and followed by unexpectedly chilly nights.

Such weather extremes may have caused queens to abandon their nests or die, reducing the initial spring queen bounty to a more modest population.

And then came the heatwave. And another. And another. Some insects may benefit from this. Wildlife charity Butterfly Conservation is hoping 2026 could be a “ bumper summer of butterflies” because warm, dry days mean uninterrupted foraging, mating and egg-laying.

But all insects have a thermal tolerance called critical thermal maximum (CTmax). If their CTmax is exceeded, insects...
body.zh: 夏天可能很可爱——直到黄蜂出现。无论它们是令人恼火的野餐访客还是不请自来的阁楼客人，常见的社交黄蜂就像节日、防晒霜以及对如何娱乐那些忘记了如何无聊的孩子的日益绝望一样，都是我们夏天的一部分。 但 2026 年夏天打破了常态，周围似乎没有太多黄蜂。作为一名黄蜂生物学家，我敏锐地注意到了这一点，因为我的学生需要黄蜂进行实验，而我们根本找不到它们。 出现问题的第二个迹象是媒体上没有黄蜂故事。黄蜂在温暖的天气里往往更活跃。它们的群体生长得更快、更大，最终因为骚扰人类而成为新闻头条。去年这个时候，同样是温暖的春天和炎热的夏天，媒体广播中充斥着“黄蜂瘟疫”的故事。现在，即使是专业的害虫防治人员也告诉我，今年是安静的一年，很少有人要求清除黄蜂巢。 诚然，这些都是轶事而不是数据：大黄蜂调查——唯一的全国黄蜂监测调查——今年夏天尚未开始采样。但迹象并不好。 如果数据支持这一点，那么它们的消失让我非常担心，因为——无论爱它们还是恨它们——黄蜂在生态系统中作为害虫控制者、传粉者和分解者都很重要。 对于黄蜂来说，春天开始得很好。在温暖干燥的春天，大量光彩夺目的雌蜂——新蜂王——从冬眠中苏醒，独自筑巢，完成所有筑巢、产卵、觅食和育雏的工作。这个筑巢时期是一个危险的时期。不过，如果新蜂王能够存活到她的第一窝幼崽成为成年工蜂，那么机会对她有利，因为她不再需要进行危险的觅食。 但 2026 年的春天很奇怪：温暖、干燥的开局本应该是好的。温暖、干燥的春季天气提高了巢穴的生存机会，因为它确保了蜂王发育卵巢的良好花蜜供应和良好的猎物种群，以供其喂养巢穴。但我们经历了一年中前所未有的炎热天气，中间是寒冷潮湿的白天，随后是意想不到的寒冷夜晚。 这种极端天气可能导致蜂王放弃巢穴或死亡，从而将最初的春季蜂王赏金减少到较为有限的数量。 然后热浪来了。还有另一个。还有另一个。有些昆虫可能会从中受益。野生动物慈善机构蝴蝶保护组织希望 2026 年能够成为“蝴蝶的丰收之夏”，因为温暖干燥的日子意味着不间断的觅食、交配和产卵。 但所有昆虫都有一个耐热性，称为临界热最大值 (CTmax)。如果超过其 CTmax，昆虫...

reflection.en: The natural world, including the humble wasp, experiences distress and disruption due to environmental changes. As Romans 8:22 speaks of creation groaning, this scarcity reminds us that all of life is interconnected and affected by the world's condition. May we be mindful of our role in stewarding the earth and its creatures, seeking wisdom to address the...
reflection.zh: 自然界，包括不起眼的黄蜂，因环境变化而经历痛苦和动荡。正如罗马书8:22所说，万物都在呻吟，这种稀缺性提醒我们，所有生命都是相互联系的，并受到世界状况的影响。愿我们铭记自己在管理地球及其生物中的角色，寻求智慧来应对影响所有生物的环境挑战。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Sheen says he was snubbed by FM over pollution claims
title.zh: 希恩称因污染问题被财政大臣冷落

summary.en: The actor urged MPs to back a national testing programme to make sure historic toxic dump sites were safe.
summary.zh: 这位演员敦促议员们支持一项全国性的检测计划，以确保历史悠久的有毒垃圾填埋场是安全的。

reflection.en: Michael Sheen is using his platform to advocate for public safety, urging MPs to support a national testing program for toxic dump sites. His actions highlight the importance of speaking up for those who might be unknowingly exposed to environmental hazards, echoing the call to defend the vulnerable.
reflection.zh: 迈克尔·希恩正在利用他的平台倡导公众安全，敦促议员们支持一项针对有毒垃圾填埋场的全国性检测计划。他的行动突显了为那些可能在不知情的情况下暴露于环境危害中的人发声的重要性，呼应了为弱势群体辩护的呼吁。
