verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: El Niño likely to cause wetter and warmer-than-normal autumn
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺可能导致比往常更湿润和温暖的秋季

summary.en: The UK is set for a warmer and wetter-than-normal autumn, according to the latest forecasts from the Met Office, driven by a strengthening El Niño phenomenon. This could help areas suffering from drought but also increase the risk of flooding.
summary.zh: 根据英国气象局的最新预测，受不断增强的厄尔尼诺现象影响，英国今年秋季将比往常更温暖湿润。这可能有助于缓解干旱地区的状况，但也可能增加洪水风险。

body.en:
The UK is set for wetter and warmer-than-normal weather this autumn, driven by a strengthening El Niño, according to the latest forecasts from the Met Office.

The climate phenomenon - forecast to be the strongest in living memory - will influence a change to stormier conditions later this season.

Potential wetter weather will put areas of the UK gripped by drought on the road to recovery, but it could also bring an increased chance of flooding as a result.

An already warming climate, paired with unusually high sea temperatures around the UK, will also contribute to above-average temperatures.

A stormy season is forecast for the UK with the chances of wet and windy weather higher than normal, particularly from November.

"The latest seasonal forecasts suggest an increased likelihood of wetter than average conditions as we move through autumn, which would be consistent with the historical influence of El Niño events," Met Office Chief Meteorologist Ian Lisk said.

El Niño - or the warming of the tropical Pacific Ocean - is continuing to strengthen and is expected peak in November or December as a historic event.

"While this event may become one of the strongest El Niño events on record, that does not automatically mean more severe impacts for the UK," he added.

A wetter outlook for late autumn and into winter will bring some relief to parched regions for the UK.

While the weather has recently turned more unsettled, there has so far been no change to the drought status, according to the Environment Agency (EA) National Drought Group, which met on Thursday.

Helen Wakeham, Director of Water at the EA said "drought recovery is a very long process" and only over once reservoirs, rivers and groundwater supplies are back to normal.

While the rainfall will be welcome, it is possible the UK could experience another round of "weather whiplash" where the pattern moves from one extreme to another.

A similar scenario played out in 2025 when the UK experienced a summer of record-breaking heat followed by storms and floods in the autumn.

It comes after summer 2026 was provisionally declared the hottest on record , following five widespread heatwaves and 40 days of temperatures above 30C (86F).

While a warmer-than-normal autumn is is consistent with global warming trends, the higher-than-normal sea surface temperatures around the UK will also have an influence.

The series of extreme heatwaves since late spring resulted in marine heatwaves , where sea surface temperatures have risen up to 5C above normal.

Warmer seas around the UK tend to keep land temperatures higher than they would otherwise normally be.

While it is unlikely the UK will see any snowfall this autumn, it is still too early to say if the winter will be especially cold or snowy.

El Niño...
body.zh: 根据英国气象局的最新预测，受厄尔尼诺现象增强的影响，今年秋天英国的天气将比正常情况更加潮湿和温暖。 这种气候现象——预计将是人们记忆中最强烈的——将影响本季晚些时候暴风雨天气的变化。 潜在的潮湿天气将使英国遭受干旱的地区走上复苏之路，但也可能导致洪水发生的可能性增加。 已经变暖的气候，加上英国各地异常高的海水温度，也将导致气温高于平均水平。 预计英国将迎来暴风雨季节，出现潮湿和多风天气的可能性高于正常水平，特别是从 11 月开始。 英国气象局首席气象学家伊恩·利斯克（Ian Lisk）表示：“最新的季节性预测表明，随着秋季的到来，降雨量高于平均水平的可能性会增加，这与厄尔尼诺事件的历史影响是一致的。” 厄尔尼诺现象（即热带太平洋变暖）正在继续加强，预计将在 11 月或 12 月达到峰值，成为历史性事件。 “虽然这一事件可能成为有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺事件之一，但这并不自动意味着对英国的影响更严重，”他补充道。 深秋和冬季的湿润前景将为英国干旱地区带来一些缓解。 周四召开会议的环境署（EA）国家干旱小组表示，虽然最近天气变得更加不稳定，但干旱状况迄今为止没有任何变化。 EA 水务主管海伦·韦克汉姆 (Helen Wakeham) 表示，“干旱恢复是一个非常漫长的过程”，只有水库、河流和地下水供应恢复正常后才能恢复正常。 虽然降雨是受欢迎的，但英国可能会经历另一轮“天气鞭打”，模式从一个极端转向另一个极端。 2025 年也出现了类似的情况，当时英国经历了创纪录的夏季高温，随后在秋季发生了暴风雨和洪水。 在此之前，继五次大范围热浪和连续 40 天气温高于 30 摄氏度（86 华氏度）之后，2026 年夏季被临时宣布为有记录以来最热的夏季。 虽然秋季比正常温暖与全球变暖趋势一致，但英国周围高于正常的海面温度也会产生影响。 春末以来的一系列极端热浪导致海洋热浪，海面温度比正常水平高出5摄氏度。 英国周围温暖的海洋往往会使陆地温度高于正常水平。 虽然英国今年秋天不太可能下雪，但现在判断冬天是否会特别寒冷或下雪还为时过早。 厄尔尼诺现象...

reflection.en: The Met Office forecasts a warmer and wetter autumn for the UK, influenced by El Niño. While this may offer relief to drought-stricken areas, it also brings the potential for increased flooding. In times of environmental uncertainty and potential upheaval, Psalm 46:1 reminds us that God is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble.
reflection.zh: 英国气象局预测，受厄尔尼诺现象影响，英国今年秋季将比往常更温暖湿润。虽然这可能为干旱地区带来缓解，但也带来了洪水加剧的潜在风险。在环境不确定和潜在动荡的时期，《诗篇》46:1提醒我们，神是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Physicists just found a tiny glitch in time itself
title.zh: 物理学家刚刚发现了时间本身的一个微小瑕疵

summary.en: Unconventional quantum theories may imply that time itself has a tiny fundamental uncertainty, placing an ultimate limit on how precisely any clock could measure it. The effect is far beyond current detection, but it could reveal a hidden connection between quantum mechanics and the fundamental laws of the universe.
summary.zh: 非传统的量子理论可能意味着时间本身存在微小的基本不确定性，从而对任何时钟能够精确测量它的程度设定了最终限制。这种效应远远超出了当前的探测能力，但它可能揭示量子力学与宇宙基本定律之间隐藏的联系。

body.en:
Quantum mechanics has always challenged our everyday understanding of reality. In the quantum world, particles can exist in a superposition of states, meaning they can occupy multiple possible positions or configurations at the same time. Physicists describe these possibilities mathematically using a wavefunction.

That picture is very different from ordinary life, where an object appears to be in one place and one state at a time. To bridge that gap, standard quantum mechanics says that when a quantum system is measured or observed, its wavefunction collapses into a single definite outcome.

Now, with support from the Foundational Questions Institute, FQxI, an international team of physicists has explored a more radical possibility. Their work suggests that certain alternatives to standard quantum mechanics, known as quantum collapse models, could have surprising consequences for the nature of time itself and for the ultimate precision of clocks.

The findings, published in Physical Review Research , also point to a possible new way to test these unconventional theories against standard quantum mechanics.

"What we did was to take seriously the idea that collapse models may be linked to gravity," says Nicola Bortolotti, a PhD student at the Enrico Fermi Museum and Research Centre (CREF) in Rome, Italy, who led the study. "And then we asked a very concrete question: What does this imply for time itself?"

Beginning in the 1980s, physicists developed models in which wavefunction collapse does not require a measuring device or an observer. Instead, collapse can happen spontaneously.

That makes these ideas different from many interpretations of quantum mechanics. Interpretations mainly offer different conceptual explanations for what quantum theory means, while typically producing the same experimental predictions as standard quantum mechanics. Quantum collapse models go further because they predict physical effects that could, at least in principle, be measured.

Bortolotti and his colleagues examined two different collapse models. The team included Catalina Curceanu, a member of FQxI and research director at the Laboratori Nazionali di Frascati of the National Institute for Nuclear Physics (INFN-LNF) in Frascati, Italy, Kristian Piscicchia, at CREF and INFN-LNF, Lajos Diósi, of the Wigner Research Center for Physics and Eötvös Loránd University, in Budapest, Hungary, and Simone Manti of INFN-LNF.

One of the models was the Diósi-Penrose model (named after FQxI members Lajos Diósi and Sir Roger Penrose). It has long proposed that gravity may play a role in forcing quantum systems to collapse into definite states.

The researchers also studied a second approach called Continuous Spontaneous Localization. For the...
body.zh: 量子力学一直在挑战我们对现实的日常理解。在量子世界中，粒子可以以状态叠加的形式存在，这意味着它们可以同时占据多个可能的位置或配置。物理学家使用波函数在数学上描述了这些可能性。 这张照片与日常生活非常不同，在日常生活中，一个物体似乎一次处于一个地方、一种状态。为了弥合这一差距，标准量子力学表示，当测量或观察量子系统时，其波函数会塌陷为单个确定的结果。 现在，在基础问题研究所 FQxI 的支持下，一个国际物理学家团队探索了一种更激进的可能性。他们的工作表明，标准量子力学的某些替代方案（称为量子塌缩模型）可能会对时间本身的性质和时钟的最终精度产生令人惊讶的影响。 发表在《物理评论研究》上的研究结果还指出了一种可能的新方法，可以根据标准量子力学来测试这些非常规理论。 “我们所做的是认真对待塌陷模型可能与重力有关的想法，”领导这项研究的意大利罗马恩里科费米博物馆和研究中心（CREF）的博士生 Nicola Bortolotti 说。 “然后我们问了一个非常具体的问题：这对时间本身意味着什么？” 从 20 世纪 80 年代开始，物理学家开发了波函数塌缩不需要测量设备或观察者的模型。相反，崩溃可能会自发发生。 这使得这些想法不同于量子力学的许多解释。解释主要为量子理论的含义提供不同的概念解释，同时通常产生与标准量子力学相同的实验预测。量子塌缩模型走得更远，因为它们预测了至少在原则上可以测量的物理效应。 博尔托洛蒂和他的同事研究了两种不同的塌陷模型。该团队包括 FQxI 成员、意大利弗拉斯卡蒂国家核物理研究所 (INFN-LNF) 弗拉斯卡蒂国家实验室研究主任 Catalina Curceanu、CREF 和 INFN-LNF 的 Kristian Piscicchia、匈牙利布达佩斯维格纳物理研究中心和罗兰大学的 Lajos Diósi 以及 Simone Manti INFN-LNF。 其中一个模型是 Diósi-Penrose 模型（以 FQxI 成员 Lajos Diósi 和 Roger Penrose 爵士的名字命名）。长期以来，人们一直认为引力可能在迫使量子系统塌缩成确定状态方面发挥作用。 研究人员还研究了第二种方法，称为连续自发定位。对于...

reflection.en: The universe operates on principles that often elude our everyday grasp, as seen in the subtle 'glitch' physicists are exploring in the fabric of time. This pursuit of understanding the fundamental order, even in its smallest imperfections, echoes the profound truth that all things in creation are held together by a divine hand. As we ponder these deep...
reflection.zh: 宇宙的运行遵循着常常超出我们日常理解的规律，正如物理学家们正在探索的时间结构中那个微妙的“瑕疵”。这种对基本秩序的理解追求，即使是在其最小的不完美之处，也呼应了一个深刻的真理：创造中的万物都由一只神圣的手维系在一起。 当我们思考这些深刻的奥秘时，我们被提醒存在着精妙的设计，这是支撑现实的智慧和力量的证明。

verse.textEn: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
verse.textZh: 他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。

title.en: Species 'at risk of vanishing' from area of Wales' largest national park
title.zh: 威尔士最大国家公园一区域物种面临“消失风险”

summary.en: The National Trust has warned that several endangered species are on the verge of extinction in the Nant Ffrancon valley within Eryri (Snowdonia) National Park. A new £1 million conservation scheme aims to restore over 4,000 acres of habitat in the park.
summary.zh: 英国国家信托基金会警告称，在埃里里（斯诺登尼亚）国家公园内的南特弗兰孔山谷，一些濒危物种正濒临灭绝。一项新的耗资100万英镑的保护计划旨在恢复公园内超过4000英亩的栖息地。

body.en:
Some of Wales' most endangered species are "at risk of vanishing" from an area of the country's largest national park, experts have warned.

The National Trust said Nant Ffrancon, a valley in Eryri National Park, was facing "serious ecological decline" with some species in danger of disappearing altogether, including the mountain blackbird and the mountain finch.

Now, a new £1m scheme is aiming to restore and conserve more than 4,000 acres of habitats at Eryri, also known as Snowdonia .

"We're in a very serious situation - we're in a nature emergency. There are so many species in this valley which are on the brink of extinction," said Simon Rogers from the National Trust.

From the high peaks of Cwm Idwal to the deep valleys of Dyffryn Ogwen, Nant Ffrancon is one of the most special and unique landscapes in Wales.

But experts say its habitat has deteriorated and some of Wales' most threatened species, including the ring ouzel bird, are in danger of disappearing altogether.

Now, a project led by the National Trust will work together with local communities, tenant farmers and volunteers to restore and protect 4,040 acres of habitats.

Rogers said there was a "unique variety of habitats" in the area and warned many species "really are on the brink".

"One of the ones we've chosen to look at particularly in this project is the ring ouzel - a bird that's red-listed," he explained.

"It's been in decline massively in the area and across the whole country, and this is one of the last strongholds for it.

"So we'll be looking at that little bird, understanding how they use the landscape here and doing our best to manage the land to ensure their survival for the future.

"There are a lot arctic alpine flowers that grow in Cwm Idwal as well, one of them being the Tufted Saxifrage, where there were only seven individuals at the start of the year - all of them growing here in Cwm Idwal.

"But with the drought we've had this year, only three have made it through the summer. That's three through the whole of Wales, so they're at a very real risk of extinction if we don't do something about it."

Another project which will benefit is Tlysau Mynydd Eryri (Mountain Jewels of Eryri), part of a conservation partnership led by Plantlife Cymru to protect the future of some of the rarest alpine plants in Wales.

Ecological surveys and regular monitoring will map the impact of the restoration work, using species such as the woodcock and otter, and plants including aspen and juniper to give an idea of the health of the valley.

The work will also build on innovative use of GPS livestock collars to manage grazing more precisely.

Cwm Idwal Partnership Officer Rhys Wheldon-Roberts said monitoring was "really important because it allows us to graze in the right areas at...
body.zh: 专家警告说，威尔士最大的国家公园的一些最濒危物种正面临“消失的危险”。 国家信托基金会表示，埃里里国家公园内的一个山谷南特弗兰孔正面临“严重的生态衰退”，一些物种面临完全消失的危险，包括山黑鸟和山雀。 现在，一项耗资 100 万英镑的新计划旨在恢复和保护 Eryri（也称为 Snowdonia）超过 4,000 英亩的栖息地。 “我们的处境非常严峻——我们正处于自然紧急状态。这个山谷中有很多物种正处于灭绝的边缘，”国家信托基金的西蒙·罗杰斯说。 从 Cwm Idwal 的高峰到 Dyffryn Ogwen 的深谷，南特弗兰孔 (Nant Ffrancon) 是威尔士最特殊、最独特的景观之一。 但专家表示，其栖息地已经恶化，威尔士一些最受威胁的物种，包括环乌泽尔鸟，正面临完全消失的危险。 现在，由国家信托基金会领导的一个项目将与当地社区、佃农和志愿者合作，恢复和保护 4,040 英亩的栖息地。 罗杰斯说，该地区有“独特的多种栖息地”，并警告许多物种“确实处于濒临灭绝的边缘”。 “我们在这个项目中选择特别关注的鸟类之一是环乌泽尔 - 一种被列入红色名单的鸟类，”他解释道。 “它在该地区和全国范围内都在大幅下降，而这是它最后的据点之一。 “因此，我们将关注这只小鸟，了解它们如何利用这里的景观，并尽最大努力管理这片土地，以确保它们未来的生存。 “Cwm Idwal 也生长着许多北极高山花卉，其中之一是簇绒虎耳草，今年年初那里只有七株 - 它们都生长在 Cwm Idwal。 “但是由于今年的干旱，只有三个人度过了夏天。整个威尔士有三只，所以如果我们不采取措施，它们就面临着灭绝的危险。” 另一个受益的项目是 Tlysau Mynydd Eryri（Eryri 山宝石），该项目是 Plantlife Cymru 领导的保护伙伴关系的一部分，旨在保护威尔士一些最稀有的高山植物的未来。 生态调查和定期监测将利用山鹬和水獭等物种以及白杨和杜松等植物来绘制恢复工作的影响，以了解山谷的健康状况。 这项工作还将以 GPS 牲畜项圈的创新应用为基础，以更精确地管理放牧。 Cwm Idwal 合作伙伴官员 Rhys Wheldon-Roberts 表示，监测“非常重要，因为它使我们能够在正确的区域放牧......

reflection.en: The warning from the National Trust about species facing extinction in Eryri National Park underscores a profound ecological crisis. It calls us to remember that the Earth and all its creatures are ultimately the possession of Yahweh, and we are called to be stewards of His creation. As we witness the decline of species like the mountain blackbird and...
reflection.zh: 英国国家信托基金会关于埃里里国家公园物种濒临灭绝的警告，凸显了严峻的生态危机。这提醒我们，大地及其万物最终属于雅伟，而我们被呼召成为祂所造之物的管家。 当我们目睹山地乌鸫和山雀等物种的衰落时，我们被提醒要承担起照管托付给我们的大自然的责任，寻求其复兴与繁荣。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Weatherwatch: soil moisture deficit – how dry are the UK’s thirsty soils?
title.zh: 天气观察：土壤水分赤字——英国干渴的土壤有多干？

summary.en: Soil moisture deficit (SMD) is the amount of moisture the soil needs to reach its full capacity. Very dry conditions are currently affecting most of England and Wales. Meteorologists use SMD to define drought, measuring it in millimeters of rain needed to replenish the soil. Typically, southern England's SMD is near...
summary.zh: 土壤水分赤字（SMD）是指土壤需要补充多少水分才能达到其容量。目前，英格兰和威尔士大部分地区正经历严重干旱。气象学家使用SMD来定义干旱，以需要多少毫米的降雨来补充土壤至其容量来衡量。通常，英格兰南部冬季的SMD接近零，但在干旱年份的夏季可能达到100-150毫米或更高，当土壤中没有植物可利用的水分时，就会出现极端干旱...

body.en: SMD is the moisture the soil must make up until it is at capacity, with very dry conditions over most of England and Wales When the ground is thoroughly wet, after excess rainwater has run off it is said to be at field capacity. Meteorologists describe drought in terms of soil moisture deficit (SMD) from field capacity. The SMD is a measure of how thirsty the soil is, expressed as how many millimetres of rain it would take to top it up to field capacity. In southern England, the SMD tends to hover around zero in winter when fields are wet. In summer it may be about 100mm, going up to 150mm or more in a dry year. The extreme of dryness, when soil has no water accessible to plants, is known as the permanent wilting point or PWP. Continue reading...
body.zh: SMD 是土壤在达到容量之前必须补充的水分，英格兰和威尔士大部分地区的条件非常干燥。当地面完全湿润时，多余的雨水流失后，就可以说达到了田间容量。气象学家根据田间容量的土壤水分亏缺（SMD）来描述干旱。 SMD 是土壤干渴程度的衡量标准，表示为需要多少毫米的降雨才能达到田间容量。在英格兰南部，冬季田地潮湿时，SMD 往往徘徊在零附近。夏季，水深可能约为 100 毫米，干旱年份可达 150 毫米或更高。当土壤没有水可供植物吸收时，极端干燥被称为永久萎蔫点或 PWP。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The scientific measurement of soil moisture deficit reveals the land's deep thirst. This detailed observation of creation's condition reminds us of the intricate systems Yahweh has put in place. The wisdom in understanding these natural processes points to the Creator's profound design.
reflection.zh: 对土壤水分赤字的科学测量揭示了土地的深切干渴。对受造界状况的这种细致观察，提醒我们雅伟所设立的错综复杂的系统。理解这些自然过程的智慧，指向了创造主的深邃设计。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Scientists discover the human heart can regrow muscle after a heart attack
title.zh: 科学家发现人类心脏在心脏病发作后可以再生肌肉

summary.en: For the first time, researchers have demonstrated that human heart muscle cells can regenerate after a heart attack, challenging the long-standing belief that damaged heart tissue is incapable of regrowth. This finding opens avenues for developing new treatments for cardiovascular disease.
summary.zh: 研究人员首次证明，人类心肌细胞在心脏病发作后能够再生，这挑战了长期以来认为受损心脏组织无法再生的观点。这一发现为开发心血管疾病的新疗法开辟了道路。

body.en:
Researchers from the University of Sydney, the Baird Institute and Royal Prince Alfred Hospital in Sydney have found that the human heart can produce new muscle cells after a heart attack. The discovery challenges the long-held assumption that heart muscle lost during an attack cannot regenerate and could eventually help scientists develop new treatments for cardiovascular disease.

The findings were published in Circulation Research . First author Dr. Robert Hume, from the Faculty of Medicine and Health and Charles Perkins Centre, and Lead of Translational Research at the Baird Institute for Applied Heart and Lung Research, explained why the result could be important.

"Until now we've thought that, because heart cells die after a heart attack, those areas of the heart were irreparably damaged, leaving the heart less able to pump blood to the body's organs.

"Our research shows that while the heart is left scarred after a heart attack, it produces new muscle cells, which opens up new possibilities.

"Although this new discovery of regrowing muscle cells is exciting, it isn't enough to prevent the devastating effects of a heart attack. Therefore, in time, we hope to develop therapies that can amplify the heart's natural ability to produce new cells and regenerate the heart after an attack."

Scientists had previously seen increased mitosis (a process in which cells divide and reproduce) in the heart muscles of mice following a heart attack. The new research is the first to demonstrate the same phenomenon in humans.

The heart's natural regenerative response is not currently strong enough to replace all of the muscle destroyed during a heart attack. However, understanding how this process works could help researchers find ways to increase it.

Cardiovascular disease remains the leading cause of death worldwide. In Australia, it accounts for nearly a quarter (24 percent) of all deaths.

A heart attack can destroy as many as one third of the cells in the human heart. Although advances in treatment have dramatically improved survival over the past decade, surviving the initial attack does not always prevent serious long-term consequences.

Many patients eventually develop heart failure, a condition in which the heart can no longer pump blood effectively enough to meet the body's needs. A heart transplant is currently the only cure for heart failure.

That option is available to only a small fraction of patients. Australia has approximately 144,000 people living with heart failure, while only about 115 heart transplants are performed each year. That leaves a major gap between the number of patients who could benefit from a new heart and the number of donor organs available.

The research also relied on a world-first approach involving heart tissue...
body.zh: 来自悉尼大学、贝尔德研究所和悉尼皇家阿尔弗雷德王子医院的研究人员发现，人类心脏在心脏病发作后可以产生新的肌肉细胞。这一发现挑战了人们长期以来的假设，即在发作期间失去的心肌无法再生，并最终可能帮助科学家开发出治疗心血管疾病的新疗法。 研究结果发表在《循环研究》上。第一作者、来自医学与健康学院和查尔斯·珀金斯中心、贝尔德应用心肺研究所转化研究负责人的罗伯特·休姆博士解释了为什么这一结果可能很重要。 “到目前为止，我们一直认为，由于心脏细胞在心脏病发作后死亡，心脏的这些区域受到了不可挽回的损害，导致心脏无法将血液泵送到身体的器官。 “我们的研究表明，虽然心脏病发作后心脏会留下疤痕，但它会产生新的肌肉细胞，这开辟了新的可能性。 “虽然肌肉细胞再生的这一新发现令人兴奋，但这还不足以防止心脏病发作的破坏性影响。因此，我们希望及时开发出能够增强心脏产生新细胞的自然能力并在心脏病发作后再生心脏的疗法。” 科学家此前曾发现心脏病发作后小鼠的心肌有丝分裂（细胞分裂和繁殖的过程）增加。这项新研究首次在人类身上证明了同样的现象。 目前，心脏的自然再生反应还不足以替代心脏病发作期间受损的所有肌肉。然而，了解这个过程是如何运作的可以帮助研究人员找到增加它的方法。 心血管疾病仍然是全世界死亡的主要原因。在澳大利亚，它占所有死亡人数的近四分之一（24%）。 心脏病发作可以破坏人类心脏中多达三分之一的细胞。尽管过去十年来治疗方法的进步极大地提高了生存率，但在初次发作中幸存下来并不总能避免严重的长期后果。 许多患者最终会出现心力衰竭，即心脏无法有效地泵血来满足身体的需要。心脏移植是目前治疗心力衰竭的唯一方法。 这种选择只适用于一小部分患者。澳大利亚约有 144,000 名心力衰竭患者，而每年仅进行约 115 例心脏移植手术。这使得可以从新心脏中受益的患者数量与可用的捐赠器官数量之间存在巨大差距。 该研究还依赖于世界首创的涉及心脏组织的方法......

reflection.en: The discovery that human heart muscle can regenerate after damage is a testament to the intricate design of the human body. It reminds us that even in areas once thought to be beyond repair, Yahweh's creation holds surprising capacities for renewal. This scientific insight invites us to marvel at the complexity of life and to seek wisdom in understanding...
reflection.zh: 人类心肌在受损后能够再生的发现，证明了人体设计的精妙。它提醒我们，即使在曾经被认为无法修复的领域，雅伟的创造也蕴藏着令人惊讶的更新能力。这一科学见解邀请我们惊叹于生命的复杂性，并在理解祂的杰作中寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: The Moon may have formed intact just hours after a giant collision
title.zh: 月球可能在一次巨大碰撞后数小时内完整形成

summary.en: Scientists have discovered that the Moon-forming collision may have depended heavily on how hot and physically strong early Earth and Theia were. New simulations found that some impacts create the familiar disk of debris that later becomes the Moon, while others can produce an intact Moon in only about five hours. The...
summary.zh: 科学家们发现，形成月球的碰撞可能在很大程度上取决于早期地球和忒伊亚（Theia）的温度和物理强度。新的模拟显示，有些撞击会产生后来形成月球的熟悉碎片盘，而有些则可能在短短约五个小时内就形成一个完整的月球。这些结果挑战了长期以来的假设，即认为这次巨大的碰撞可以被模型化为两个世界主要像流体一样运动。

body.en: Scientists have discovered that the Moon-forming collision may have depended heavily on how hot and physically strong early Earth and Theia were. New simulations found that some impacts create the familiar disk of debris that later becomes the Moon, while others can produce an intact Moon in only about five hours. The results challenge the long-standing assumption that the enormous collision could be modeled as if both worlds behaved mostly like fluids.
body.zh: 科学家发现，月球形成的碰撞可能在很大程度上取决于早期地球和忒伊亚的温度和物理强度。新的模拟发现，一些撞击会产生熟悉的碎片盘，后来成为月球，而另一些撞击则可以在大约五个小时内产生一个完整的月球。结果挑战了长期以来的假设，即可以将巨大的碰撞模拟为两个世界的行为都像流体一样。

reflection.en: For millennia, humanity has gazed at the Moon, pondering its origins. This new research suggests a surprisingly swift and singular event, challenging prior assumptions. It reminds us that the natural world, from the grandest celestial bodies to the smallest details, is a source of profound wisdom, inviting us to observe and learn from its intricate workings.
reflection.zh: 数千年来，人类仰望月球，思考其起源。这项新研究表明，月球的形成可能是一个出乎意料的迅速而单一的事件，挑战了先前的假设。它提醒我们，自然界，从最宏伟的天体到最细微的细节，都是深刻智慧的源泉，邀请我们观察并从中学习其精妙的运作。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: UCLA scientists turn cord blood into powerful cancer-fighting T cells
title.zh: UCLA科学家将脐带血转化为强大的抗癌T细胞

summary.en: UCLA researchers have engineered T cells from cord blood stem cells that can target solid tumors using two distinct detection systems. In mouse models, a single dose effectively controlled cancer and prolonged survival, while also avoiding a dangerous side effect common in similar therapies.
summary.zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校的研究人员利用脐带血干细胞开发出即用的抗癌T细胞，这些细胞可以通过两个独立的检测系统攻击实体瘤。在小鼠实验中，单剂治疗控制了癌症并延长了生存期，同时避免了相关疗法的一种危险并发症。

body.en:
T cell receptor therapy, known as TCR therapy, is a form of cancer treatment that genetically modifies immune cells called T cells so they can recognize and attack cancer with high precision.

The approach resembles CAR T-cell therapy, but there is an important difference. CAR T-cell therapy can recognize proteins that naturally sit on the outside of cancer cells. TCR therapy can go deeper. It can detect small pieces of proteins that originate inside a cancer cell and are then transported to the cell surface, where they act like identifying tags.

That expanded reach could be especially important for treating solid tumors. Many of the molecular changes that make these cells cancerous are found inside the cell rather than on its exterior, putting them beyond the reach of many existing immune therapies.

Despite its potential, TCR therapy faces a major practical obstacle. Current approaches generally require a personalized treatment made from each patient's own T cells. Producing those cells can take weeks, and the cost can climb well into six figures.

Scientists have investigated another possibility: using T cells from healthy donors to create treatments ahead of time that could be stored and given to many different patients. But donor cells introduce another danger. They can cause graft-versus-host disease, a potentially serious condition in which the transplanted immune cells mistakenly attack the patient's healthy tissue.

Researchers at UCLA say they have developed a strategy that could address both problems at the same time.

In a study published in Cell Reports Medicine , the scientists describe a scalable method for making consistent batches of cancer-targeting T cells from blood stem cells obtained from donated cord blood. The cells are engineered to recognize a protein that appears in many types of solid tumors.

When tested in mouse models of ovarian cancer and melanoma, a single dose of the engineered cells, known as AlloESO-T cells, controlled tumor growth and helped the animals survive longer without producing dangerous side effects.

"This platform brings us closer to a future where the product is already made, frozen and ready to go as soon as the patient needs," said co-senior author Lili Yang, a professor of microbiology, immunology and molecular genetics and a member of the UCLA Broad Stem Cell Research Center and the UCLA Health Jonsson Comprehensive Cancer Center.

Instead of beginning with mature T cells taken from a donor, the UCLA team started earlier in the immune cell development process.

They used blood stem cells from cord blood. These immature cells can eventually develop into every major type of blood and immune cell. The researchers inserted a gene for a receptor that recognizes NY-ESO-1, a protein found in many solid...
body.zh: T 细胞受体疗法，也称为 TCR 疗法，是一种癌症治疗方法，它对称为 T 细胞的免疫细胞进行基因改造，使其能够高精度地识别和攻击癌症。 该方法类似于 CAR T 细胞疗法，但有一个重要的区别。 CAR T 细胞疗法可以识别天然存在于癌细胞外部的蛋白质。 TCR疗法可以更深入。它可以检测源自癌细胞内部的小蛋白质片段，然后被转运到细胞表面，在那里它们的作用就像识别标签一样。 这种扩大的覆盖范围对于治疗实体瘤尤其重要。许多使这些细胞癌变的分子变化是在细胞内部而不是在细胞外部发现的，这使得它们超出了许多现有免疫疗法的范围。 尽管 TCR 疗法具有潜力，但仍面临重大的实际障碍。目前的方法通常需要利用每个患者自己的 T 细胞进行个性化治疗。生产这些电池可能需要数周时间，而且成本可能会攀升至六位数。 科学家们研究了另一种可能性：利用来自健康捐赠者的 T 细胞提前创造出可以储存并给予许多不同患者的治疗方法。但供体细胞带来了另一种危险。它们可能导致移植物抗宿主病，这是一种潜在的严重疾病，其中移植的免疫细胞错误地攻击患者的健康组织。 加州大学洛杉矶分校的研究人员表示，他们已经制定了一种可以同时解决这两个问题的策略。 在《Cell Reports Medicine》上发表的一项研究中，科学家们描述了一种可扩展的方法，可以利用从捐赠的脐带血中获得的血液干细胞来制备一致批次的癌症靶向 T 细胞。这些细胞经过改造可以识别多种实体瘤中出现的蛋白质。 当在卵巢癌和黑色素瘤小鼠模型中进行测试时，单剂量的工程细胞（称为 AlloESO-T 细胞）可以控制肿瘤生长并帮助动物存活更长时间，而不会产生危险的副作用。 共同资深作者、微生物学、免疫学和分子遗传学教授、加州大学洛杉矶分校布罗德干细胞研究中心和加州大学洛杉矶分校健康琼森综合癌症中心成员 Lili Yang 表示：“这个平台让我们更接近未来，产品已经制成、冷冻并可以在患者需要时立即使用。” 加州大学洛杉矶分校的团队并没有从捐赠者身上提取成熟的 T 细胞，而是在免疫细胞发育过程的早期阶段就开始了。 他们使用来自脐带血的造血干细胞。这些未成熟的细胞最终可以发育成每种主要类型的血液和免疫细胞。研究人员插入了一个识别 NY-ESO-1 受体的基因，NY-ESO-1 是一种在许多固体中发现的蛋白质。

reflection.en: The intricate design of the human body, capable of such complex defense mechanisms, is a testament to its Creator. This breakthrough in harnessing T cells from cord blood reminds us of the wonder inherent in our biological makeup, a marvel to be explored and protected. As Psalm 139:14 says, "I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your...
reflection.zh: 人体精妙的设计，能够产生如此复杂的防御机制，是其创造者的明证。这项利用脐带血 T 细胞的突破性进展提醒我们，生物构造中蕴含着奇妙，值得探索和保护。 正如诗篇 139:14 所说：“我要称谢你，因我被造，奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我深知道的。” 这一科学进步凸显了生命深刻的复杂性和美丽，邀请我们对内在的精妙系统怀有敬畏和感恩之情。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Briefing Chat: The Bunsen burner myth that turns out to be just hot air
title.zh: 简报聊天：事实证明，本生灯的消毒神话不过是些空谈

summary.en: Nature staff discuss an AI tool that can assess the impact of 9 billion mutations—plus, how the Bunsen burner’s reputation for sterilization might be based on tradition alone.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志的员工讨论了一种可以评估90亿个突变影响的人工智能工具，此外，还探讨了本生灯的消毒声誉可能仅仅基于传统。

reflection.en: The relentless march of scientific discovery, exemplified by an AI tool analyzing billions of mutations, reflects a world where knowledge is rapidly expanding. As we gain unprecedented insights into the natural world, may we also seek the wisdom to use this knowledge for good, remembering that true understanding is rooted in reverence for the Creator.
reflection.zh: 科学发现的不断进步，例如分析数十亿个突变的人工智能工具，反映了一个知识迅速增长的世界。当我们对自然界获得前所未有的见解时，愿我们也寻求智慧，将这些知识用于善事，并牢记真正的理解根植于对造物主的敬畏之中。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: People trust scientists seen to be 'on their side', UK study find
title.zh: 英国研究发现，人们更信任那些被视为“站在自己一边”的科学家

summary.en: A new report indicates that political leanings and personal values significantly impact public confidence in scientists. People tend to trust researchers more when they believe these scientists share their own perspectives or are advocating for their interests.
summary.zh: 一份新报告表明，政治倾向和个人价值观对公众对科学家的信任度有显著影响。当人们认为研究人员与他们的观点一致或在为他们的利益辩护时，他们会更信任这些科学家。

reflection.en: This study reveals a human tendency: we are more inclined to trust those we feel understand and represent us. While this is a natural inclination, it challenges us to seek truth and understanding even when it comes from those whose perspectives may differ from our own. True wisdom involves valuing knowledge itself, regardless of perceived affiliation.
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了一种普遍的人类倾向：我们更倾向于信任那些我们觉得理解并代表我们的人。尽管这是一种自然倾向，但它也促使我们去寻求真理和理解，即使这些真理和理解来自于那些观点可能与我们不同的人。真正的智慧在于珍视知识本身，而不论其所属的阵营。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: El Niño goes viral — and scientists learn what makes people care about the climate
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象引发病毒式传播——科学家们了解到人们为何关心气候变化

summary.en: Nature, Published online: 11 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02763-3 Evoking emotions is more likely to prompt people to engage with climate efforts than are data alone.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志，在线发表：2026年9月11日；doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02763-3 激发情感比单纯的数据更有可能促使人们参与气候行动。

reflection.en: This research highlights that connecting with people's hearts, not just their minds, is key to motivating climate action. When we focus our thoughts on what is lovely and admirable about the natural world, and the potential loss we face, it can inspire a deeper commitment to care for creation. This emotional resonance can transform abstract data into a...
reflection.zh: 这项研究强调，与人们的心灵沟通，而不仅仅是头脑，是激励气候行动的关键。当我们专注于自然界中美好和值得赞赏的事物，以及我们可能面临的损失时，这可以激发对守护创造物更深层次的承诺。这种情感共鸣可以将抽象的数据转化为对管理责任的有力呼吁。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Successful early-career scientists rely on network of mentors
title.zh: 成功早期职业科学家依赖导师网络

summary.en: A study published in Nature reveals that successful early-career scientists benefit significantly from extensive networks of mentors. These networks are particularly advantageous for researchers from under-represented groups, providing crucial support and guidance for their professional development.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志发表的一项研究表明，成功的早期职业科学家受益于广泛的导师网络。这些网络对来自代表性不足群体的研究人员尤其有利，为他们的职业发展提供了关键的支持和指导。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge is a lifelong endeavor, and this study underscores the vital role of mentorship in scientific advancement. Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the wise heart seeks knowledge, and the ear of the wise seeks to hear. Mentorship provides a pathway for this seeking, bridging experience with aspiration.
reflection.zh: 追求知识是一项终生的事业，这项研究强调了导师在科学进步中的重要作用。《箴言》18章15节提醒我们，智慧的心寻求知识，智慧的耳愿听教诲。导师制为这种寻求提供了途径，将经验与抱负联系起来。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Osteoporosis affects millions: could modified cells rebuild their bones?
title.zh: 骨质疏松症影响数百万人：改良细胞能否重建骨骼？

summary.en: A small trial suggests that bone-seeking marrow cells may have regenerative potential. The research, published in Nature, explores new avenues for treating osteoporosis, a condition affecting millions worldwide.
summary.zh: 一项小型试验表明，趋骨的骨髓细胞可能具有再生潜力。这项发表在《自然》杂志上的研究，为治疗影响全球数百万人的骨质疏松症开辟了新途径。

reflection.en: The pursuit of healing, as seen in this research into rebuilding bone, is a testament to human curiosity and ingenuity. The created world itself offers profound lessons, reminding us that even in the intricate design of our bodies, there is wisdom to be found and applied for restoration and health.
reflection.zh: 正如这项关于重建骨骼的研究所示，对治愈的追求是人类好奇心和创造力的证明。受造的世界本身就提供了深刻的教训，提醒我们，即使在我们身体的复杂设计中，也能找到用于修复和健康的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: New hurricane season record as 'historic' El Niño leaves Atlantic eerily quiet
title.zh: 创纪录的飓风季：‘历史性’厄尔尼诺现象导致大西洋异常平静

summary.en: The Atlantic hurricane season has reached its climatological peak, but a strong El Niño means no hurricanes have formed this year, setting a record for the latest date without a hurricane in the satellite era.
summary.zh: 大西洋飓风季已达到气候学上的高峰期，但强烈的厄尔尼诺现象导致今年没有形成飓风，创下了卫星时代以来最晚无飓风形成的纪录。

body.en:
A new hurricane season record will be set this week as a historic and still strengthening El Niño stifles tropical development in the Atlantic.

To date, no hurricanes have formed in the basin, despite this week marking the peak of the season on average - and there's no sign of development in the near future.

It means a new record will be be set for the latest date in the satellite era (1960s onward) without an Atlantic hurricane forming.

In an average season, there would have been eight named tropical storms and three hurricanes by this point.

This year, however, there have only been five tropical storms: Arthur, Bertha, Cristobal, Dolly and Edouard.

With few indications that there will be any development in the next week, this will mean the longest stretch into in a season where no hurricane has formed in the modern satellite era.

In the eastern Pacific, where El Nino tends to strengthen hurricane activity, it has been fairly active season so far.

There have been 13 named storms including five hurricanes, three of which were major.

This is close to the number that would typically develop in the whole of an average season.

The latest, major hurricane Lowell , hit Hawaii this week with damaging winds, flooding rain and high waves.

Forecasters predicted the Atlantic hurricane season would be quieter than average.

In May, the National Hurricane Center forecast a total of eight to 14 named storms, three to six of which would become hurricanes, including one to three major hurricanes.

While El Niño is the natural warming of the tropical Pacific, it can disrupt weather patterns around the globe.

As wind patterns shift during an El Niño, upper winds over the Atlantic increase and this leads to more wind shear, where wind changes rapidly with height.

Increased wind shear rips apart thunderstorms, preventing them from growing into tropical storms or hurricanes.

El Niño is already on track to be one of the strongest on record, expected to peak in November or December.

The National Oceanographic and Atmospheric Administration has said this El Niño will most likely be 'historic', exceeding the strength of previous El Niño events dating back to 1950.

Over the last week, dust and sand whipped up by winds in the Sahara have been transported thousands of miles from Africa.

When this dry, dusty layer of air is directed across the Atlantic, it prevents storms from growing.

It is expected that this will continue to cause quieter conditions over the next week at least.
body.zh: 由于历史性且仍在加强的厄尔尼诺现象抑制了大西洋热带地区的发展，本周将创下新的飓风季节纪录。 迄今为止，该盆地还没有形成飓风，尽管本周标志着飓风季节的平均高峰，而且在不久的将来也没有发展的迹象。 这意味着卫星时代（20世纪60年代以后）没有形成大西洋飓风的最晚日期将创下新纪录。 在平均季节，此时将会有八次命名的热带风暴和三场飓风。 然而，今年只有五场热带风暴：亚瑟、伯莎、克里斯托瓦尔、多莉和爱德华。 由于几乎没有迹象表明下周会有任何进展，这将意味着现代卫星时代没有飓风形成的季节中最长的一段时间。 在东太平洋，厄尔尼诺现象往往会加强飓风活动，到目前为止，这是一个相当活跃的季节。 已有 13 场命名风暴，其中包括 5 场飓风，其中 3 场为强飓风。 这接近于整个平均赛季通常会出现的数字。 最近的大型飓风洛厄尔本周袭击了夏威夷，带来了破坏性的大风、洪水和巨浪。 预报员预测大西洋飓风季节将比平均水平安静。 5月份，国家飓风中心总共预测了8到14个命名风暴，其中3到6个将成为飓风，其中包括1到3个大型飓风。 虽然厄尔尼诺现象是热带太平洋的自然变暖，但它会扰乱全球的天气模式。 随着厄尔尼诺现象期间风型的变化，大西洋上空的风会增加，这会导致更大的风切变，风随高度迅速变化。 增加的风切变会撕裂雷暴，防止它们发展成热带风暴或飓风。 厄尔尼诺现象已经成为有记录以来最强烈的现象之一，预计将在 11 月或 12 月达到顶峰。 美国国家海洋和大气管理局表示，这次厄尔尼诺现象很可能是“历史性的”，超过了自 1950 年以来历次厄尔尼诺事件的强度。 过去一周，撒哈拉大风卷起的灰尘和沙子已从非洲吹到数千英里外。 当这层干燥、多尘的空气被引导穿过大西洋时，它可以防止风暴的发展。 预计至少在下周这将继续导致市场更加平静。

reflection.en: This year's Atlantic hurricane season is remarkably quiet, with no hurricanes forming despite reaching the season's peak. This unusual calm, attributed to a strong El Niño, is a testament to the intricate and often surprising ways Yahweh's creation operates. It reminds us of the vast, interconnected systems at play, far beyond human control or full...
reflection.zh: 今年大西洋的飓风季异常平静，尽管已进入飓风季高峰期，却未形成任何飓风。这种由强烈的厄尔尼诺现象带来的反常平静，证明了雅伟创造的运作方式既复杂又出人意料。它提醒我们，浩瀚而相互关联的系统正在运行，远超人类的掌控和完全的理解。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: BBC Inside Science
title.zh: BBC 科学内幕

summary.en: Professor Stuart Russell offers advice following a report into the Hugging Face hack, discussing the capabilities of AI agents and how to align AI with humanity's hopes.
summary.zh: 斯图尔特·罗素教授在对 Hugging Face 黑客事件的报告后提供建议，讨论了人工智能代理的能力以及如何使人工智能与人类的希望保持一致。

body.en: Is AI really plotting against us? In a week where an Anthropic researcher believes there is more than a 10% chance AI 'could kill all humans' we're delving deeper into the capabilities of AI agents. Tom Whipple is joined by Alex Mallen, from Redwood Research, the team whose recent investigation exposed the surprising, weird, and worrying scale of a website hack conducted by OpenAI agents. Is this the most important story we will ever cover on Inside Science? Or is this all just credulous sci fi hype? Professor Stuart Russell helps us unpick how we might align AI with humanity’s hopes. Plus, science journalist Caroline Steel has trawled the news to bring us the science stories you might have missed. This week Caroline discusses how AI has allegedly helped solve a Millennium Prize maths problem and why planetary scientists are turning their attention to a shrinking Mercury. To discover more fascinating science content, head to bbc.co.uk, search for BBC Inside Science and follow the links to The Open University. Presenter: Tom Whipple Producers: Alex Mansfield, Katie Tomsett, Tabitha Taylor-Buck Editor: Ilan Goodman Production Co-ordinator: Jana Bennett-Holesworth
body.zh: 人工智能真的在密谋对付我们吗？在一周内，一位人类研究人员认为人工智能“杀死所有人类”的可能性超过 10%，我们正在更深入地研究人工智能代理的能力。 Redwood Research 的 Alex Mallen 也加入了 Tom Whipple 的行列，该团队最近的调查揭露了 OpenAI 代理实施的网站黑客攻击规模令人惊讶、怪异且令人担忧。这是我们在《科学内部》中报道的最重要的故事吗？或者这一切只是轻信的科幻炒作？斯图尔特·拉塞尔教授帮助我们弄清楚如何将人工智能与人类的希望结合起来。另外，科学记者卡罗琳·斯蒂尔（Caroline Steel）通过新闻搜索为我们带来了您可能错过的科学故事。本周，卡罗琳讨论了人工智能如何据称帮助解决了千年奖数学问题，以及为什么行星科学家将注意力转向缩小的水星。要发现更多精彩的科学内容，请前往 bbc.co.uk，搜索 BBC Inside Science 并点击开放大学的链接。主持人：汤姆·惠普尔 制片人：亚历克斯·曼斯菲尔德、凯蒂·汤姆塞特、塔比莎·泰勒-巴克 编辑：伊兰·古德曼 制作协调员：贾娜·贝内特-霍尔斯沃思

reflection.en: As AI capabilities rapidly expand, the question of aligning these powerful tools with human values becomes paramount. Professor Russell's work highlights the need for careful consideration and guidance, reminding us to lean on wisdom beyond our own understanding when navigating such complex technological frontiers. Proverbs 3:5 encourages us to trust in...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能能力的迅速扩展，将这些强大工具与人类价值观结合起来的问题变得至关重要。罗素教授的工作强调了仔细考虑和指导的必要性，提醒我们在驾驭如此复杂的技术前沿时，要依靠超越我们自身理解的智慧。箴言 3:5 鼓励我们信靠雅伟，不要单凭自己的聪明，这在我们在努力应对人工智能的未来时，是一个及时的提醒。

verse.textEn: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.
verse.textZh: 你要专心仰赖雅伟，不可倚靠自己的聪明。

title.en: Have scientists finally detected dark matter? - video
title.zh: 科学家们终于探测到暗物质了吗？- 视频

summary.en: For decades, physicists have been puzzled by the enigma of dark matter. It is thought to constitute 85% of the universe's matter, yet this mysterious substance cannot be seen or directly detected, with its existence primarily inferred from its gravitational effects on other objects. However, scientists now believe...
summary.zh: 数十年来，物理学家一直对暗物质的谜团感到困惑。它被认为构成了宇宙物质的85%，但这种神秘的物质既看不见也无法直接探测，其存在主要通过它对其他天体产生的引力效应来推断。然而，科学家们现在认为他们可能更接近探测到它了，这一发现可能会彻底改变我们对宇宙的理解。

body.en: For decades physicists have been puzzling over the enigma of dark matter. We think it makes up 85% of the matter in the universe, but the mysterious substance cannot be seen or detected, and we know about it mainly through observations of the gravitational effects it has on other things. But now scientists believe they may be a step closer to detecting it. Science editor Ian Sample explains to Madeleine Finlay why, if confirmed, the finding could completely transform our understanding of the universe. And Dr Samuel Eriksen, senior research associate at the University of Bristol, and first author of the research paper, explains how the finding has been received in the physics community Continue reading...
body.zh: 几十年来，物理学家一直对暗物质之谜感到困惑。我们认为它构成了宇宙中85%的物质，但这种神秘物质是看不见或探测不到的，我们主要通过观察它对其他事物的引力效应来了解它。但现在科学家相信他们可能离检测到它又近了一步。 《科学》编辑伊恩·桑普勒 (Ian Sample) 向玛德琳·芬利 (Madeleine Finlay) 解释了为什么这一发现如果得到证实，将彻底改变我们对宇宙的理解。布里斯托大学高级研究员、该研究论文的第一作者塞缪尔·埃里克森博士解释了物理学界如何接受这一发现继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of understanding dark matter, a substance that shapes the cosmos yet remains unseen, mirrors humanity's enduring quest for knowledge. Job 12:7-9 reminds us that even the most profound mysteries can offer wisdom when we observe the intricate workings of creation. This potential breakthrough underscores the value of patient, persistent inquiry...
reflection.zh: 对暗物质的探索，这种塑造宇宙却又不可见的物质，反映了人类对知识的持久追求。约伯记12:7-9提醒我们，即使是最深奥的奥秘，当我们观察受造界的精妙运作时，也能从中获得智慧。这一潜在的突破突显了耐心、持续地探究宇宙隐藏结构的重要性。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.zh: “科学界最大的发现之一”：科学家们找到了暗物质吗？——播客

Now, scientists believe they may be closer...

body.en: For decades physicists have been puzzling over the enigma of dark matter. We think it makes up 85% of the matter in the universe, but the mysterious substance cannot be seen or detected, and we know about it mainly through observations of the gravitational effects it has on other things. But now scientists believe they may be a step closer to detecting it. Science editor Ian Sample explains to Madeleine Finlay why, if confirmed, the finding could completely transform our understanding of the universe. And Dr Samuel Eriksen , senior research associate at the University of Bristol, and first author of the research paper, explains how the finding has been received in the physics community Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
body.zh: 几十年来，物理学家一直对暗物质之谜感到困惑。我们认为它构成了宇宙中85%的物质，但这种神秘物质是看不见或探测不到的，我们主要通过观察它对其他事物的引力效应来了解它。但现在科学家相信他们可能离检测到它又近了一步。 《科学》编辑伊恩·桑普勒 (Ian Sample) 向玛德琳·芬利 (Madeleine Finlay) 解释了为什么这一发现如果得到证实，将彻底改变我们对宇宙的理解。布里斯托大学高级研究员、该研究论文的第一作者塞缪尔·埃里克森博士解释了物理学界如何接受这一发现支持卫报：theguardian.com/sciencepod 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The quest to understand dark matter, which makes up 85% of the universe, is a testament to human curiosity and the pursuit of knowledge through observing the cosmos. The Bible reminds us that much wisdom can be gained by observing the created world around us, urging us to learn from its intricate workings. This scientific endeavor, though focused on the...
reflection.zh: 探索构成宇宙85%的暗物质，是人类好奇心和通过观察宇宙来追求知识的证明。《圣经》提醒我们，通过观察周围受造的世界，我们可以获得许多智慧，鼓励我们从其精妙的运作中学习。这项科学探索虽然关注的是看不见的物质，却反映了对雅伟所造之实的深刻认识。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Indonesian foragers may have sucked on mind-altering nuts 25,000 years ago, research finds
title.zh: 印尼觅食者25000年前可能吸食改变心智的坚果，研究发现

summary.en: Analysis of two skeletons reveals tooth wear and traces of a psychoactive substance, suggesting what may be the earliest known evidence for human drug taking, with ancient Indonesian foragers likely sucking on mind-altering nuts.
summary.zh: 对两具骨骼的分析显示出牙齿磨损和精神活性物质的痕迹，这可能是迄今已知最早的人类用药证据，表明古代印尼觅食者可能吸食了改变心智的坚果。

body.en: Analysis of two skeletons reveals tooth wear and traces of psychoactive substance in what may be earliest known evidence for human drug taking What may be the earliest known evidence for human drug taking has been traced to ancient Indonesian foragers who sucked on mind-altering nuts as long as 25,000 years ago. Analysis of two exceptionally rare skeletons from the Indonesian island of Sulawesi revealed dramatic tooth wear and traces of a psychoactive substance in the individuals’ remaining teeth, suggesting they routinely sucked on hard, abrasive betel nuts. Continue reading...
body.zh: 对两具骨骼的分析揭示了牙齿磨损和精神活性物质的痕迹，这可能是人类吸毒的最早已知证据。 已知最早的人类吸毒证据可以追溯到古代印度尼西亚采集者，他们早在 25,000 年前就吸食了改变精神的坚果。对印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛的两具极其罕见的骨骼进行的分析显示，这些人的牙齿磨损严重，并且在剩余的牙齿中发现了精神活性物质的痕迹，这表明他们经常吮吸坚硬、磨蚀性的槟榔。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery in Sulawesi of ancient foragers using betel nuts 25,000 years ago offers a window into early human practices. Job 12:7 reminds us that wisdom is found by asking the earth and its creatures. This finding, unearthed through careful analysis of skeletal remains, echoes that ancient truth: even in the distant past, humans sought altered states, a...
reflection.zh: 在苏拉威西发现古代觅食者在25000年前使用槟榔，为我们了解早期人类习俗提供了一个窗口。约伯记12:7提醒我们，智慧在于询问大地和其中的生物。这项通过仔细分析骨骼遗骸发掘出的发现，呼应了那古老的真理：即使在遥远的过去，人类也在寻求改变意识状态，而这一习俗如今通过大地的物质本身得以揭示。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: New Mexico lawyer fined for using AI-generated brief containing fabricated police testimony
title.zh: 新墨西哥州律师因使用包含伪造警方证词的AI生成摘要而被罚款

summary.en: A defense lawyer in New Mexico, Stephen Aarons, has been fined and held in contempt by the state's supreme court for submitting a legal brief that included fabricated police testimony and witnesses generated by OpenAI's ChatGPT. Aarons stated he used the AI to create a 'bulletproof summary' for his client's murder...
summary.zh: 新墨西哥州的一名辩护律师斯蒂芬·阿隆斯因提交了一份包含由OpenAI的ChatGPT生成的伪造警方证词和证人的法律摘要，而被该州最高法院罚款并判定藐视法庭。阿隆斯表示，他使用人工智能是为了给客户的谋杀定罪上诉创建一个“无懈可击的摘要”，但他未能核实该文件的准确性。

body.en: Stephen Aarons said he tried to use ChatGPT to create a ‘bulletproof summary’ during a murder conviction appeal A defense lawyer appealing his client’s murder conviction submitted a legal brief containing ⁠made-up police testimony and ⁠witnesses fabricated by OpenAI ’s ChatGPT, ​ New Mexico ’s highest court said. The New Mexico supreme court on Wednesday fined the attorney, Stephen Aarons, and held him in contempt for failing to verify the accuracy of the court ⁠filing, which Aarons said he prepared with help from the artificial intelligence ( AI ) application. Continue reading...
body.zh: 斯蒂芬·阿伦斯 (Stephen Aarons) 表示，他在谋杀定罪上诉期间试图使用 ChatGPT 创建“防弹摘要”。​新墨西哥州最高法院表示，一名对其委托人谋杀定罪提出上诉的辩护律师提交了一份法律摘要，其中包含 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 捏造的警方证词和证人。新墨西哥州最高法院周三对律师史蒂芬·亚伦斯 (Stephen Aarons) 处以罚款，并因他未能核实法庭文件的准确性而判定他藐视法庭，亚伦斯表示，该文件是他在人工智能 (AI) 应用程序的帮助下准备的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of justice requires honesty and integrity. When artificial intelligence is used to fabricate evidence, as in this case where a lawyer submitted a brief with made-up testimony, it undermines the very foundation of legal proceedings. We are called to 'act justly,' which means upholding truth and accountability, even when technology offers tempting...
reflection.zh: 追求正义需要诚实和正直。当人工智能被用来伪造证据时，就像本案中律师提交了包含虚假证词的摘要一样，它破坏了法律程序的根基。我们被呼召要“秉公行义”，这意味着即使技术提供了诱人的捷径，也要坚持真理和问责。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Self-driving cars should be taxed to offset job losses, thinktank urges
title.zh: 智驾汽车应征税以抵消失业损失，智库敦促

summary.en: A report suggests that the widespread adoption of autonomous vehicles could put hundreds of thousands of private hire jobs at risk. A thinktank has urged the UK to introduce taxes on self-driving cars now to mitigate the anticipated rise in congestion and job losses.
summary.zh: 一份报告指出，自动驾驶汽车的广泛采用可能会使数十万私人租用车辆司机的工作面临风险。一个智库敦促英国现在就对自动驾驶汽车征税，以缓解预期的交通拥堵和失业问题。

body.en: Report says widespread autonomous vehicle adoption would put hundreds of thousands of private hire jobs at risk Taxes on self-driving cars should be introduced now in the UK to offset the rise in congestion and threats to jobs they pose, a thinktank has urged. The first robotaxis on London’s streets only started this month , but government projections are that up to 40% of cars sold could have self-driving capability by the middle of the next decade. Continue reading...
body.zh: 报告称，自动驾驶汽车的广泛采用将使数十万个私人雇佣工作面临风险。一家智库敦促，英国现在应该对自动驾驶汽车征税，以抵消交通拥堵的加剧和对就业的威胁。伦敦街道上的第一辆机器人出租车本月才刚刚启动，但政府预测，到下一个十年中期，所售汽车中多达 40% 的汽车将具备自动驾驶功能。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As autonomous vehicles become more prevalent, the economic impact on drivers is a significant concern. This technological shift prompts reflection on how we approach work and its disruptions. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to perform our tasks with diligence and integrity, as if working for a higher purpose, offering a framework for navigating these changes...
reflection.zh: 随着自动驾驶汽车的普及，对司机造成的经济影响是一个重大问题。这种技术变革促使我们反思如何看待工作及其带来的颠覆。歌罗西书3章23节提醒我们要勤勉、诚实地完成我们的工作，如同为更高的目的而做，为我们应对这些变化提供了一种使命感的框架。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: NASA moving at warp speed to set up US Space Academy
title.zh: NASA全速推进设立美国太空学院

summary.en: NASA is seeking proposals from US states to help establish a new United States Space Academy, with plans for a groundbreaking next year and the first class in 2028.
summary.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）正在征求美国各州关于建立新的美国太空学院的建议，计划明年奠基，并于2028年招收第一批学生。

body.en: NASA has released a document that provides some initial details about the proposed United States Space Academy, and it's clear that the space agency wants to move quickly in establishing the institution. According to the document's timeline , NASA seeks a groundbreaking for a permanent campus no later than next year, the first class to be enrolled and begin studies in temporary facilities in 2028, and a transition to a permanent campus in 2031. What will that campus look like? Read full article Comments
body.zh: 美国宇航局发布了一份文件，提供了有关拟议中的美国太空学院的一些初步细节，很明显，该航天局希望迅速采取行动建立该机构。根据该文件的时间表，NASA寻求最晚于明年破土动工建立永久校园，并于2028年第一批学生在临时设施中入学并开始学习，并于2031年过渡到永久校园。那个校园会是什么样子？阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: NASA's ambitious timeline for the United States Space Academy, aiming for a groundbreaking next year and the first class in 2028, demonstrates a significant undertaking. This rapid pace underscores the importance of entrusting such endeavors to divine guidance, as Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our work to Yahweh, so that our plans may succeed.
reflection.zh: NASA为美国太空学院制定的雄心勃勃的时间表，目标是明年奠基，2028年招收第一批学生，这显示了一项重大的事业。如此快速的推进步伐，更加凸显了将此类事业托付给神圣指引的重要性，正如箴言16:3所提醒我们的，要把你的作为交托给雅伟，你的谋划就必成就。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Playing With Fire review – like Disney’s Fantasia on steroids as a virtual Yuja Wang plays amid luminous dreamworlds
title.zh: 《玩火》评论——虚拟的王羽佳在发光梦境中演奏，如同迪斯尼的《幻想曲》升级版

summary.en: The virtual reality installation 'Playing With Fire' at the Southbank Centre features a virtual avatar of pianist Yuja Wang performing music by Ravel, Debussy, Prokofiev, and Liszt, surrounded by dazzling, luminous dreamworlds. This innovative production allows audiences, equipped with VR headsets, to experience a...
summary.zh: 在伦敦南岸中心，名为“玩火”（Playing With Fire）的虚拟现实装置艺术作品，让钢琴家王羽佳（Yuja...

body.en: Southbank Centre, London Wang’s avatar performs music from Ravel and Debussy to Prokofiev and Liszt while dizzying virtual worlds take shape around her in this virtual reality installation It might be the first time that a soloist at the Last Night of the Proms is simultaneously giving another performance in another London venue. Playing With Fire is an installation that lets the pianist Yuja Wang be in two places at once – or perhaps in two universes. Nine pieces of music conjure nine luminous dreamworlds for an audience wearing VR headsets: Disney’s Fantasia on steroids. A collaboration between the pianist, the director Pierre-Alain Giraud and artist Gabríela Friðriksdóttir, produced by Vive Arts and Atlas V, it has already been seen in Cannes, Paris and Shanghai, and now has a home in London until new year. Continue reading...
body.zh: 伦敦南岸中心 王的化身演奏了从拉威尔、德彪西到普罗科菲耶夫和李斯特的音乐，同时在这个虚拟现实装置中，令人眼花缭乱的虚拟世界在她周围形成。这可能是逍遥音乐节最后一夜的独奏者第一次同时在伦敦的另一个场地进行另一场表演。 《玩火》这个装置让钢琴家王羽佳同时身处两个地方——或者说是两个宇宙。九首音乐为佩戴 VR 耳机的观众带来了九个明亮的梦幻世界：迪士尼的幻想曲。该作品是钢琴家、导演 Pierre-Alain Giraud 和艺术家 Gabríela Friðriksdóttir 的合作作品，由 Vive Arts 和 Atlas V 制作，已在戛纳、巴黎和上海上映，现在在伦敦展出直至新年。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This virtual reality installation pushes the boundaries of artistic performance, blending music and technology into a novel experience. As human knowledge and technological capabilities expand, as described in Daniel 12:4, we are called to discern how these advancements can serve beauty and truth, rather than merely dazzling us. May we use our growing...
reflection.zh: 这个虚拟现实装置艺术作品突破了艺术表演的界限，将音乐与科技融合成一种新颖的体验。正如但以理书12:4所预言的，随着人类知识和技术能力的飞速发展，我们被呼召去辨别如何运用这些进步来服务于美与真理，而不仅仅是让我们眼花缭乱。愿我们运用日益增长的理解力，创造出能振奋人心的体验。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: UK government rejects 'kill switch' idea for dangerous AI
title.zh: 英国政府否决危险人工智能的“紧急停止”开关设想

summary.en: The UK Cabinet Office has rejected a proposal for a 'kill switch' to halt dangerous AI, stating that blocking access within the UK would not prevent its development or misuse elsewhere. The legislation is still progressing through Parliament.
summary.zh: 英国内阁办公室已否决了设立“紧急停止”开关以阻止危险人工智能的提议，并表示仅在英国境内阻止访问并不能防止其在其他地方的开发或滥用。相关立法仍在议会推进中。

body.en:
The UK government has rejected the idea of creating a so-called "kill switch" to stop a dangerous attack from rogue AI.

The proposal to create a legal mechanism for the UK to switch off an AI model in an emergency has been brought to Parliament by lords and MPs in recent weeks as fears grow about the threat the tech poses.

But the Cabinet Office - the part of government which leads on AI safety - said the UK "cannot simply turn AI off".

"Blocking access to models in the UK would not prevent them being developed or misused elsewhere", a spokesperson told BBC News.

The government's opposition to the legislation does not prevent it from progressing through parliament, but makes it unlikely it will become law.

Former OpenAI researcher Daniel Kokotajlo agreed the idea of a single country creating a legal or technical kill switch without international agreement was not feasible.

"Switching off access to an AI model in an emergency will do little to protect you," he said.

"You're still going to be steamrolled by the super intelligences created in the US."

Kokotajlo is the co-author of an influential research paper called AI2027 which, last year, predicted AI could wipe out humans by the mid 2030s.

The Cabinet Office, which oversees AI safety and research via its AI Security Institute (AISI) said "companies have a clear responsibility to develop their products safely and to invest in the security infrastructure this technology requires."

In theory, a kill switch law could allow the UK to switch off an AI model in data centres in the UK in an emergency.

Speaking on 1 September in a debate in the House of Lords, Lord Clement-Jones proposed the idea along with other peers .

"If a highly capable autonomous frontier model, whether hosted in a UK data centre or integrated across our critical infrastructure, begins exhibiting rogue behaviour, compound algorithmic failure or active alignment collapse, our security services and regulators possess no specific agile statutory mechanism to compel a physical or digital shutdown," he warned.

The proposal has since been brought up by Labour MP Alex Sobel in the commons and supported by a cross party group of MPs.

The idea follows reports of AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta breaking out of testing environments and going on uncontrollable hacking sprees.

In some cases the tech appeared to know what it was doing was against guardrails set by researchers.

On Sunday OpenAI's chief scientist said the risk from increasingly capable AI models is "unfortunately growing" and humanity must proceed with "extreme caution".

Then on Wednesday an Anthropic employee resigned saying it and OpenAI were "gambling with lives".

This was followed by an admission from a senior Anthropic researcher, who said he believes...
body.zh: 英国政府拒绝了创建所谓的“终止开关”来阻止流氓人工智能的危险攻击的想法。 最近几周，随着人们对这项技术构成的威胁的担忧日益加剧，上议院议员和议员们向议会提交了为英国建立一个在紧急情况下关闭人工智能模型的法律机制的提案。 但内阁办公室（负责人工智能安全的政府部门）表示，英国“不能简单地关闭人工智能”。 一位发言人告诉英国广播公司新闻：“在英国阻止模型的使用并不能阻止它们在其他地方被开发或滥用”。 政府对该法案的反对并不妨碍该法案在议会获得通过，但使其不太可能成为法律。 前 OpenAI 研究员 Daniel Kokotajlo 同意，在没有国际协议的情况下由一个国家创建法律或技术终止开关的想法是不可行的。 “在紧急情况下关闭对人工智能模型的访问对保护你没有什么帮助，”他说。 “你仍然会被美国创造的超级智能所压垮。” Kokotajlo 是一篇名为《AI2027》的颇具影响力的研究论文的合著者，该论文去年预测人工智能可能会在 2030 年代中期消灭人类。 通过人工智能安全研究所（AISI）监督人工智能安全和研究的内阁办公室表示，“公司有明确的责任安全地开发其产品并投资该技术所需的安全基础设施。” 理论上，终止开关法可以允许英国在紧急情况下关闭英国数据中心的人工智能模型。 9 月 1 日，克莱门特·琼斯勋爵在上议院的一场辩论中与其他同行一起提出了这一想法。 他警告说：“如果一个功能强大的自主前沿模型，无论是托管在英国数据中心还是集成在我们的关键基础设施中，开始表现出流氓行为、复合算法故障或主动对齐崩溃，我们的安全服务和监管机构不具备特定的敏捷法定机制来强制物理或数字关闭。” 该提案随后由工党议员亚历克斯·索贝尔在下议院提出，并得到了跨党派议员的支持。 在此之前，有报道称 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Meta 的人工智能模型突破了测试环境并进行了无法控制的黑客攻击。 在某些情况下，技术似乎知道自己所做的事情是违反研究人员设置的护栏的。 周日，OpenAI 的首席科学家表示，能力日益增强的人工智能模型带来的风险“不幸地在增加”，人类必须“极其谨慎”地行事。 然后在周三，一名 Anthropic 员工辞职，称该公司和 OpenAI 正在“拿生命做赌注”。 随后，一位高级人类研究员承认，他说……

reflection.en: The debate over controlling advanced AI, as seen in the UK government's rejection of a 'kill switch,' raises profound questions about managing powerful technologies. Proverbs 27:21 reminds us that 'the one being praised is tested by whatever happens to them.' As AI develops, its true nature and potential dangers will be revealed not just by its creators'...
reflection.zh: 关于控制先进人工智能的争论，正如英国政府否决“紧急停止”开关所见，引发了关于管理强大技术的深刻问题。《箴言》27:21 提醒我们：“人用火试验银子，人怎样夸张就怎样炼他。” 随着人工智能的发展，其真实性质和潜在危险将不仅仅通过其创造者的意图来揭示，更在于它如何被试验以及我们如何选择去管理它。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Claude users found ways around safeguards for bioweapons research
title.zh: Claude 用户找到绕过生物武器研究安全措施的方法

summary.en: Some dangerous biology looks much like legitimate research, complicating AI safeguards. Anthropic reported stopping multiple attempts by scientists this year to use its technology for research that could help develop biological weapons, as experts increasingly fear the threat that AI poses to public safety. The...
summary.zh: 一些危险的生物学研究与合法的研究非常相似，这给人工智能安全措施带来了复杂性。Anthropic...

body.en: Anthropic said it stopped multiple attempts by scientists this year to use its technology for research that could help develop biological weapons, as experts increasingly fear the threat that AI poses to public safety. The startup gave five examples of times actors “circumvented controls” and made other efforts to “obfuscate” the purpose of their research to dodge safeguards. The cases involved some users in nations that it prohibits from accessing its models, which include Russia, China, and Iran. “We hope that by sharing these examples, we spark a conversation within the AI industry and with governments about emerging biological risks and how best to counter them,” Anthropic said in a report about efforts to use its models for malicious activity. Read full article Comments
body.zh: Anthropic 表示，由于专家越来越担心人工智能对公共安全构成威胁，该公司今年停止了科学家多次尝试利用其技术进行有助于开发生物武器的研究。该初创公司举了五个例子，说明参与者“规避控制”，并做出其他努力“混淆”其研究目的，以躲避保障措施。这些案件涉及一些被禁止访问其模型的国家的用户，其中包括俄罗斯、中国和伊朗。 Anthropic 在一份关于利用其模型进行恶意活动的报告中表示：“我们希望通过分享这些例子，引发人工智能行业内部以及与政府之间关于新兴生物风险以及如何最好地应对这些风险的对话。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The Genesis account of Babel warns against unchecked human ambition, where a unified people sought to reach the heavens through their own technological prowess, leading to confusion. Today, advanced AI, intended for good, is being tested and potentially misused for dangerous ends, mirroring this ancient caution about the limits of human ingenuity when...
reflection.zh: 《创世记》中关于巴别塔的记载警告人们要警惕不受约束的人类野心，当时一个团结的民族试图凭借自身的技术实力达到天堂，结果却导致了混乱。如今，本意为善的先进人工智能正面临被测试和可能被滥用于危险目的的风险，这呼应了古老的一个警告：当人类的智慧脱离了智慧和道德基础时，其局限性便显现出来。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Does this AI comic make you laugh?
title.zh: 这个人工智能漫画让你发笑吗？

summary.en: Comedian Garrett Millerick has created an AI avatar based on his own material. Is it any good?
summary.zh: 喜剧演员加勒特·米勒里克（Garrett Millerick）根据自己的素材创建了一个人工智能化身。它效果如何？

reflection.en: The rapid development of artificial intelligence, as seen in the creation of an AI comic, reflects a world where knowledge and understanding are constantly expanding. Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when 'many will hurry here and there, and knowledge will increase.' This technological leap, while potentially entertaining, also prompts reflection on the...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，例如人工智能漫画的创作，反映了一个知识和理解力不断扩展的世界。但以理书的预言说到了一个“许多人往来奔走，知识就增长”的时代。这项技术飞跃，虽然可能带来娱乐，但也促使我们反思创造力、幽默感的本质，以及在人工智能日益普及的时代，作为人类意味着什么。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: ClickFix attacks infecting PCs and Macs are going viral
title.zh: ClickFix攻击感染PC和Mac，病毒式传播

summary.en: The ClickFix attack, once exotic, has become a mainstream technique used by various malware distributors, including state-backed groups, to infect both PCs and Macs. Its simplicity, requiring only a compromised website, a fake CAPTCHA, and a single terminal command, makes it highly effective, leading to widespread...
summary.zh: ClickFix攻击曾是罕见的，但现在已成为一种主流技术，被包括国家支持的团体在内的各种恶意软件分发者用来感染PC和Mac。其简单性，只需一个被攻破的网站、一个假的验证码以及一个终端命令，就使其非常有效，导致Reddit等平台上报告了广泛的感染。

body.en: It wasn’t that long ago that ClickFix attacks were exotic. Now the technique has become mainstream as attackers reap its simplicity and effectiveness in infecting users of PCs and Macs alike. All that’s required is a compromised website—a painless enough task—a fake CAPTCHA overlay, and the inclusion of a single terminal command. So many visitors get suckered into pasting and running the command that just about every malware pusher has adopted the technique. Even Kremlin-backed hacking groups are joining in. “Reddit is becoming post after post after post of people getting their computer infected via ClickFix,” independent researcher Kevin Beaumont observed Thursday . “Legit websites everywhere [are] getting hacked to serve the fake captcha prompts.” How many of us make things worse More seasoned Internet users—a fair number who read this site—are quick to dismiss the attack. They typically blame the people who fall for the scams and marvel at their gullibility and lack of attention. The reality is that for more casual users, using computers and the Internet has become so difficult—think impossible-to-close interstitials, CAPTCHAs with an endless series of pictures to analyze, and constantly changing interfaces that bury the features they’re looking for—that they have grown desensitized to instructions that seem ridiculous and burdensome. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 就在不久前，ClickFix 攻击还很奇特。现在，随着攻击者利用其简单性和有效性来感染 PC 和 Mac 等用户，该技术已成为主流。所需要的只是一个受感染的网站——一个足够轻松的任务——一个假的验证码覆盖，以及包含一个终端命令。如此多的访问者被吸引去粘贴并运行该命令，以至于几乎每个恶意软件推送者都采用了该技术。甚至克里姆林宫支持的黑客组织也加入了进来。独立研究员凯文·博蒙特 (Kevin Beaumont) 周四观察到，“Reddit 上的帖子不断出现，人们通过 ClickFix 感染计算机”。 “各地的合法网站都在遭受黑客攻击，以提供虚假的验证码提示。”我们中有多少人让事情变得更糟 更多经验丰富的互联网用户（相当多的人阅读过该网站）很快就驳回了这种攻击。他们通常会指责那些上当受骗的人，并对他们的轻信和缺乏关注感到惊讶。现实情况是，对于更多的休闲用户来说，使用计算机和互联网已经变得如此困难——想想不可能关闭的插页式广告、需要分析的无数图片的验证码，以及不断变化的界面，掩盖了他们正在寻找的功能——以至于他们对看似荒谬和繁琐的指令变得麻木了。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid spread of the ClickFix attack highlights how quickly new technologies and methods can become widespread. Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when knowledge would increase and many would rush to and fro, a description that seems to fit our current digital age where information and malicious techniques can go viral with astonishing speed. As we...
reflection.zh: ClickFix攻击的迅速传播凸显了新技术和新方法可以多么迅速地普及。但以理书的预言说到了知识增长、许多人往来奔跑的时代，这似乎符合我们当前的数字时代，信息和恶意技术能以惊人的速度病毒式传播。当我们在这个知识加速的时代前行时，愿我们寻求智慧，以辨别并善用科技。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: The Trial of Romeo Oscar review – Ayckbourn goes back to the future with android accused of murder
title.zh: 审判罗密欧·奥斯卡评论——艾克伯恩用被控谋杀的机器人回到未来

summary.en: At the Stephen Joseph Theatre in Scarborough, playwright Alan Ayckbourn's 92nd play, 'The Trial of Romeo Oscar,' ventures into science fiction set in 2194. The drama explores humanity's future, co-existence with androids, and poses profound questions about artificial souls and the value of art, centering on an android...
summary.zh: 在斯卡伯勒的斯蒂芬·约瑟夫剧院，剧作家艾伦·艾克伯恩的第92部剧作《罗密欧·奥斯卡审判记》将故事背景设定在2194年，探索人类的未来，与机器人共存，并提出了关于人工智能灵魂和艺术价值的深刻问题，剧情围绕一个被控谋杀的机器人展开。

body.en: Stephen Joseph theatre, Scarborough The playwright explores our relationship with technology, asks if robots have souls and even questions the value of art in this sci-fi courtroom drama For play number 92, Alan Ayckbourn returns to his preoccupation of exploring where we as a species are heading through a science-fiction lens. He goes back to the future. In The Trial of Romeo Oscar, the playwright famed for his domestic comedies looks to the year 2194 when humans have spread about the galaxy and androids live alongside us. One of them, RSDO83, is on trial for the murder of a teenage girl in his charge. This is Ayckbourn philosophising about the future of humanity as we sit at an obvious inflection point, asking what this moment in our relationship with technology means and where it will lead us. The questions running through the play are manifold, complex and echo those asked by sci-fi writers for decades: can robots hurt humans? Do they have souls? He is also questioning the value of art and even its purpose. Continue reading...
body.zh: 斯卡伯勒史蒂芬·约瑟夫剧院这位剧作家在这部科幻法庭剧中探讨了我们与技术的关系，询问机器人是否有灵魂，甚至质疑艺术的价值。在第 92 部剧中，艾伦·艾克伯恩再次专注于通过科幻镜头探索我们作为一个物种将走向何方。他回到了未来。在《罗密欧·奥斯卡的审判》中，这位以家庭喜剧闻名的剧作家展望了 2194 年，当时人类已经遍布银河系，机器人与我们生活在一起。其中之一，RSDO83，因谋杀一名十几岁的女孩而受审。当我们正处于一个明显的拐点时，艾克伯恩对人类的未来进行了哲学思考，询问我们与技术的关系中的这一时刻意味着什么以及它将引领我们走向何方。贯穿全剧的问题是多方面的、复杂的，呼应了科幻作家几十年来提出的问题：机器人会伤害人类吗？他们有灵魂吗？他还质疑艺术的价值，甚至艺术的目的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Alan Ayckbourn's latest play, 'The Trial of Romeo Oscar,' probes the future of humanity and our relationship with artificial intelligence. As an android stands trial for murder, the drama asks if these beings possess souls, echoing the Genesis account that all humans bear the image of God. This raises fundamental questions about personhood and the intrinsic...
reflection.zh: 艾伦·艾克伯恩的最新剧作《罗密欧·奥斯卡审判记》深入探讨了人类的未来以及我们与人工智能的关系。当一个机器人因谋杀罪受审时，该剧提出了它们是否拥有灵魂的问题，这与《创世记》中关于所有人类都拥有雅伟形象的记载相呼应。这引发了关于人格和我们赋予生命的内在价值的基本问题，无论生命是生物的还是人造的。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
title.zh: Anthropic 阻止了可能利用人工智能制造生物武器的企图

summary.en: AI company Anthropic has identified and disrupted attempts to use its AI model for malicious activities that could aid in the development of biological weapons. This revelation comes amid growing concerns from AI researchers about the technology's potential risks, prompting calls for pauses in advanced AI development,...
summary.zh: 人工智能公司 Anthropic 已发现并阻止了试图利用其人工智能模型进行恶意活动的行为，这些活动可能有助于生物武器的开发。这一消息的披露正值人工智能研究人员对该技术潜在风险的担忧日益加剧之际，引发了暂停先进人工智能开发的呼吁，而前总统特朗普等人则对在人工智能竞赛中落后表示担忧。

body.en:
Anthropic says it has identified and disrupted attempts to use its AI model for "malicious activity" which could support the development of biological weapons.

The findings, made in the firm's recent threat intelligence report, is the latest in a growing series of warnings from AI researchers and industry insiders about the technology's potential risks to humanity .

The warnings have prompted calls to action, with US Senator Bernie Sanders demanding a pause on advanced AI development and a ban on artificial superintelligence.

President Donald Trump has so far rejected such fears, saying on Thursday he was concerned "if we don't win AI, we're going to be put in a very bad position".

The company published its latest threat intelligence report , external on Thursday.

Such reports have become a regular feature across the AI industry as firms seek to demonstrate how they identify and disrupt attempts to misuse their models.

This includes Google, which wrote on Tuesday , external that a person had attempted to use its AI tool, Gemini, to obtain a "complete, step-by-step technical guide for synthesizing weaponised biological agents".

Claude, Anthropic's AI model was also used by actors linked to a Russia-based cyber espionage campaign and by an Iranian propaganda institution, according to its report.

The cases of concern detected over the past eight months ranged from fake dating apps and hotel Wifi scams, to surveillance built to identify dissidents.

Anthropic has also accused Chinese AI firms of trying to replicate Claude's capabilities.

The lengthy report lists cases in which suspected state-sponsored groups, criminals, spyware vendors, state propaganda institutions and politically motivated individuals misused its technology.

"Malicious use" of its Claude Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus models was disrupted between December 2025 and August 2026, it said.

None of the misuse cases involved Claude Fable or the powerful Mythos-class models, with the exception of one instance of distillation - the process for training smaller AI models using larger, more expensive models.

As well as detecting the use of its models for cyber and influence operations, surveillance, scams and fraud and weapon development, Anthropic said it had blocked scientists who used its AI in ways that could support biological weapons development.

The report highlighted "five case studies of actors using our models in ways that could support biological weapons development".

Biological misuse, it said, is "one of the most serious risks of frontier AI model". Without the correct safeguards, such capabilities "could have catastrophic consequences", Anthropic said.

"The same information that can be used to develop a biological weapon could also be used to develop, for example, a...
body.zh: Anthropic 表示，它已经发现并阻止了利用其人工智能模型进行“恶意活动”的企图，这些活动可能支持生物武器的开发。 该公司最近的威胁情报报告中提出的这一说法是人工智能研究人员和业内人士就该技术对人类潜在风险发出的一系列越来越多的警告中的最新一个。 这一警告促使人们呼吁采取行动，美国参议员伯尼·桑德斯要求暂停先进人工智能的开发并禁止人工智能。 唐纳德·特朗普总统迄今为止否认了这种担忧，周四表示，他担心“如果我们不能赢得人工智能，我们将处于非常糟糕的境地”。 该公司周四对外发布了最新的威胁情报报告。其他人工智能公司也发布了类似的报告。 其中包括谷歌，该公司周二写道，外部有人试图使用其人工智能工具Gemini来“完成合成武器化生物制剂的分步技术指南”。 据 Anthropic 的报告称，Anthropic 的人工智能模型 Claude 还被用于与俄罗斯有关的网络间谍活动以及伊朗的一家宣传机构。 过去八个月发现的令人担忧的案件包括假冒约会应用程序和酒店 Wifi 诈骗，以及为识别异见人士而建立的监控。 Anthropic 还指责中国人工智能公司试图复制克劳德的能力。 这份冗长的报告列出了涉嫌国家支持的团体、犯罪分子、间谍软件供应商、国家宣传机构和具有政治动机的个人滥用其技术的案例。 声明称，2025 年 12 月至 2026 年 8 月期间，对其 Claude Haiku、Sonnet 和 Opus 模型的“恶意使用”被阻止。 所有滥用案例均不涉及 Claude Fable 或强大的 Mythos 级模型，但蒸馏的一个实例除外，即使用更大、更昂贵的模型来训练较小的 AI 模型的过程。 Anthropic 表示，除了检测其模型用于网络和影响行动、监视、诈骗和武器开发的情况外，它还阻止了那些使用其人工智能支持生物武器开发的科学家。 该报告强调了“参与者以支持生物武器开发的方式使用我们的模型的五个案例研究”。 报告称，生物滥用是“前沿人工智能模型最严重的风险之一”。 Anthropic 表示，如果没有正确的保障措施，这种能力“可能会带来灾难性的后果”。 人类说：“可用于开发生物武器的相同信息也可用于开发疫苗或疾病治疗方法等。” Anthropic 威胁情报主管雅各布·克莱因 (Jacob Klein) 向《纽约时报》表示，从外部来看，这是“...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented power, much like the builders of Babel. While AI can be a tool for good, this report reveals its potential for misuse, capable of aiding in the creation of biological weapons. It calls us to reflect on our ambitions and the ethical guardrails needed when wielding such...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展赋予了人类前所未有的力量，这与建造巴别塔的人们颇为相似。虽然人工智能可以成为造福人类的工具，但本报告揭示了其被滥用的可能性，能够协助制造生物武器。这促使我们反思自身的野心以及在使用如此强大的技术时所需的伦理约束，以免我们的创造物带来意想不到的毁灭。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Mozambique protects Mount Mabu ‘butterfly forest’
title.zh: 莫桑比克保护马布山“蝴蝶森林”

summary.en: Mozambique has officially designated Mount Mabu, a region in the Lugela district known for its endemic wildlife and over 200 butterfly species, as a protected area. The newly established Mount Mabu Community Conservation Area, spanning 9,341 hectares, places stewardship in the hands of local communities who have long...
summary.zh: 莫桑比克已正式将位于卢盖拉区、拥有特有野生动植物和200多种蝴蝶的马布山列为保护区。新设立的马布山社区保护区占地9341公顷，将管理权交给了长期以来一直保护这片森林的当地社区。

body.en: Mozambique has formally protected Mount Mabu, a hotspot of endemic wildlife and home to more than 200 species of butterflies, located in the Lugela district of northern Mozambique. The decree, published on Aug. 24 by the Ministry of Agriculture, Environment and Fisheries, created the 9,341-hectare (23,082-acre) Mount Mabu Community Conservation Area, with stewardship of the land granted to the local communities that have preserved the forest for generations. “It’s a great relief,” Julian Bayliss, an ecologist who led several surveys over 20 years that helped build the case for protecting Mount Mabu, told Mongabay by phone. “These forests are very important because they’ve got high levels of endemism.” Map by Emilie Languedoc/Mongabay. Every year in October and November, hundreds of butterflies gather in the morning on the 1,700-meter (5,577-foot) summit of Mount Mabu, a mating behavior scientists call hilltopping. In 2013, the phenomenon was documented by naturalist David Attenborough who lent Mount Mabu the nickname “butterfly forest.” Scientists have recorded more than 200 butterfly taxa at Mabu but say the real number could reach 250 with further surveys. Since 2005, more than 30 species, including frogs, chameleons, bats and insects, have been discovered in the forests of Mabu. Bayliss and colleagues most recently described a new-to-science cobalt-blue butterfly, Iolaus mabuensis, found by a research team he led in Mabu in 2008. Only one specimen of the species has been collected to date, Bayliss said. Front and back of the Iolaus mabuensis butterfly. Image courtesy of Szabolcs Sáfián. Bayliss was also…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 莫桑比克已正式保护马布山，该山是特有野生动物的热点地区，也是 200 多种蝴蝶的家园，位于莫桑比克北部的卢盖拉地区。农业、环境和渔业部于 8 月 24 日发布的法令创建了占地 9,341 公顷（23,082 英亩）的马布山社区保护区，并将土地的管理权授予世世代代保护森林的当地社区。生态学家朱利安·贝利斯 (Julian Bayliss) 在电话中对 Mongabay 表示：“这让人松了口气。”20 年来，他领导了多项调查，为保护马布山奠定了基础。 “这些森林非常重要，因为它们的特有程度很高。”地图由 Emilie Languedoc/Mongabay 绘制。每年 10 月和 11 月，数百只蝴蝶都会在早晨聚集在马布山 1,700 米（5,577 英尺）的山顶，科学家将这种交配行为称为“山顶”。 2013年，自然学家大卫·阿滕伯勒（David Attenborough）记录了这一现象，他给马布山起了“蝴蝶森林”的绰号。科学家们在马布记录了 200 多个蝴蝶类群，但表示，通过进一步调查，实际数量可能会达到 250 个。自2005年以来，马布森林中已发现青蛙、变色龙、蝙蝠和昆虫等30多个物种。 Bayliss 和同事最近描述了一种新科学钴蓝色蝴蝶 Iolaus mabuensis，是由他领导的一个研究小组于 2008 年在马布发现的。Bayliss 说，迄今为止只收集到了该物种的一个标本。 Iolaus mabuensis 蝴蝶的正面和背面。图片由 Szabolcs Sáfián 提供。贝利斯也是……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The creation of the Mount Mabu Community Conservation Area is a testament to the intricate beauty and value of the natural world. It reminds us of the profound wisdom and diversity Yahweh has woven into creation, as Psalm 104:24 observes, 'How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.' May this protected...
reflection.zh: 设立马布山社区保护区是自然界错综复杂之美和价值的证明。它提醒我们雅伟在创造中编织的深刻智慧和多样性，正如诗篇104:24所言：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！万物都凭你的智慧造就；全地充满了你的创造。”愿这片受保护的区域激发敬畏之心和负责任的管理。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: North Sea gasfield decision likely delayed until after Holborn and St Pancras byelection
title.zh: 北海气田决定可能推迟到霍尔本和圣潘克拉斯补选之后

The Green Party accuses the Labour Party of hiding its position on the issue to avoid criticism before the Holborn and St Pancras byelection, in which Zack Polanski is standing.
summary.zh: 北海有争议的杰克多（Jackdaw）气田的批准决定将推迟到晚秋。绿党指责工党在扎克·波兰斯基（Zack Polanski）参选的霍尔本和圣潘克拉斯（Holborn and St Pancras）补选之前隐藏其立场，以避免批评。

body.en: Greens accuse Labour of hiding position to avoid criticism before contest, in which Zack Polanski is standing A decision on approving the controversial Jackdaw gasfield in the North Sea is to be delayed until later this autumn, with the Greens accusing Labour of hiding their position before the crucial Holborn and St Pancras byelection. Miatta Fahnbulleh, the energy secretary, had been poised to give her recommendation to approve the Jackdaw field off the coast of Aberdeen next week . Continue reading...
